SubTitle.月下に咲くは白百合の旗: <size=-5><line-height=60%>The White Lily Banner Blooms Beneath the Moon</line-height></size>
SubTitle.あなたの隣を歩けたら: If I Could Walk Beside You

Description.シリウスシュガーの少女たちはメイズにて、\n全裸で追いかけられる謎の男性を発見す: In the Maze, the girls of Sirius Sugar discover a mysterious man being chased around completely naked. That was the beginning of a fate-altering encounter.
Description.突如として退学の危機に陥る指揮官たち。\nそんな彼女たちは最強クラスのチームと\: The commanders suddenly face the threat of expulsion. To save their future, they must challenge a top-tier team in a high-stakes battle with everything on the line.
Description.危機を乗り越えたシリウスシュガーへと、\n待ち受けていた次なる試練は資金難？\n: Having overcome the crisis, the next trial awaiting Sirius Sugar is... financial trouble? As they take on new challenges, an unexpected turn of events unfolds...
Description.２つの試練を乗り越え成長した彼女たちの\n次なる試練は問題児達の訓練指導！？\n: <size=90%>Having grown after overcoming two trials, their next ordeal is instructing a group of problem children!? Meanwhile, a conspiracy targeting them begins to unfold in the shadows...</size>
Description.次に指揮官が導くのは、チーム『トレブル\nクインテット』。ＭＧの新型ジェネレータ: Next, the commander leads team 'Treble Quintet'. They take on a project to evaluate MG's new generator model, and so—
Description.ＬＯＣでの事件を解決した指揮官は、突如として誘拐される。その犯人は……スランプに: After resolving the incident at LOC, the commander is suddenly kidnapped. The culprit is none other than... 'Chaos Maiden', who have fallen into a slump!?
Description.ミリアム達に招かれた指揮官。そこで彼は\n『ピクシス・マスール』の解散と新チーム: Invited by Miriam and her group, the commander learns of the disbandment of 'Pyxis Ma Soeur' and the birth of a new team, 'Arcturus'—
Description.人工スタンピードの犯人『双頭の斧』を一斉検挙するため、学園は大規模作戦を企図。そ: <size=80%>To round up the 'Double-Headed Axe', the culprits behind the artificial stampede, the Academy plans a large-scale operation. To that end, Sirius Sugar is provided with new machines—</size>
Description.危機的な状況から、生還した指揮官たち。\nイザナミによって支配されたパイロットを: Having survived a critical situation, the commanders launch a counteroffensive on the surface to save the pilots controlled by Izanami—
Description.ゾリャー校区に現れたのは、イザナミが操る\n戦略機動要塞『八咫烏』。指揮官達は校: Appearing in the Zorya School District is the strategic mobile fortress 'Yatagarasu', controlled by Izanami. The commanders head into battle to protect the district. Just then, five Tenkyu units appear—

Appearing in the Zorya School District is the strategic mobile fortress 'Yatagarasu,' controlled by Izanami. The commanders head into battle to protect the district. Just then, five Tenkyuu units appear--
Description.ピコの告げる真実に衝撃を受ける一同。\nそしてそれをきっかけに記憶を取り戻す指揮:
Everyone is shocked by the truth Pico reveals.
And spurred by it, the Commander regains his memories.
The final battle with Izanami begins—
Description.イザナミとの戦いが終わり、ようやく静かな\n時間が戻ってきた。だからこそ、俺は―: With the battle against Izanami over, a quiet time has finally returned. That is precisely why I—I must properly determine where I belong.

SubTitle.色褪せるは白百合の園: The Fading Garden of White Lilies
SubTitle.煌めくは白百合の剣: The Gleaming Sword of White Lilies
SubTitle.結びつくは白百合の絆: The Bound Ties of White Lilies
SubTitle.選んだ居場所: The Place I Chose to Belong

Overview.「次の公式試合で負ければ退学」\nそんな条件を言い渡されたシリウスシュガー。\n: "Expulsion if you lose the next official match." That was the condition handed down to Sirius Sugar. Living alongside these girls who lacked any sense of urgency, you, as their commander, must discover what missing element Sirius Sugar needs...
Overview.同じ校舎のチーム『カラフルブーケ』との\n演習で惨敗し、後がないことを自覚した\: After suffering a crushing defeat in a practice match against Colorful Bouquet, a team from the same school building, the members of Sirius Sugar realize they have their backs to the wall. To train them, the protagonist subjects them to drills that seem downright unreasonable. Pushed to their limits, frustration builds up within the girls, but as a test of their progress, they dive into the maze...
Overview.ついに訓練を終えたシリウスシュガー。\n成果を披露するものの、不安を隠す事の\n: Sirius Sugar has finally finished their training. Though showcasing the fruits of their labor, Meru remains unable to hide her anxiety, and together you head out to scope out the competition. What you witness there is Chaos Maiden, a team boasting overwhelming skill. What will be the outcome of a match with the team's destiny on the line...?
Overview.辛い特訓乗り越えたシリウスシュガー。\nだが、楽観視できない現状に危機感を抱く\: Sirius Sugar managed to overcome their grueling special training. However, feeling a sense of crisis regarding their far-from-promising situation, Nanairo head out together to the Scalar School Building. There, they witness the prowess of Julia Barnes, who possesses talent beyond common sense. What will be the outcome of a match with the team's destiny on the line...?
Overview.退学の危機を乗り越えたシリウスシュガー。\nしかし、次なる危機が待ち受ける。\n: Sirius Sugar survived the threat of expulsion, but the next crisis was already waiting for them. And that was... the team's lack of funds! As they prepare to embark on a full-scale maze exploration to earn money, two familiar girls arrive to act as their advisors.
Overview.順調に進んでいくメイズの探索だったが、\n『メイズシンドローム』という現象による: The maze exploration was progressing smoothly, but a condition known as "Maze Syndrome" leaves them feeling ill and brings their progress to a halt. However, that very phenomenon increases their maze aptitude, pushing them to venture even deeper. But when they discover a new route...
Overview.メイズの未知なる領域へと落ち、危機に陥る\nシリウスシュガーのメンバー。\n極限: Falling into an unknown region of the maze, the members of Sirius Sugar find themselves in danger. Pushed to the brink, what are the feelings that the cheeky and competitive Rami opens up to the commander about? In a desperate, cornered situation, will they be able to escape the maze safely...?
Overview.新ルート開拓に失敗して、メイズの奥底へと\n落ちていったシリウスシュガー。\nそ: Having failed to forge a new route, Sirius Sugar plummets into the depths of the maze. Even in such an unsettling situation, Shirona remains a pillar for the team, her skills earning everyone's trust. Yet, only the commander notices a certain side to her...? Will they truly be able to escape the maze...?
Overview.メイズの深層から脱出という危機を乗り越えた\nシリウスシュガー。そんな彼女たちに: Having overcome the crisis of escaping the maze's deep layers, Sirius Sugar receives an unexpected request. It entails training the pilot trainees of Pre-Class A. Flipping the script from students to teachers, will they be able to successfully shape them up?
Overview.大きな陰謀に巻き込まれたシリウスシュガー。\nそのターゲットは『月ヶ瀬ちゆる』と: Sirius Sugar becomes embroiled in a massive conspiracy. The target was none other than Tsukigase Chiyuru, a genius. Sirius Sugar finds themselves competing against a team from another school in a match to decide who gets her. In the midst of the battle over Chiyuru, an unidentified, mysterious entity crashes the fight...
Overview.ちゆるを巡るバトルロイヤルに\n突如乱入してきた違法パイロット集団――\n『双頭: Suddenly barging into the battle royale over Chiyuru is a group of illegal pilots—Double-Headed Axe. Their goal, too, was Chiyuru. With various motives intertwining, Chapter 3 finally reaches its climax...!
Overview.ＬＯＣ所属『トレブルクインテット』からの\n依頼で、新型ジェネレーターの\n評価: Taking a request from Treble Quintet of LOC, the commander agrees to support an evaluation project for a new generator. Standing in their way, however, are the three members of their rival team, Trinity Jewel!
Overview.１勝１敗で迎えた次なる試験は、\nメイズでの実地試験。\nトリニティ・ジュエルと: Tied at one win and one loss, the next trial is a practical test inside the maze. In a match against Trinity Jewel that they cannot afford to lose, Evi can be seen quietly wrestling with her own troubles. Entering the challenge with various anxieties and emotions, where will this maze exploration contest lead...?
Overview.情報窃取の疑いで捕まったトリニティ・\nジュエル。リリーの呼びかけもあり、\n指: Trinity Jewel is arrested on suspicion of stealing information. Prompted by Lily, the commander and Flute begin questioning people around LOC to see if anyone suspicious has been spotted, hoping to prove their innocence. In doing so, an unexpected name comes up.

Trinity Jewel is arrested on suspicion of stealing information. Prompted by Lily, the commander, Evi, and the others track the traces of unauthorized access. In the process, Evi realizes the possibility that her former hacking mentor, Farfalla, might be involved in this matter...
Overview.ＬＯＣでの依頼を終えた指揮官は、突如として\nＭＧ集団に誘拐されてしまう。その正: Upon finishing the request at LOC, the commander is suddenly kidnapped by a group of MGs. Their true identity turns out to be Chaos Maiden, who have fallen into a slump. Meanwhile, a request from "a certain someone" comes in for Meru and the others while they wait for the commander.
Overview.生徒会長が企画した競技、メイズラッシュ。\n参加を要請されるカオスメイデンだが、: Maze Rush— a competition organized by the student council president. Chaos Maiden is requested to participate, but they are still stuck in a severe slump. Will the commander be able to guide them out of it...?
Overview.突如として現れた巨大穿光属種によって、\n分断されたふたつのチーム。\n未だに受: The two teams are separated by a giant Spearlight species that appears out of nowhere. Julia remains bewildered, unable to accept her feelings. Just then, a swarm of Spearlight species launches an attack against them.
Overview.突如として現れた巨大穿光属種によって、\n分断されたふたつのチーム。\n未だに己: The two teams are separated by a giant Spearlight species that appears out of nowhere. Saya still hasn't found her answer. Just then, a new Maze Shifter attacks them.
Overview.ユーロ・タワーに新チーム『アークトゥルス』\nが発足。このチームにドロテアがリー: A new team, Arcturus, is formed in Euro Tower. Dorothea is scouted to be its leader, leaving Pyxis Ma Soeur destined for dissolution. Wanting to stay with Dorothea, Miriam and the others invite the commander to assist in special training so they can win the member selection trials.
Overview.ユニティエッジに勝利したミリアム達。\nだが、その後リュシーから告げられたのは、: Miriam and the others defeated Unity Edge. However, Lucy delivers a shocking truth to them afterwards: Miriam, Harriette, and Kate weren't even eligible to participate in the selection trials in the first place. Upon learning this, Miriam and the others...
Overview.コード９９１――大規模敵性存在の出現。\n学園中の生徒達はＭＧを駆り、\n次々と: Code 991—the appearance of a large-scale hostile entity. Students across the academy pilot their MGs and head to the battlefield one after another. The commander, too, sorties at the head of Dorothea and the others to eradicate the threat approaching the academy.
Overview.コード９９１――大規模敵性存在の出現。\nそれは人工的に引き起こされた可能性が\: Code 991—the appearance of a large-scale hostile entity. Word has it that this might have been artificially triggered... To pursue Double-Headed Axe, the suspected culprit, the commander leads Dorothea and the others deep into the Sparkling Belt...
Overview.人工的にスタンピードを発生させている\n『双頭の斧』。\n学園は彼女達を一斉検挙: Double-Headed Axe has been artificially causing stampedes. In order to round them all up at once, the academy plans a large-scale operation. To that end, Sirius Sugar is provided with new units...
Overview.神楽とコトハが、実は仲間だった……\nその事実に動揺する一同。\nそこにさらに神: Kagura and Kotoha were actually allies all along... Everyone is shaken by this fact. To make matters worse, Kagura and her companion reveal a shocking truth. It pertains to the very foundation of this world, as well as the crisis currently unfolding within it...
Overview.イザナミによって大事な仲間を奪われた\n指揮官とコトハ。そんなふたりを救ったのは: Having had precious comrades stolen from them by Izanami, the commander and Kotoha are saved by Team Krasna—a team from the Zorya School Building led by Olga Volkova. Entrusted with Kagura's "hope" by the team, Kotoha...
Overview.暗示にかかった仲間たちを救うため、\n一行は４つのサブノードの破壊に動き始める。: To save their brainwashed allies, the group sets out to destroy four sub-nodes. The first target is Node-A in the nearest LOC district. Waiting for them there are their former academy schoolmates...
Overview.トレブルクインテットやトリニティ・ジュエル\nを打ち破り、さらにイザナミの防御網: Having defeated Treble Quintet and Trinity Jewel, as well as breaking through Izanami's defense network, the commander and the group successfully destroy Node-A. The second target is Node-S in the Scalar district. The commander prepares for the upcoming battle while deepening bonds with Kotoha and everyone in Krasna.
Overview.カオスメイデン戦での予想以上の消耗から、\n指揮官たちは残り２つのサブノードを\: Due to greater depletion than expected during the battle with Chaos Maiden, the commander and the group decide to split into two teams to capture the remaining two sub-nodes. The commander and Kotoha set off for Node-N alongside Olga and Elena. Waiting for them there is...

Due to greater depletion than expected during the battle with Chaos Maiden, the commander and the group decide to split into two teams to capture the remaining two sub-nodes. The commander and Kotoha set off for Node-K alongside Nadja and Elena. Waiting for them there is...
Overview.指揮官を排除するため、行動を開始した\n戦略機動要塞『八咫烏』。\n強大すぎる敵: The strategic mobile fortress Yatagarasu springs into action to eliminate the commander. Facing an overwhelmingly powerful foe, the group avoids direct combat, opting instead for an operation to strike Izanami's main server. Just as they attempt to break through a drone encirclement, five Tenkyu appear...
Overview.指揮官の演説を引き金として、\nザルトゥームの生徒達は洗脳から解放された。\nし: Triggered by the commander's speech, the students of Zartum are freed from their brainwashing. Driven to madness, however, Izanami deems the area of the speech a target for purge and launches an attack. Freed from mind control, the various teams gather around the commander to fight alongside one another and protect the people.
Overview.生還した神楽を加え、決戦の準備は整った。\nザルトゥームの人々の自由を勝ち取るた: Joined by the surviving Kagura, preparations for the final battle are complete. To win back freedom for the people of Zartum, the group embarks on their final operation, targeting Selenosia Island where Izanami's main body resides. As preparations proceed at a breakneck pace, the commander catches sight of Tatiana, who looks exhausted...

Joined by the surviving Kagura, preparations for the final battle are complete. To win back freedom for the people of Zartum, the group embarks on their final operation, targeting Selenosia Island where Izanami's main body resides. As preparations proceed at a breakneck pace, the commander catches sight of Elena, who wears a gloomy expression...
Overview.イザナミとの最後の戦いが始まる。\n立ちはだかるのは、全力の『八咫烏』。\nザル:
The final battle with Izanami begins.
Standing in the way is the full-powered "Yatagarasu."
With the future of Zartum Island and its people at stake,
the Commanders head into the decisive battle.
Overview.ザルトゥーム島の真実を知った学園の少女達。\nそしてそのピコの話をきっかけに、\:
The Academy girls learn the truth of Zartum Island.
And spurred by Pico's words,
the Commander regains his memories.
Though shocking, it changes nothing about their goal.
For the freedom and future of Zartum Island,
the party heads for Izanami's main server—
Overview.１万年以上前。アマツカゼに乗って宇宙へ\n旅立ったあなたとイザナミ、そして――\:
More than 10,000 years ago. You and Izanami
set out into space aboard the Amatsukaze, and—
Captain "Mikage Asahi" and the crew.
In the new land they reached at the end of a long voyage,
they are forced to make a momentous choice—
Overview.イザナミとの戦いが終わり、\nザルトゥーム島に日常が戻った。\n指揮官は自身がこ: With the battle against Izanami over, daily life returned to Zartum Island. The Commander is troubled by the reality that they are one of the 'root causes' who changed this world. Amidst this, he ends up going out on a date with Meru, just the two of them—
Overview.生徒会長・四王天神楽は双頭の斧の少女達に\n学園への所属を提案する。\nしかしコ: Student Council President Kagura Shioumon proposes that the girls of the Twin-Headed Axe join the academy. However, Kotoha refuses. Afterward, they suddenly abandon their hideout and disappear. It seems their destination is the Maze—

Hobby.研究・読書・友達と出かける: Research, reading, and hanging out with friends
Hobby.読書・野良猫マップ作成: Reading and making stray cat maps
Hobby.ファッション ・古着屋巡り: Fashion and visiting secondhand clothing stores
Hobby.ヒーロー作品を見る事・グッズ収集: Watching hero shows and collecting merch
Hobby.推し活: Supporting my favorite idol / Oshi activities
Hobby.日記をつける（誰にも見せない）: Keeping a diary (never showing it to anyone)
Hobby.いろんな茶葉をあつめること: Collecting various kinds of tea leaves
Hobby.食べたことないもの探し: Searching for foods I've never tried
Hobby.軍歌・戦詩・英雄叙事詩の朗読・戦術シミュレーションゲーム: Reciting military songs, war poetry, and epic hero poems; tactical simulation games

Description.平凡な家庭に生まれた少女。過集中の傾向があり、集中すれば高いパフォーマンスを発揮: A girl born into an ordinary family. She has a tendency to hyperfocus, which allows her to perform exceptionally well when concentrated, though this has caused troubles with those around her in the past. She has a strong desire to be helpful to others.
Description.シリウスシュガーのリーダー。ＭＧ事業で１代にして財を築いた鳴滝家の長女。世の中か: The leader of Sirius Sugar. Eldest daughter of the Narutaki family, who built their fortune in a single generation through the MG business. Known to the world as nouveau riche, she carries a complex about it and wants the world to recognize the Narutaki family as respectable, legitimate wealth.
Description.社交的で明るいメイズオタク。会員が自分だけの『メイズ研究同好会』を立ち上げ、１人: A social, cheerful Maze nerd. An eccentric who founded the 'Maze Research Club' where she is the sole member and conducts research alone. She is supposedly extremely smart, but because her suspicious experiments constantly trigger explosions in the clubroom, those around her view her as a brilliant idiot.
Description.お金を稼ぐためにザルトゥーム学園へと入学した少女。生意気で負けず嫌いな性格をして: A girl who enrolled in Zartum Academy to earn money. She has a cheeky, competitive personality and never backs down, even against older opponents. Coming from a complicated family environment, she is reluctant to talk about her background.
Description.ミステリアスなオーラを漂わせる寡黙な少女。様々な分野で好成績を残している事から、: A quiet girl with a mysterious aura. Respected across the academy for her high achievements in various fields, she seems to hold a secret she can tell no one...
Description.カラフルブーケのリーダー。政治家の父を持つ名家出身の少女。柊校舎内でも優秀なパイ: The leader of Colorful Bouquet. A girl from a distinguished family with a politician father, and an elite pilot in the Hiiragi Dorm. Strict with both herself and others, she values discipline above all. Though feared by some students, she is deeply caring at heart.
Description.引っ込み思案で自信のない少女。学園にも両親に言われたから入学しただけで、危険で怖: A shy, insecure girl who only enrolled in the academy because her parents told her to, and wants to quit because it's dangerous and scary. Despite her fears, her abilities are exceptional and highly valued by her team, though her lack of self-awareness leaves her perpetually frightened.
Description.生まれつき知能が高く、周囲にも献身的で慕われている優等生。効率的に立ち回る事を好: A naturally brilliant honor student, devoted to others and widely admired. She prefers acting with maximum efficiency. As Colorful Bouquet's strategist, she stays behind the scenes to support the team, though she appears to harbor a secret.
Description.ノヴァセレスの元貴族。元貴族ではあるが、誇りを重んじる負けん気の強い性格。いつか: A former noble from Novaceres. Despite her fallen status, she possesses a fierce pride and competitive spirit, dreaming of reviving her family's business to prove everyone wrong. She can be surprisingly easy to manipulate at times. 'Kira' is her mother's surname.
Description.面倒くさがりな省エネ主義であり、目立ったことを嫌って必要以上に前に出ないようにし: An energy-saving slacker who hates standing out and avoids the spotlight whenever possible. A longtime best friend of Aoi, she constantly backs up Aoi, who frequently creates friction with others.
Description.カオスメイデンのリーダー。パイロットとして天才的なセンスを持っているが、性格は問: The leader of Chaos Maiden. A genius pilot whose personality is a complete disaster. Though bright and charismatic, she is childish and tactless, with a mysterious origin that hints at hidden secrets...
Description.スカラ地区の華連というコミュニティの出身。商家の娘でビジネスの世界を知るせいか他: Hailing from the Karen community in the Scalar District. As a merchant's daughter familiar with business, she can be strict with others, but is fundamentally caring and kind. Reluctant to be bound to her family's trade, she hopes to work for a stable company with good benefits in the future.
Description.アマツをルーツに持つスカラ地区出身の茶道宗家の息女。茶の道を究める精神修行を兼ね: A grandmaster's daughter from a tea ceremony family in the Scalar District with roots in Amatsu. She became a pilot as part of her mental training to master the way of tea. Perceived by outsiders as a gentle young lady, her teammates seem to view her quite differently.
Description.掴みどころのない性格をしており、普段はぼんやりとしていることが多い。しかしＭＧに: An elusive girl who often seems spaced out. However, once inside an MG, she displays top-tier piloting skills capable of handling any situation. In her own words, she enrolled in the academy to learn human emotions.
Description.ノヴァセレスをルーツに持つ少女。仲の良い相手をからかい、その反応で親愛を試すよう: A girl with roots in Novaceres. She has a bad habit of teasing close friends to test their affection through their reactions. Raised by a single mother currently hospitalized for mental illness, she became a pilot to pay medical bills and secure a stable future.
Description.アマツ系の少女。凄腕のパイロットだが他人と行動するのが苦手。実力で学園に特例を認: A girl of Amatsu descent. A highly skilled pilot who struggles to work with others, her sheer talent forced the academy to grant a special exception allowing her to operate as a solo team. Raised in the mountains by her father in self-sufficiency, her favorite nail gun is a keepsake from him.
Description.トレブルクインテットのリーダー。元々は真面目で大人しい地味な子だったが、ネットを: The leader of Treble Quintet. Originally a serious, quiet, and plain girl, her discovery of Amatsu's 'gal culture' online inspired her to become a gal herself. She is now a popular gal streamer with a growing fanbase.
Description.幼い頃からＰＣに慣れ親しみ、ネットで出会った師匠から教わったハッキング技術で、一: Familiar with computers from an early age, she operates as a top-tier white hat hacker using skills learned from a mentor online. Lacking grand dreams or ambitions, she holds a pragmatist mindset focused heavily on time efficiency and cost-performance.
Description.かつてはザルトゥーム島でも有名な歌手として活動していた。現在は活動を休止し、パイ: Once a famous singer on Zartum Island, she currently put her music career on hold to work as a pilot. Fluffy, cheerful, and soothing to be around, her hobby is cultivating cacti.
Description.起業家の父親と画家の母親の間に生まれた、商売人気質な少女。親から教わった手腕で、: Born to an entrepreneur father and painter mother, she inherited a natural business instinct, running several ventures despite being a student. Broadly social and outgoing, she struggles with an unfortunate tendency to view relationships in terms of profit and loss.
Description.金属工芸アーティストとして有名であり、一部界隈からは『空想造形師ロージー』という: Famous as a metalcraft artist, known in certain circles by the alias 'Rosie the Imaginary Sculptor.' Raised in a family auto repair shop, she is skilled with machinery. Exceptionally bright and free-spirited, she frequently drags along anyone she takes a liking to.
Description.ピクシス・マスールのリーダー。名門カークランド公爵家の一人娘。上に立つべき人間と: The leader of Pyxis Ma Soeur and the only daughter of the prestigious Ducal Kirkland family. A true noble who honors the duty of leadership, acting in a way that commands respect. Her maid Lucy has been her best friend since childhood, whom she regards as an older sister.
Description.下級貴族ヘイワード家の生まれ。実家は貴族としての体面を維持するのがギリギリで、暮: Born to the low-ranking noble Hayward family, whose lifestyle barely maintains aristocratic appearances and resembles commoners. Admiring Dorothea after a certain incident, she became a maid-in-training. Poor at academics, her confidence is second to none.
Description.下級貴族ミルズ家の生まれ。多忙な両親の元で一人で過ごしてきた事から、内向的で人見: Born to the low-ranking noble Mills family, spending her childhood alone due to busy parents left her introverted and shy. She idolizes Dorothea following a certain incident and became a maid-in-training. Sharp-tongued and guarded toward outsiders, she is earnest and affectionate at core.
Description.中級貴族フルニエ家の生まれ。やや特殊な家庭環境で育ったせいか、運動神経抜群。ある: Born to the mid-ranking noble Fournier family, her unusual home upbringing granted her outstanding athletic ability. Inspired by Dorothea after a certain incident, she became a maid-in-training. Usually timid, she is secretly the scariest member of the team when angered.
Description.プレ・クラス－Ａのリーダー。４人兄妹の末っ子として、家族に愛されて育ってきた明る: The leader of Pre-Class A. Raised as the beloved youngest of four siblings, she is a bright girl who respects her father, a small business owner, and plans to start her own company. A bit clumsy and clumsy-brained, but relentlessly positive.
Description.母親がアマツ出身なハーフの女の子。弟や妹が多く、家族の生活のためにパイロットを目: A half-Amatsu girl with many younger siblings who entered the academy as a pilot to support her family's livelihood. Gentle and big-sisterly, she finds joy in helping others. She is terrified of ghosts and bugs.
Description.かつて将来を期待された陸上競技の選手だったが、事故によってその道を諦めることに。: A promising track-and-field athlete whose career was cut short by an accident. Finding out her Maze aptitude opened a second path in life at the academy. Stoic and hardworking, her lack of cooperativeness sometimes leads to trouble.
Description.人懐っこく誰とでも仲良くなれるが、メイズに潜ると我を忘れて暴れまわる危険な一面を: Friendly and quick to make friends, she harbors a dangerous side that loses control and goes wild when diving into the Maze. Secretly a romantic, she loves reading romance novels away from prying eyes.
Description.カークランド家のメイド。孤児。幼い頃施設を飛び出し、路上生活を送っていたが、ある: A maid of the Kirkland family and an orphan. After running away from an orphanage to live on the streets, she saved a drowning Dorothea from a river, becoming her maid. She considers Dorothea both her master and a younger sister.
Description.元々は内気で臆病な少女だったが、『超機神ジャスティオン』という作品を読んでからヒ: Originally a timid, shy girl, reading 'Super Machine God Justion' inspired her love for heroes, transforming her into a cheerful, justice-driven person. Passionate about heroes, she can talk endlessly whenever she meets a fellow enthusiast.
Description.スカラ地区の華連というコミュニティの名家出身。様々なコネクションを持っており、そ: From a prominent family in the Karen community of the Scalar District, her extensive connections remain shrouded in mystery. She respects Shiouten Kagura deeply and will push through any obstacle for her sake. Though she hides her weakness for spicy food, it is open knowledge.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Resilient and positive, she is uniquely assertive and overbearing only toward her childhood friend Takeru Shirogane.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Exceptional in swordsmanship, noble, and composed, rumors in her homeland say she bears a striking resemblance to a certain noble figure.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Always cheerful, innocent, and friendly, Takeru Shirogane calls her by the nickname 'Tama.' Her marksmanship as a sniper is exceptional.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Possessing a strict military personality that respects orders, she frequently clashes with the free-spirited Ayamine.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Bright and often the moodmaker of her squad, her overly easygoing pace sometimes causes her to tune out others.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Feline in demeanor, she possesses great close-quarters combat instincts and adapts fluidly, though over-improvising occasionally leads to acting alone.
Description.有名なモデルとしても活躍している精鋭クラスのパイロット。クールで知的なリーダーと: An elite pilot who also doubles as a famous model. She leads Trinity Jewel as a cool, intellectual leader. Born into an ethnic minority, she cherishes her homeland. It seems she harbors a secret hobby she has told to no one.
Description.運動が苦手で自尊心が低い陰気な女の子。だが、非常に高いメイズ適性と知識、観察力で: A gloomy girl poor at sports and low in self-esteem. However, her exceptionally high Maze aptitude, knowledge, and observation skills make her a powerful support pilot. Hoping to change herself, her first goal is losing weight, though her sweet tooth leaves little sign of success.
Description.不思議な雰囲気を持つフワフワとした博愛主義の女の子。みんなを笑顔にするために、色: A airy, philanthropic girl with an enigmatic aura. To make everyone smile, she helps solve people's troubles and fulfill their wishes. Though appearing laid-back, her piloting skills are praised as genius level.
Description.風紀委員会・副委員長。一見気怠げなギャルだが、実はノヴァセレスの下級貴族出身であ: Vice Chairperson of the Disciplinary Committee. At first glance a lazy gal, she is actually a low-ranking noble from Novaceres. Unserious and a chronic slacker, she is nevertheless clever and quietly supports the blunder-prone Mao behind the scenes. Though never showing it, she admires Mao deeply.
Description.風紀委員会・委員長。身体能力が高く、ＭＧ操作技術も風紀委員会トップ。正義感も強く: Chairperson of the Disciplinary Committee. Athletic with top-tier MG piloting skills in the committee. Earnest with a strong sense of justice, she is useless at administrative work outside piloting. Yet in crises, she steps up as a leader, acting as a resilient emotional pillar for everyone.
Description.クラスナのリーダー。パイロット歴１０年以上のベテランであり、一人の娘を持つ母親で: The leader of Krasna. A veteran with over 10 years of piloting experience and mother to a daughter. A strict woman who values discipline and rationality above all. Rarely displaying emotion, her awkward yet profound love for her daughter is genuine.
Description.オルガの一人娘。引っ込み思案で甘えん坊気質。母親に褒めてもらうため、日々努力を重: Olga's only daughter. Shy and affectionate by nature, she works hard every day seeking her mother's praise. Raised in a single-parent home, she longs for a father figure. Despite her appearance, she inherited her mother's talent and high MG piloting abilities.
Description.クラスナのムードメーカー。明るく元気な性格で、周囲の空気を読むことが得意。パイロ: The moodmaker of Krasna. Bright and energetic, she excels at reading the room. While her piloting skills fall slightly behind other members, her ability to mediate and coordinate among teammates is second to none.
Description.クラスナの作戦参謀。作戦立案力の高さを評価されており、その実力を買われてチームに: Krasna's tactical strategist. Recruited to the team for her renowned operational planning skills. Though appearing purely analytical and rational, she is compassionate and deeply values her friends. Her archaic manner of speech comes from her former female mentor.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Usually strict with herself, she occasionally glimpses the innocent side of a normal girl her age.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Hot-headed and quick to fight, she excels in close-quarters battle using unique maneuvers she developed herself.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' A cool beauty with mature charm, she also shows a domestic side by occasionally cooking dishes from her homeland.
Description.違法パイロット組織『双頭の斧』のボス。その正体は『ＡＩＤＡプロトコル統括ＡＩ・イ: The boss of the illegal pilot syndicate 'Double-Headed Axe.' Her true identity is an isomorphic construct of the original Shiouten Kagura, operating behind the scenes to liberate the world from the control of 'AIDA Protocol Managing AI Izanami.' Feisty at first glance, she is deeply considerate and kind at heart.
Description.メイズの内部で出会った『衛士』を名乗る少女。『戦術機』と呼ばれるＭＧに似た人型兵: A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' A cool beauty with mature charm, she also shows a domestic side by occasionally cooking dishes from her homeland.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Hot-headed and quick to fight, she excels in close-quarters battle using unique maneuvers she developed herself.

A girl encountered inside the Maze who calls herself a 'Surface Pilot.' She pilots a humanoid weapon similar to an MG known as a 'Tactical Surface Fighter.' Usually strict with herself, she occasionally glimpses the innocent side of a normal girl her age.
Description.主人格ニーナ・ミーシナ。クラスナのメンバーで、二重人格の少女。物腰柔らかく、穏や: The primary personality, Nina Mishina. A member of Krasna and a girl with a dual personality. She has a soft-spoken and gentle demeanor. In daily life, the primary personality Nina is active, and she can switch personalities by sneezing. However, Gina occasionally pops out on her own as well.
Description.別人格ジーナ・ミーシナ。クラスナのメンバーで、二重人格の少女。やや芝居がかった口: The alternate personality, Gina Mishina. A member of Krasna and a girl with a dual personality. She has a unique personality, speaking in a somewhat theatrical tone. Gina primarily handles combat while piloting the MG. According to them, they share memories with each other even while switching personalities.

Favorite.静かな場所・自分の部屋: Quiet places and my own room
Favorite.カフェスイーツ・ファッション雑貨・ポップミュージック: Cafe sweets, fashion accessories, and pop music
Favorite.正しいこと・小動物・子ども: Doing the right thing, small animals, and children
Favorite.母に従うこと・甘い食べ物・一家団欒: Obeying mother, sweet foods, and family time
Favorite.他人の笑顔・可愛い文房具やメモ帳: Smiles of others, cute stationery, and notepads

Description.鳴滝七彩をリーダーとした落ちこぼれチーム。仲の良さならトップにも負けない。: A underachieving team led by Narutaki Nanairo. When it comes to how well they get along, they lose to no one, even the top teams.
Description.生駒葵をリーダーにした校舎内トップクラスチーム。規律の取れた連携が強み。: A top-tier team in the school building led by Ikoma Aoi. Their strength lies in disciplined coordination.
Description.リーダーのユリアの性格を反映したような自由さが売りの校舎内トップクラスチーム。: A top-tier team in the school building whose selling point is a sense of freedom reflecting the personality of their leader, Julia.
Description.実力によって学園から特例で単独結成を認められた榊野ヒイロだけのチーム。: A team composed solely of Hiiro Sakakino, granted a special exception by the academy to form alone due to her skill.
Description.ドロテアをリーダーとした学園でも指折りのチーム。統率の取れたチームワークが強み。: One of the academy's leading teams, led by Dorothea. Their strength lies in well-organized teamwork.
Description.フルートをリーダーとしたチーム。全員がパイロット以外に別の肩書きを持つ。: A team led by Flute. Every member holds a title or profession outside of being a pilot.
Description.レイヴェルをリーダーとしたチーム。たった３人でもトップクラスの実力を持つ。: A team led by Ravel. Despite having only three members, they possess top-class strength.
Description.再訓練用校舎『特別養成校舎』に所属するプレ・クラスのうちの１チーム。: One of the Pre-Class teams belonging to the 'Special Training School Building,' a facility used for retraining.
Description.オルガをリーダーとするチーム。チームの連携力は、他チームを凌ぐと言われている。: A team led by Olga. Their team coordination is said to surpass all other teams.
Description.生徒会直下の治安維持チーム。各校舎から集められた生徒達で構成されている。: A public safety team directly under the student council, composed of students gathered from each school building.

Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、味方全体に対し1ヒットまで攻撃を回避するバフを付与す: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants all allies a buff that evades attacks for up to 1 hit
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、味方全体に対し、2行動の間気絶無効のバフを付与する: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants all allies a buff that negates Stun for 2 actions
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、敵全体に1行動の暗闇を付与する。暗闇状態は40%の確: Removes all buffs and debuffs and inflicts 1 action of Blindness on all enemies. While blinded, skills miss with a 40% chance
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、敵全体に1行動の炎上を付与する。炎上は攻撃力×15%: Removes all buffs and debuffs and inflicts 1 action of Burn on all enemies. Burn deals continuous damage equal to ATK x 15%
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、敵全体の防御力を1行動の間50%低下させる: Removes all buffs and debuffs and lowers all enemies' DEF by 50% for 1 action
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、最大HP・攻撃力・防御・行動速度・会心率を強化し、敵: Removes all buffs and debuffs, strengthens Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate, and inflicts all enemies with 2 "Nevyurim". Additionally, grants the user "Mutation".
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、最大HP・攻撃力・防御・行動速度・会心率を強化し、自: Removes all buffs and debuffs, strengthens Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate, and grants the user 2 hits of evasion. Additionally, grants the user "Mutation".
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、最大HP・攻撃力・防御力・行動速度・会心率を20%強: Removes all buffs and debuffs, raises Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate by 20%, and reduces all enemies' ATK by 10%. Additionally, grants the user "Mutation".

Removes all buffs and debuffs, strengthens Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate, and grants the user a buff that evades attacks for 2 hits.
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、最大HP・攻撃力・防御力・行動速度・会心率を強化する: Removes all buffs and debuffs and strengthens Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、自身に対し、自身が2回行動を終えるまでの間、新たに付: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants the user a buff that negates newly applied Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate debuffs until the user finishes 2 actions.
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、自身に対し「意志の力」を付与する: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants the user "Willpower"
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、自身に対し「荒魂」を1つ付与する。さらに1行動の間、: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants the user 1 "Wild Soul". Additionally, for 1 action, randomly raises 1 of the user's ATK, DEF, Action Speed, or Crit Rate by 30%, and lowers 1 of the other 3 by 15% (stackable)
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、自身に対し最大HP×12.5％のダメージを防ぐシール: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants the user 4 shields that block damage equal to 12.5% of Max HP. The shields disappear 1 at a time each action
Stages[]::SkillDescription.全てのバフ・デバフを解除し、自身を除く味方全体に対し回復量を20%増加させるバフ: Removes all buffs and debuffs and grants all allies other than the user a buff that raises their healing by 20%. Additionally, distributes and restores HP worth power 100 evenly among all allies other than the user
Stages[]::SkillDescription.味方全体を、全てのバフ・デバフを解除した状態で復活させる。さらに自身の最大HP・: Revives all allies with all buffs and debuffs removed. Additionally, strengthens the user's Max HP, ATK, DEF, Action Speed, and Crit Rate.

This gacha uses Paid/Free Gems or Standard Gacha Tickets. 
 
[Gacha Points] 
In the Standard Gacha, each 1 pull earns 1 Standard Gacha Point.
※Standard Gacha Points do not expire.
 
[Wishlist]
For each of the 4 basic types (Aggressive, Smart, Shy, Cute), you can add 4 students to your wishlist, and for each of the 2 special types (Comical, Clever), you can add 1 student. When a wishlist is set, only students on that wishlist can appear as SSR students.  

[Style Cards] 
If you obtain a student you already own, that student is converted into a Style Card.
Style Cards are used for student Limit Breaks.

[Available Students]
Students newly introduced in pickup gachas are gradually added to this gacha.
※Students from limited pickup gachas are excluded from these additions.

Name.双頭の斧補給基地_地穴帯差分_その他: Twin-Headed Axe Supply Base (Earth Pit Zone Variant) (Other)
Name.LOC校区放送タワー地下通路_その他: LOC District Broadcast Tower Underground Passage (Other)

Speech.集中しすぎて周りが見えなくなるくせ……今なら前向きに受け止められます。これもあな: I used to get so focused that I'd lose track of everything around me... But now I can see the good in that habit. That's thanks to you, too.
Speech.この学園に入ってよかったと心からそう思ってます。シリウスシュガーのみんなやあなた: I'm so glad I came to this academy. If I hadn't met you and everyone in Sirius Sugar, I don't think I would ever have changed.
Speech.今度どこかにシリウスシュガーのみんなと遊びに行きませんか？例えばピクニックとか…: Would you like to go somewhere with everyone in Sirius Sugar sometime? Maybe a picnic... I'd be happy to make lunch for everyone!
Speech.あれ……？ 反応がありませんね……もしかしてお休み中でしょうか？ふふ、目が覚める: Huh...? You're not answering... Are you asleep, maybe? Hehe, I'll wait here until you wake up.
Speech.今日はあなたが生まれた記念すべき日……そんな日に立ち会えて、なんだか嬉しいです。: Today's the special day you were born... I'm so happy I get to be here for it. Shall we celebrate in my room, just the two of us? For the whole day, of course.
Speech.ふふっ、あけましておめでとうございますっ！ こうして一緒に年を越せて、感慨深いで: Hehe, Happy New Year! It means so much to ring in the new year with you. I'm still a little clumsy, but... please keep me by your side.
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーですね……ふふっ、もちろんチョコレートはありますよ。えっ？: It's Valentine's Day... Hehe, of course I brought chocolates. Huh? You're asking if they're safe to eat, with no alcohol in them...? W-Well... who knows?
Speech.ドキドキ……ドキドキ……きょ、今日ってホワイトデーですよね！その…………えっ？: Ba-dump... ba-dump... T-Today's White Day, isn't it? Um... Huh? You have something for me, too? H-Hehe... I'm so happy!
Speech.あ、あのっ……私！ あなたに嘘をついてみたいです！！……なんて、今の言葉が嘘だっ: U-Um... I! I want to try telling you a lie!! ...Or maybe that was the lie... Hehe.
Speech.ウエディングドレスって結婚式のとき以外にも着たいほど、綺麗なドレスですよね。実は: Wedding dresses are so beautiful, you almost want to wear one even when you're not getting married. There's actually a shop nearby where you can try them on... Would you like to go have a look with me?
Speech.ふふ、私のお願いはもう叶っちゃったか、あるいはみんながいれば叶うものばかりです。: Hehe, all my wishes have either come true already, or will as long as everyone's with me. So I'll share my wishes with you.
Speech.秋といえば食欲の秋。もしよろしければ、かぼちゃ料理なんてどうですか？くり抜いたも: Autumn always gives me an appetite. Would you like something made with pumpkin? Everyone in the school building gave me lots of pumpkin they'd scooped out, saying, 'Use this for cooking'...
Speech.メリークリスマスです！ あの……チームのみんなとのクリスマスパーティーのあと、よ: Merry Christmas! Um... after the team's Christmas party, would you like to have another one... 'just for the two of us'?
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……？ ありがとうございます！ プレゼント何がいいか……ですか？: Happy birthday...? Thank you! You're asking... what I'd like for a present? Oh, w-well... I'd like to s-spend this whole day... alone with you...
Speech.ここって……なるほど……|あなたのおかげで、だいぶわかるようになってきたかもです: This part... Oh, I see...|Thanks to you, I think I'm starting to understand it much better. You're good at helping with schoolwork, too.
Speech.ちょっと眠く……|あっ……ね、寝てない……ですよ？ え？ 見てた？ き、気のせい: I'm getting a little sleepy...|Oh... I-I wasn't sleeping, you know? Huh? You saw me? A-Are you sure you weren't imagining it?
Speech.（あっ！ 目があった……）|（うぅ……そういえば今ふたりきりなんだよね……意識し: (Oh! Our eyes met...)|(Ugh... come to think of it, it's just the two of us right now... Now that I've noticed, my heart won't stop racing!)
Speech.自分だけが犠牲になればいいなんて思いません。あなたと、みんなと……一緒に生きて帰: I don't think sacrificing myself is the answer. I promised you and everyone else... we'd all come back alive, together. I'll never give up!
Speech.最近、前よりも少しだけ自分に自信が持てるようになった気がします。あなたがいつも、: I feel like I'm a little more confident than I used to be. It's because you're always looking out for me. Hehe...
Speech.メイズ深層での戦いは不安ですけど……あなたとなら、どこまででも行ける気がするんで: I'm nervous about fighting deep in the Maze... but with you, I feel like I can go anywhere. So please keep guiding me!
Speech.すぅ……すぅ……あっ、いけない！ 私のほうが寝ちゃってました。あなたが無防備な顔: Zzz... zzz... Oh, no! I'm the one who fell asleep. You looked so peaceful and unguarded sleeping there that I just relaxed... Hehe.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございますっ！ あなたが生まれてきてくれた奇跡に、心から感謝し: Happy birthday! I'm so grateful for the miracle that brought you into this world. Today, I'll do... anything you ask!
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます！ 今年もあなたのお世話はいーっぱい私にさせてくだ: Happy New Year! Let me take really good care of you again this year! First, let's visit the shrine... and buy charms for luck in love!
Speech.ハッピーバレンタイン、ですっ！ ……あ、あの、このチョコ……私のありったけの『想: Happy Valentine's Day! ...U-Um, these chocolates... I made them myself, with all my 'feelings' in them... so you'll eat every last one, won't you?
Speech.……えっ、これ……私にですか！？ バレンタインのお返し……っ！ あ、あわわ……嬉: ...Huh, these... are for me!? A gift in return for Valentine's Day...! O-Oh, wow... I'm so happy! They're too precious to eat. I almost want to keep them on display forever...!
Speech.実は私……ちょっと家の事情で故郷に帰ることにしたんです。……なーんて、嘘ですよっ: Actually... I've decided to go back home because of some family matters. ...Just kidding! Sirius Sugar is where I belong.
Speech.６月の花嫁は幸せになれるって言いますよね。……あの、もし私がウエディングドレスを: They say a bride who marries in June will be happy. ...Um, if I wore a wedding dress... would you stand beside me...?
Speech.短冊にお願い事、書きましたか？ 私は……『ずっとみんなのそばにいられますように』: Have you written a wish on your paper strip? I wrote... 'I wish I could always stay by everyone's side.' ...Hehe, do you think it'll come true?
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート、ですっ！ お菓子をくれないとイタズラしちゃいますよ？…: Trick or treat! If you don't give me sweets, I'll play a trick on you! ...Huh? You'd rather play a trick on me than give me sweets...? Aww...!
Speech.この時期は街がキラキラしてて、とっても綺麗ですね……でも私にとっては、こうしてあ: The city looks so beautiful, all sparkling at this time of year... But for me, nothing sparkles brighter than these moments I get to spend with you.
Speech.私のお誕生日、覚えててくれたんですね……っ！ ありがとうございます！……誕生日プ: You remembered my birthday...! Thank you! ...Could I ask for one thing as my birthday present? Please, take me—N-No, never mind!
Speech.えへへ……転んじゃいました……|まだまだこのスーツ、全然着こなせてないですね……: Hehe... I fell over...|I still haven't got the hang of wearing this suit at all...
Speech.あっ……胸元が……！|うぅ……この格好、やっぱり恥ずかしいです……あ、あまり見な: Oh... the chest...!|Ugh... this outfit really is embarrassing... P-Please don't stare so much...
Speech.ピチッとした感じ……苦手かも……|普段あまりこういうのを着ないので、張り付く感じ: I don't think I like how tight it feels...|I don't usually wear things like this, so it's hard to get used to how it clings to me...
Speech.実はドライフラワー作りが得意ですの。自分が育てた花を、ずっとわたくしの手元に残し: I'm actually quite good at making dried flowers. I learned because I wanted to keep the flowers I'd grown with me forever.
Speech.今までの自分を振り返ると……冷静に立ち向かう重要性が分かりますわね。焦っては、ノ: Looking back on how I used to be... I can see how important it is to face things calmly. I can't fulfill my noblesse oblige if I let myself panic.
Speech.秘密にしておりましたが……実はジャンクフードも好きですの。濃いめの味が好きで……: I've kept this a secret... but I actually enjoy junk food, too. I like strong flavors... Um, would you like to go out for some together?
Speech.ふぅ……こうして静かな時間を過ごすのも悪くありませんが……。どうしても、チームの: Phew... A quiet moment like this is quite pleasant... And yet, I find myself missing all the noise and bustle of being with the team.
Speech.あなたの誕生日には、どんなことをしてあげればいいのでしょうか？……お金じゃない、: What should I do for your birthday? ...I'd like to give you something from the heart, something money can't buy.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。もし、あなたが良ければ……一緒に新年のあいさつで: Happy New Year. If you'd like... would you come home with me to exchange New Year's greetings?
Speech.その、どうぞ。バレンタインデーのチョコレートですわ。生まれて初めて手作りをしてみ: Um, here you are. Valentine's chocolates. It's the first time I've ever made them myself... Would you accept them?
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しですか？ ありがとうございます。……ふふ、あなたから貰ったも: A White Day gift? Thank you. ...Hehe, since it's from you, I'll treasure it.
Speech.実はお父様の会社が倒産しまして……今はただの一般人なんですの。 ……えっと、嘘で: Actually, Father's company has gone bankrupt... so I'm just an ordinary girl now. ...Um, that was a lie. I'm really not very good at this!
Speech.わたくし、いつか結婚をするのなら政略結婚などではなくて……大好きな誰かと大恋愛の: If I marry someday, I don't want it to be an arranged marriage for political reasons... I want to fall deeply in love with someone, and then marry them.
Speech.……こうして空に祈って願い事をかなえてもらうよりも、自分の力で叶えたい……そんな: ...Rather than praying to the sky to grant my wishes, I'd like to make them come true myself... That's how I've come to feel, you know?
Speech.トリックオアトリート……いえ、仮装はしませんわよ？子供の頃は、それこそとっても派: Trick or treat... No, I won't be dressing up. As a child, I used to wear such extravagant costumes that I stood out for all the wrong reasons...
Speech.メリークリスマス。お金を使って豪華なパーティもいいですけども……自分たちの手で準: Merry Christmas. A lavish party is lovely, of course... but preparing everything ourselves and celebrating together is wonderful, too♪
Speech.わたくしの誕生日を祝ってくださってありがとうございます……ふふ、あなたに祝ってい: Thank you for celebrating my birthday... Hehe, somehow, having you celebrate it makes me feel all giddy...
Speech.はぁ、とっても可愛い……|ふふ、ふかふかで、とても愛らしくて……このままずっと抱: Oh, it's so cute...|Hehe, so soft and fluffy, and utterly adorable... I could hold it like this forever.
Speech.これが、あちらに……あっ！|取るのに失敗してしまいましたね……こういうゲームは難: This goes over there... Oh!|I failed to get it... Games like this are so difficult.
Speech.ふふ、ありがとうございます。|知らない場所でも、安心できるのはあなたが居てくれた: Hehe, thank you.|It's because you're here that I can feel at ease, even somewhere unfamiliar.
Speech.メイズっていうのは謎が多くて奥が深いんだよねぇ。いつかは全ての謎を解き明かしたい: The Maze is full of mysteries. There's always more to discover. I'd love to unravel them all someday... Though I usually take my research at my own pace♪
Speech.シリウスシュガーの皆は割と気に入ってるよ。だって面白い子達ばっかりだもんね。もち: I'm pretty fond of everyone in Sirius Sugar. They're all so interesting! And of course, I'm very interested in you, too♪
Speech.ねえねえ、ちょっと実験に付き合ってくれないかな？ どんな内容かって？簡単だよ！: Hey, hey, wanna help me with a little experiment? What's it about? Easy! All you have to do is drink that rainbow-colored liquid... Absolutely not? Aww, come on~!
Speech.んー、暇だなぁ。あたしに構ってくれないと退屈で死んじゃうよ～？: Mmm, I'm bored. If you don't pay me some attention, I might just die of boredom~!
Speech.今日はキミの誕生日なんだよね？今なら、特別にあたしの部屋へご招待♪ 一緒に朝まで: It's your birthday today, right? Then here's a special invitation to my room♪ Wanna stay up having fun together till morning?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！折角の新年だからね、どうせなら部室でちょっと爆発でも起こし: Happy New Year! Since it's a special occasion, maybe I'll set off a little explosion in the clubroom and give everyone the shock of their lives♪
Speech.ハッピーバレンタイン！ さて、チョコを作ってきたからパクっと食べてみて！……え？: Happy Valentine's Day! Here, I made chocolates. Pop one in your mouth! ...Huh? Did I put something in them? Ahaha... Try one and you might find out!
Speech.おや、ホワイトデーのお返しをくれるの？うーん、君も律儀だねぇ。ありがと、大切に食: Oh, a White Day gift for me? You're so thoughtful. Thanks! I'll savor every bite♪
Speech.さて、おバカな振りはやめて科学者として活動を再開しようかしらね……なーんて、冗談: Well, maybe it's time to stop playing the fool and get back to work as a scientist... Just kidding♪ Huh? That sounded serious? Ahaha, which part do you think was true?
Speech.ジューンブライドかぁ。気になるよねぇ。なんで６月にやるんだろう？結婚するなら、も: June brides, huh? Makes you wonder, doesn't it? Why June? You'd think there'd be a better month to get married, right? ...I'm killing the romance?
Speech.願い事？ うーん、それなら面白いことが起きますようにって願いをするかな。自分で叶: A wish? Mmm, I'd probably wish for something interesting to happen. No point wishing for something I can make happen myself♪
Speech.お化けかぁ。なんとなくお化けの正体を考察してみてるんだけどさ。メイズの重力異常か: Ghosts, huh? I've been tossing around ideas about what they really are. Beings created by gravitational anomalies in the Maze... So maybe ghosts come from the Maze, too... Just a thought!
Speech.メリークリスマス♪ いやー、クリスマスっていいよねぇ！だって、ホールケーキを誰に: Merry Christmas♪ Ahh, Christmas is great! It's the day you can eat a whole cake without anyone giving you grief♪ ...No, it isn't?
Speech.え？ 誕生日？ ……ああ、そういえばそうだったね。意外と覚えてなかったから不意打: Huh? My birthday? ...Oh, right, it is. I'd actually forgotten, so you really caught me off guard... Thanks♪
Speech.え？ 誕生日？ ……ああ、そういえばそうだったね。意外と覚えてなかったら不意打ち: Huh? My birthday? ...Oh, right, it is. I'd actually forgotten, so you really caught me off guard... Thanks♪
Speech.んー、君と一緒だからかなぁ？|こうしてのんびりしてても、一人でいる時よりもずっと: Mmm, maybe it's because I'm with you?|Even just lazing around like this feels so much more fun than being on my own♪
Speech.んん～！ 美味しい！|もしかして、一口欲しい？間接キスになっちゃうけど、それでい: Mmm~! Delicious!|Want a bite? It'll be an indirect kiss, but if you're okay with that, I'll share♪
Speech.わわっ！？ ……なんだ、花びらかぁ。|いきなり何事かと思っちゃった……もっとおし: Wah!? ...Oh, it's just a petal.|I thought something had happened... Maybe I should've reacted a little more gracefully?
Speech.アマツから戻ったら、さっそく研究研究研究の研究ざんまいだね♪ こんなに時間あるの: Now that I'm back from Amatsu, it's research, research, research, all day long♪ With this much free time, it'd be a waste to just sit around! I'm itching to get started~!
Speech.ねえ、お正月だからこそ、メイズ探索いかない？ 他のチームとか休んでて人少なそうだ: Hey, since it's New Year's, wanna explore the Maze? The other teams are probably taking time off, so it'll be less crowded. Sounds like a nice, easy trip, right? Oh, but that means more Maze Shifters for us to fight...
Speech.ねえ、甘酒買ってきたんだけど、一緒に飲まない？ あ、でも、酔っ払って襲わないでよ: Hey, I bought some amazake. Wanna have some with me? But don't get drunk and pounce on me, okay? I couldn't fight you off. Huh? This wouldn't get you drunk? Really~?
Speech.お正月のせいで、ちょっと体重が……%usernameusernameuserna: I've put on a little weight over New Year's... %usernameusernameuserna% probably likes girls on the skinny side—Wait, when did you get behind me!? You... didn't hear that, did you!?
Speech.誕生日おめでと。今日はあたしがキミの神様になって、何か１つ願い事を叶えてあげよう: Happy birthday. Today, I'll be your goddess and grant you one wish... 'Anything,' as long as it isn't dangerous. Don't tell Meru-chan and the others, okay?
Speech.あけましておめでとう、%usernameusernameuserna%。これから: Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%. I hope we'll keep saying that to each other for years to come. So, on that note, give me some New Year's money for my research♪
Speech.はい、チョコ羊羹。振袖着てるし、せっかくなら渡すものも和菓子っぽいのがいいかなっ: Here, chocolate yokan. Since I'm wearing a furisode, I thought a Japanese sweet would suit the occasion. Besides, you've probably gotten chocolate from other girls, so I wanted mine to leave an impression♪
Speech.ん？ ホワイトデーのお返しに苺大福？ わぁ、美味しそう♪ こんな美味しそうなの、: Hm? Strawberry daifuku for White Day? Wow, they look delicious♪ Are you sure I can have something this good? Even if you ask, you're not getting them back! But I might be open to eating them together.
Speech.今日エイプリルフールだったよね？ ふふ、そうだ。あたしの質問に答えてみてよ。『あ: It's April Fools' Day today, right? Hehe, I know. Answer me this: 'Do you like me or hate me? Which is it?' How will you answer, %usernameusernameuserna%~?
Speech.多分あたしって研究第一人間だから、行き遅れる気がするんだよね。もしそうなったらさ: I'm the sort who puts research first, so I might end up missing my chance to marry. If that happens, would you marry me? ...Just kidding. Though with that settled, I could keep putting research first without worrying.
Speech.七夕の願い事かぁ……神社でも散々したし、これ以上は欲張りすぎて罰が当たるかもね。: A Tanabata wish, huh... I've already made so many at the shrine, I might get punished for being greedy if I make any more. Still, since they'll hear me out for free, this feels like better value...
Speech.ハロウィンなのに振袖はおかしいって？ まあでも、アマツなら着物姿の女の霊が出てく: A furisode for Halloween is weird? Well, Amatsu has ghost stories about women in kimonos. Why not call it an Amatsu-style Halloween? We could have yokan for the sweets, too♪
Speech.メリクリ～！ 振袖だと違和感ある？ どうせこのあとすぐお正月だし、別にいいでしょ: Merry Christmas~! Does the furisode look out of place? New Year's is right around the corner anyway, so it's fine. Supermarkets start taking orders for New Year's food early, don't they? Think of it like that.
Speech.へえ～誕生日祝ってくれるんだ？ じゃあ、今日はキミがあたしの願いを叶える神様にな: Oh~? You're celebrating my birthday? Then today, you can be the god who grants my wishes. Hmm, what should I ask for~? Let's start by wishing for 100 wishes♪
Speech.ぷくー……|ふふ、どう？ あたしのほっぺもお餅っぽいでしょ。: Puff...|Hehe, what do you think? My cheeks are like mochi, too, aren't they?
Speech.醤油、使う？|砂糖醤油を絡めたお餅は格別だよね～。それともキミと一緒だから格別な: Want some soy sauce?|Mochi with sweet soy sauce is something special~. Or maybe it's special because I'm eating it with you?
Speech.まだかな、まだかな、お・も・ち♪|ちなみにこことこれとあれは、あたしが育ててる餅: Is it ready? Is it ready? Mo-chi, mo-chi♪|By the way, this one, that one, and the one over there are the mochi I'm tending, so hands off!
Speech.いやー、今思えばメイズで出会ったときの裸のおまえ、動画にでも撮っておけばよかった: Ugh, thinking back, I should've filmed you naked when we met in the Maze~! With that, I could keep messing with you forever!
Speech.部屋の中、物が少ない？ まあ、あんましいろいろ買うお金ないし。どこに消えてるのか: Not much stuff in my room? Well, I don't exactly have the cash to buy a bunch of things. Where's it all going? That's—none of your business~!
Speech.お金って本当人間変えちゃうよね……特にうちの親とか財政状況がマイナスに振り切って: Money really changes people... Especially my parents, once their finances went way into the red—Sorry. I shouldn't be telling you this.
Speech.……はぁ、退屈～。最近金欠だし、暇つぶしの材料も買えないの、マジだる……なんで世: ...Haa, I'm bored~. I'm broke lately, so I can't even buy anything to kill time with. Such a pain... Why does everything in this world have to cost money...?
Speech.誕生日なんだ？ へえ、めでたいじゃん。……え？ 普通に祝ってくれて意外？ こうい: It's your birthday? Huh, good for you. ...What? Surprised I'm actually being nice about it? I can wish you a happy birthday, you know. It only comes once a year. Nobody celebrating it would be pretty lonely, right?
Speech.よし、きた！ お正月！ お正月といえば……！ お年玉！ だから、ちょ～だい！え？: Yes! It's here! New Year's! And you know what that means... New Year's money! So gimme~! Huh? I'm too old for that now? Oh, come on~! Who cares!
Speech.え～？ もしかしてラミからチョコが欲しいの～？どうしよっかな～？ 用意はしてるけ: Ooh~? You want chocolates from Rami~? Hmm, what should I do~? I've got some ready, but do you waaant them~? Reeeally want them~?
Speech.え？ バレンタインのお返し？ ふーん……まあ、良い心がけじゃない？おまえにしては: Huh? A gift in return for Valentine's? Hmm... Well, at least you've got the right idea. Pretty thoughtful, for you... Th-Thanks.
Speech.ラミだけ課題の提出し忘れがある……？ マジで！？ ……なんて、驚くと思った？そん: I'm the only one who forgot to hand in an assignment...? Seriously!? ...What, you thought I'd fall for that? I'm not buying a lie like that! ...Huh? You're not lying? Seriously!?
Speech.……何？ ラミだって女の子なんだから、ドレスに憧れはあるっての。人生で１回くらい: ...What? Rami's a girl, too, you know. Of course I dream about wearing a dress. I'd like to wear a wedding dress at least once in my life... Glance.
Speech.願い事？ お金ほしい！ ……って言いたいところだけど、お金はあくまで手段というか: A wish? I want money! ...That's what I'd usually say, but money's just a means to an end, not the goal. What I really want is—for my little brother and sister to be happy.
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ お菓子じゃなくて、お金よこせー！え？それじゃ、ただのアウ: Trick or treat! Forget the candy, hand over the cash! Huh? That just makes me an outlaw?
Speech.今日おまえも含めてクリスマスパーティーやるじゃん？ でもラミ、こういうの初めてな: We're having a Christmas party today, with you there too, right? Thing is, it's my first time doing this. We didn't really get to at home. So what am I supposed to... Oh, right. No point asking a guy with amnesia.
Speech.待ちに待った、ラミの誕生日～！ おまえはどんなプレゼントしてくれるの？時計？ カ: Finally, Rami's birthday~! So, what are you getting me? A watch? A bag? Jewelry? Anything I can sell for cash works. Heck, a wad of bills is fine, too!
Speech.はぁ～、まったく。|なっさけないなぁ、もう。そんなんでラミ達の教導指揮官できるの: Haa~. Seriously.|How pathetic. Can you really be our Instructional Commander like that~?
Speech.あはっ、どこで寝てんの？|いくら疲れてるからって、こんな道端で寝るとか野生動物じ: Ahaha, where do you think you're sleeping?|I don't care how tired you are. Sleeping on the roadside? What are you, a wild animal~!?
Speech.ざ～こ、ざ～こ、よっわ～！|もっと普段から体力つけてないから、こうやってラミに笑: Weakling~! Weakling~! So weak~!|If you worked on your stamina more, you wouldn't have Rami laughing at you like this!
Speech.昔は、こういう浮かれた空気はあんまり好きじゃなかったけどさ……最近は、なんだろ…: I never used to like all this festive stuff... But lately, I dunno... Thanks to you and everyone else, I think I'm starting to get what makes it fun.
Speech.久々に弟と妹の顔見たなー。ちょっと大きくなってて、やっぱ子どもの成長って早いよね: It's been ages since I saw my little brother and sister. They've gotten a bit bigger. Kids really grow up fast~. Huh? I'm taking my time? I'm not a kid! I'm just a little petite!
Speech.神社巡りのために、お賽銭用の小銭いっぱい両替しておいたけど、マジでおっっっも！: I changed a bunch of money into coins for shrine offerings, but they're sooo heavy! My wallet's gotten seriously fat! ...Oh, I can just make %usernameusernameuserna% carry it.
Speech.……ふんふんふーん♪ 結構着るのもダルそうだし、お金の無駄と思ったけど……着てみ: ...Hm-hm-hmm♪ I thought it'd be a pain to put on, and a waste of money... But now that I've tried it, a furisode isn't half bad♪
Speech.あ、誕生日おめでと。それじゃ、どこ行く？ ……え？ どういうことかって？そんなの: Oh, happy birthday. So, where are we going? ...Huh? What do I mean? Obviously, we're going out to celebrate together. Just for today, I'll go anywhere with you.
Speech.ん？ このメモ？ 神社でお祈り予定の願い事リストに決まってんじゃん。多すぎて覚え: Hm? This note? It's my list of wishes for the shrine, obviously. There are too many to remember, so I wrote them all down. You've got that 'aren't you being greedy?' look, but this is after I narrowed them down.
Speech.……なんか、ただチョコを渡すだけだっていうのに、この格好だと……仰々しくて緊張す: ...I'm just handing you some chocolate, but dressed like this... it feels so formal, I'm getting nervous... H-Hey, quit staring at my face!
Speech.ほら、バレンタインデー、チョコあげたんだからホワイトデー返しなさいよ。まさか準備: Look, I gave you chocolate on Valentine's Day, so you'd better give me something for White Day. Don't tell me you haven't got anything ready. I'm expecting three times as much!
Speech.あれ？ なんで服着替えてないの？ この後、学園の行事があるから正装しないとダメな: Huh? Why haven't you changed? There's an academy event later, so you need to dress up. What? You forgot? Seriously...? Just kidding~! Ahaha, you bought it?
Speech.ラミは白無垢よりもドレス派なんだよね～……って、正月に見たあの夢思い出したじゃん: I'd pick a wedding dress over a white bridal kimono... Ugh, now you've reminded me of that dream I had at New Year's... Huh? What dream...? N-Nothing!!
Speech.ふふ、七夕でも願い事しまくってやるんだから。そうすればご利益２倍ね！まずは弟と妹: Hehe, I'm making a ton of wishes for Tanabata, too. That means twice the blessings! First, happiness for my little brother and sister... That's the top priority. Then, you and me... Wait, scratch that!!
Speech.トリックオアウィーッシュ！ イタズラされたくなけりゃ、ラミの願い事をなんでも叶え: Trick or wish! If you don't want a trick played on you, you'd better grant every one of Rami's wishes! Huh? That's asking too much...? Fine. You're getting tricked, no arguments.
Speech.クリスマスかぁ……シリウスシュガーの皆とパーティーやろって話してて、楽しみにして: Christmas, huh... We're planning a party with everyone in Sirius Sugar, and I'm really looking forward to it♪ ...Still, if I show up dressed like this, they'll probably think I've got the date wrong...
Speech.もう誕生日か～。早いもんだよね。え？ 神様の代わりに願い事ひとつ叶えてやるって？: My birthday already~? That was fast. Huh? You'll grant me a wish in the gods' place? Ohh... If you'll grant 'anything,' what should I ask for~? ...Hm? You didn't go that far?
Speech.ちょ、取るな！？|あっぶなー……油断も隙もないなぁ。折角の大吉なんだから、大切に: H-Hey, don't take that!|That was close... Can't let my guard down around you. I got 'Great Fortune,' so of course I'm keeping it safe.
Speech.……やりすぎたかも。|ムキになっちゃった……うぐぐ……この後の予定が……節約しな: ...I might've overdone it.|I got carried away... Ugh... I've still got plans after this... Gotta watch my spending...
Speech.へへーん、大吉～♪|ほらほら♪ これこそ、本気ラミの運気パワーなんだから！: Heh-heh, Great Fortune~♪|See? See♪ That's Rami's luck power when she gets serious!
Speech.わたしは何もできないから……何かを出来る自分になりたいと思ってる。それがメイズに: I can't do anything... so I want to become someone who can. Even if it means doing something dangerous, like going into the Maze.
Speech.わたし、服を見たりするのが好きなの。もしよければ、あなたのコーディーネートをして: I like looking at clothes. If you don't mind, I'd like to put together an outfit for you... May I?
Speech.こんな、何もできないわたしの事を必要だって言って、仲間にしてくれた……そんなシリ: They said they needed me, even though I couldn't do anything, and welcomed me into the team... That's why I love Sirius Sugar. I want to help everyone.
Speech.……あれ？ もしかしてどこかに行っちゃった……？全然気づかなかった……えっと、ど: ...Huh? Did you go somewhere...? I didn't notice at all... Um, what should I do...?
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……わたしからお祝いをしたいの。だから、あなたのためにピッタリな: Happy birthday... I'd like to do something for you. Can I pick out an accessory that suits you perfectly?
Speech.わたしは初日の出を見たことがないの。毎年、気づいたらいつも寝ちゃうから……: I've never seen the first sunrise of the year. Every year, I end up falling asleep before I know it...
Speech.……これ、どうぞ。チョコレート。いつもお世話になってるから。頑張って作ったから、: ...Here. Chocolates. For always looking after me. I worked hard to make them, so I'd be happy if you told me what you think...
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？ 私にいいの？嬉しい……絶対に落とさないように気を付けるね: A White Day gift? Is it really okay for me to have this? I'm so happy... I'll make sure I don't drop it.
Speech.嘘をついていい日って言われてるけど……何を言えばいいんだろう？……うう、全然思い: They say it's a day when you can tell lies... but what should I say? ...Ugh, I can't think of anything... What kind of lie should I tell...?
Speech.ジューンブライド……６月に結婚式を挙げたら、幸せなお嫁さんになれるっていうの。…: A June bride... They say if you get married in June, you'll be a happy bride. ...I'd like to be one someday, too.
Speech.願い事……他の子みたいに要領良く出来るようになりたいな。他にも色々お願いしたい事: A wish... I'd like to get things done as smoothly as the other girls. There are lots of other things I'd like to wish for... but that's my biggest wish right now.
Speech.わたし、ハロウィンでお菓子をあげる準備をしてるんだけど……あげる前に子供たちから: I've got sweets ready to give out for Halloween... but the children run away before I can give them any. I wonder why...
Speech.メリークリスマス。クリスマスパーティーだね。ちゃんとサンタさんのための靴下も用意: Merry Christmas. It's time for the Christmas party. I've got a stocking ready for Santa-san, too. Everything's ready.
Speech.……もしかして誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ふふ、そんな風に祝って貰えるなんて……: ...Are you going to celebrate my birthday? Hehe, having you celebrate it like this... makes me so happy.
Speech.……不思議な気分。|一人でいつも来ているから……誰かと一緒に、アクセサリーを見る: ...This feels strange.|I always come here alone... Looking at accessories with someone else is fun, too...
Speech.……その、どうして見てるの？|髪をかき上げてるだけで……あんまり、じっと見られる: ...Um, why are you watching me?|I'm only brushing my hair back... It's embarrassing when you stare so much.
Speech.……どう、似合ってる？|ふふ……こんなに素敵なアクセサリーをプレゼントして貰えて: ...Well? Does it suit me?|Hehe... I'm so happy you gave me such a lovely accessory.
Speech.何度見ても、このスーツ……すごい格好。え？ もっと見ていたい？ ……変態。そもそ: No matter how often I look at it, this suit... is quite an outfit. Huh? You want to keep looking? ...Pervert. Are you sure you're happy with someone like me? I think everyone else is more attractive.

Speech.そろそろ温泉の季節じゃない！？ え？ ハロウィン……？ それよりも温泉いこーよ！: Isn't it about time for hot springs!? Huh? Halloween...? Forget that, let's go to the hot springs! Hot springs or Halloween! Just kidding! Which would you pick!?

Speech.誕生日祝ってくれるの！？ ありがとー！ ほしいプレゼントはぁ～%username: You're celebrating my birthday!? Thank yooou! The present I want is... %usernameusernameuserna%! Everyone in Chaos Maiden will take care of you, so wanna come join us after all?
Speech.うーん！ きもちー！|もうずっと入ってたいね～。しわしわにふやけちゃうけど！: Mmm! This feels so good!|I could stay in here forever~. Even if I end up all wrinkly!

Speech.一緒に入ろ～？|入らないの？ 洗いっことかもしたいな～なんて思ってたのに。: Come in with me~?|You're not coming in? And here I was hoping we could wash each other...
Speech.まったく、ユリアは放っておくと何しでかすかわかりませんし、フィーは逆に何もしませ: Honestly, leave Julia alone and there's no telling what she'll do. Fee, on the other hand, won't do anything. Saya can't control herself in battle, and Anis is always getting into trouble with someone... What is this team...?
Speech.はぁ、ユリアってば寝る前にお菓子食べて、その上歯も磨かずそのまま寝るんですよ。何: Haa, Julia eats sweets before bed, then goes straight to sleep without brushing her teeth. No matter how often I tell her, she won't listen... Could you speak to her as her Instructional Commander?
Speech.実家にいた頃は、弟や妹の面倒ばかり見ていました。親は自分達が忙しいからって、私に: Back home, I spent all my time looking after my younger siblings. My parents kept saying they were busy and leaving it all to me... I thought I'd finally escaped, but then there's everyone in Chaos Maiden...
Speech.あの……用がないなら、もう帰ります。いいんですか？ 本当に帰りますけど……それと: Um... If you don't need anything, I'll go now. Is that okay? I really will leave... Or are you deliberately ignoring me because you find it amusing? ...I'll get angry, you know.
Speech.あ、えっと……お、お誕生日、おめでとうございます。その……プレゼントです。弟や妹: Oh, um... H-Happy birthday. This is... your present. I picked it the same way I pick gifts for my siblings and everyone in Chaos Maiden, so I'm not sure you'll like it...
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。……まあ、義理として、一応挨拶はしておこうかなと: Happy New Year. ...Well, I thought I should at least offer a greeting out of courtesy. Huh? You're happy to see me so early in the new year...? D-Don't start the year with jokes like that...!
Speech.チョコがほしい……？ 嫌ですけど……って、なんでそんな悲しそうな顔してるんですか: You want chocolate...? I'd rather not... Wait, why do you look so sad? As if you expected to get some... Well, I have leftovers, if those will do.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し……ですか。まあ、くれるというなら、もらっておきます。どうせ: A White Day gift...? Well, if you're offering, I'll accept it. You're giving them to the other girls anyway, aren't you? Huh? I'm first...? I-I... I see.
Speech.正直、嘘をつくのもつかれるのも面倒なので、今日はあまり人と会いたくないです。あな: Honestly, telling lies and being lied to are both a hassle, so I'd rather not see many people today. You feel the same? Then why don't we spend today together? No lies, of course.
Speech.結婚……いずれはするんでしょうか。あまり想像はできませんね。というより、興味が薄: Marriage... I suppose I'll get married someday. I can't really picture it. Or perhaps I'm just not very interested. Still, I think it depends on the person. What about you?
Speech.願い事はシンプルに優秀な成績で卒業し、高給かつ安定した企業に就職することですね。: My wish is simple: graduate with excellent grades and get a well-paid job at a stable company. I don't particularly want a life of taking unnecessary risks.
Speech.ああ、今日ハロウィンですか……どうりで。さっき作業の合間に食べようと買ったお菓子: Oh, it's Halloween today... That explains it. Julia took every last sweet I'd bought to eat during breaks, saying, 'Today's the day you get sweets from your friends'...
Speech.はぁ……ユリアがクリスマスパーティーに興味を持ってしまって、今開催に向けて大忙し: Haa... Julia's taken an interest in having a Christmas party, so I'm terribly busy getting it ready. Huh? You'd like to come...? You'll help, too...? ...Hehe, I'd intended that all along.
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……？ そういえば、忘れていました。あ……そっか、それでみんな、: Happy birthday...? I'd forgotten, actually. Oh... That explains why everyone suddenly asked what I wanted... Well, since they've gone to the trouble, I think I'll forget again until I see them.
Speech.この景色、いいと思いませんか？|いつもはゆっくりひとりで眺めるんですが、『誰かと: Isn't this a lovely view?|I usually take my time enjoying it alone, but perhaps sharing it 'with someone' isn't so bad.
Speech.あっ……流れ星ですね。|あなたに願いごとってありますか？ 私はたった今思いつきま: Oh... A shooting star.|Do you have a wish? I just thought of one. Of course, what it is... is a secret.
Speech.えっ、私が……や、優しい……？|そんなことはないと思いますが……仲間や妹たちから: Huh, I'm... k-kind...?|I don't think so... My teammates and younger sisters think I'm just a nag...
Speech.ユリアが着てほしいってせがむから着てますが……どうしても露出が気になります……%: Julia kept begging me to wear this, so here I am... But I can't stop worrying about how much it shows... %usernameusernameuserna%-san, please don't stare so much.
Speech.はぁ……早く着替えたいです。これひょっとして、布の面積より露出した肌の面積のほう: Haa... I'd like to change already. Is there more exposed skin than fabric here? Even a swimsuit would be better...
Speech.家族にこんな姿を見られたら、威厳が丸潰れですよ。絶対に秘密にしてくださいね、約束: If my family saw me like this, I'd lose all my authority. Keep it absolutely secret, all right? Promise me. If they find out, you'll have to take responsibility.
Speech.お忙しいのですか？ でしたら私はこれで……この格好で一人で待たされるのは、罰ゲー: Are you busy? Then I'll be going... Being left to wait alone dressed like this is worse than a punishment game. Don't complain if I've changed by the time you come back.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。プレゼントとして、今日一日この格好でいてほしい？: Happy birthday. As your present, you want me to stay dressed like this all day? Haa... Honestly. Just for today, all right?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。どうして新年からこんな衣装なんですか。……縁起物: Happy New Year. Why am I starting the year in this outfit? ...It's a good-luck charm? Do you really think a lie like that will convince me?
Speech.バレンタインのチョコです。……ユリア達に『バニー姿で渡した方が喜ぶ』と言われて、: Valentine's chocolates. ...Julia and the others told me you'd be happier if I gave them to you in a bunny outfit, so I came over without changing. Once you've taken them, please turn around.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し、ありがとうございます。……その、できればお菓子よりも、この: Thank you for the White Day gift. ...Um, if possible, rather than sweets, a coat or something I could put on over this skimpy outfit would be more helpful.
Speech.実は私、この衣装をとても気に入っているんです。毎日着たいくらい……なんて、もちろ: I actually love this outfit. Enough to wear it every day... Just kidding, of course. It's April Fools' Day. Don't take it seriously. I want to change out of it already.
Speech.……え？ もし将来結婚するときは、ウェディングドレスの代わりにバニーはどうかって: ...Huh? If I get married someday, how about a bunny outfit instead of a wedding dress...? You'd want a bride dressed like this? Wait, I don't mean that we're getting married...
Speech.短冊の願い事ですか？ 『平穏無事な日々を過ごせますように』……それと、『早くこの: My wishes on the paper strip? 'May I have peaceful, uneventful days'... And, 'May I change out of this outfit soon.' Those are heartfelt wishes, so I really hope they come true.
Speech.ハロウィンの仮装だと言われて、なぜこのバニー服を渡されたのか理解に苦しみます。あ: I don't understand why I was handed this bunny outfit and told it was a Halloween costume. Oh, by the way, we've prepared one for you this time, too, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. So I'm counting on you.
Speech.クリスマスなのに、サンタでもトナカイでもなく、ウサギって……しかも露出度も高すぎ: It's Christmas, and instead of Santa or a reindeer, I'm a rabbit... And it shows far too much skin. I'd catch a cold immediately if I went outside in this.
Speech.誕生日のお祝い、ありがとうございます。どうして私は自分の生まれた記念すべき日に、: Thank you for celebrating my birthday. Why am I dressed like this on the special day I was born...?
Speech.あっ……！ もう！|どこ見てるんですか……！ というか、私のなんか見ても、楽しく: Oh...! Honestly!|Where are you looking...!? It's not as if looking at mine could be any fun, is it?
Speech.あちこち際どすぎます……|どんな思考回路をしていたら、こんないろいろ危ない衣装を: It's far too revealing in so many places...|What kind of mind comes up with an outfit with so many ways for things to go wrong...?
Speech.すごく視線を感じます……|この服着てシティを歩いたら、確実に風紀委員会に目をつけ: I can really feel you staring...|If I walked around the city dressed like this, I'd definitely attract the Disciplinary Committee's attention...
Speech.私の実家は茶道の宗家ですから、少しだけお茶やアマツの文化には詳しいのです。もしよ: My family heads a school of tea ceremony, so I know a little about tea and Amatsu culture. If you'd like, shall we talk about the different aspects of Amatsu culture?
Speech.お茶菓子は好きですが、甘すぎるものは実は苦手で……以前にリバティのケーキを食べた: I like sweets with tea, but I'm not very good with anything too sweet... I once had a cake from Liberty that was so sweet it gave me a headache...
Speech.私は紫雲家の跡継ぎとして、恥じない自分であるように律してきました。だからでしょう: As the Shiun family's heir, I've always held myself to strict standards so I wouldn't bring shame on our name. Perhaps that's why... I sometimes feel the urge to become someone different.
Speech.……そういえば、カオスメイデンの皆さんとお茶の約束をしていましたね。ふふ、ユリア: ...Come to think of it, I promised to have tea with everyone in Chaos Maiden. Hehe, what sweets should I serve Julia-san and the others?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。言葉だけではなく贈り物をしたいのですが……もしよけ: Happy birthday. I'd like to give you a present, rather than just my birthday wishes... If you'd like, shall we go shopping together now?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。一年の計は元旦にありといいます。ご一緒に一年の抱: Happy New Year. They say the year's plans begin on New Year's Day. Shall we decide on our resolutions together?
Speech.こちら、お饅頭です。……その、チョコレートが売り切れていて……いつも食べている和: Here, some manju. ...Um, the chocolates were sold out... These are the Japanese sweets I usually eat, but will they convey my feelings?
Speech.私にバレンタインデーのお返しを？……ふふ、とても嬉しいです。お茶を点てるのでご一: A gift in return for Valentine's Day, for me? ...Hehe, I'm very happy. I'll prepare some tea. Would you join me?
Speech.実は……今から実家に帰って家元として茶道の道に戻るつもりなのです。ふふ、嘘です。: Actually... I'm going home now to return to tea ceremony as the head of our school. Hehe, just kidding. Since coming to this academy, I've learned to be a little playful, too♪
Speech.私はどちらかといえば洋風の結婚式よりも、白無垢が良いですね。……ですが、確かにド: If I had to choose, I'd prefer a white bridal kimono to a Western-style wedding... But I do want to try wearing a wedding dress, too... This is more of a dilemma than I expected.
Speech.願い事をする日ですか……私の願い事は、スカラに茶道文化が広まる事です。ですが、叶: A day for making wishes... My wish is for tea ceremony culture to spread through Scalar. But wishes need a first step to come true. I must keep sharing it, little by little.
Speech.今日はお化けの仮装をして、お菓子をねだる日だと聞いています。……無理やり強奪……: I've heard today is the day to dress as a ghost and ask for sweets. ...Taking them by force... I almost wish I could be a child for a little while... Huh? You don't take them by force?
Speech.メリークリスマスです。ふふ、こういうお祝い事は楽しみませんとね。ユリアさん達が楽: Merry Christmas. Hehe, we must enjoy celebrations like this. Julia-san and the others are looking forward to it. In fact, so am I.
Speech.私の誕生日を覚えてくださっていたのですか？ふふ、ありがとうございます。思わず、飛: You remembered my birthday? Hehe, thank you. I'm so happy I almost feel like jumping for joy...
Speech.……退屈ではありませんか？|ふふ、静かに待つのもいいですが……こうして会話を楽し: ...Are you bored?|Hehe, waiting quietly is pleasant, but enjoying a conversation like this is part of the pleasure of tea, too.
Speech.……照れてしまいますね。|家族以外の男の方を前にするのは、初めてですから……緊張: ...This is rather embarrassing.|It's my first time sitting before a man outside my family... so I'm a little nervous.
Speech.……どこを見ているのですか？|……あまりジロジロとみられると恥ずかしいので……そ: ...Where are you looking?|...It's embarrassing when you stare so much... so, um, you mustn't look too much, all right?
Speech.紫雲家の跡取りとして、このような破廉恥な格好をするのはいかがなものかと思うのです: As the Shiun family's heir, I do wonder whether I should be wearing such a shameless outfit... Hehe, but the thrill of doing something forbidden makes my heart race.
Speech.知っていますか？ ウサギってとても繁殖能力が高いんです。それと基本草食動物ですが: Did you know? Rabbits reproduce very quickly. And although they're mostly herbivores, apparently they sometimes eat meat, too. Not that I'm making any particular point... Hehehe.
Speech.普段は自分を厳しく律していますが、この服を着ていると、違う自分になれたような気が: I'm usually very strict with myself, but wearing this makes me feel like someone else... It makes me want to be wilder, more uninhibited.
Speech.この服のまま放置されると、色々な意味で昂りそうですね……ふふ、私をこんな姿にして: Being left alone in this outfit might get me worked up in all sorts of ways... Hehe, dressing me like this and then leaving me alone is rather cruel of you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。え？ プレゼントに今日一日この格好でいてほしい？: Happy birthday. Huh? For your present, you'd like me to wear this all day? Hehe, very well. I'll stay by your side and attend to you dressed like this. It feels as though we're doing something forbidden.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。新年からバニー姿でご挨拶することになるとは……紫: Happy New Year. I never imagined I'd offer my New Year's greetings in a bunny outfit... It's terribly embarrassing as a member of the Shiun family, but this feeling of freedom could become rather addictive...
Speech.バレンタインの贈り物です。バニーで渡すようにとアニスさんに言われまして……ふふ、: A Valentine's gift. Anis-san told me to give it to you in a bunny outfit... Hehe, are your eyes fixed on me rather than the chocolates? I'm both pleased and embarrassed.
Speech.お返し、ありがとうございます。バニーに合うお茶菓子はなんでしょうか？ バニー姿で: Thank you for the return gift. What tea sweets would suit a bunny? Preparing tea in a bunny outfit is unheard of... Hehe, but I'd rather like to try it.
Speech.実は私、実家を飛び出してバニーガールとして生きていくことに決めたのです。……ふふ: Actually, I've decided to leave home and live as a bunny girl. ...Hehe, just kidding. But running across the battlefield in this outfit would feel so freeing... I might get rather worked up.
Speech.結婚式ですか。純白のドレスも素敵ですが、いっそこの衣装の上にウェディングベールを: A wedding? A pure white dress would be lovely, but how about simply putting a wedding veil over this outfit? ...I'm joking. Though the thought does stir my heart a little.
Speech.短冊にどんな願いを書いたのか……ですか？ ふふ……ではヒントを。%usernam: What wish did I write on my paper strip...? Hehe... I'll give you a hint. Your name is on it, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. And I suspect everyone on the team may have similar wishes.
Speech.ハッピーハロウィン。仮装ということでこの服をカオスメイデンの皆で着てますが……や: Happy Halloween. Everyone in Chaos Maiden is wearing this as a costume... It really does show a lot of skin. But this breezy feeling... could become rather addictive.
Speech.メリークリスマス。サンタの衣装だと思ってユリアさんから受け取ったら、バニーでした: Merry Christmas. I thought I was accepting a Santa outfit from Julia-san, but it turned out to be a bunny outfit. ...Still, if it will brighten our Christmas, I'll do my utmost to make the most of it.
Speech.私のお誕生日をお祝いしてくださるのですか？ ありがとうございます。……ふふ、こん: You're celebrating my birthday? Thank you. ...Hehe, I never expected to spend my birthday dressed like this, but it will make a lovely memory in its own way.
Speech.誘惑が……|ダメだとわかっているのに、シたくなっちゃいます……！: The temptation...|I know I shouldn't, but I want to do it...!
