Speech.あぁ……ヤりたい……|紫雲家の人間がギャンブルに魅了されるなんて……でも、昂るの: Ahh... I want to do it...|A member of the Shiun family, captivated by gambling... But I can't hold back my excitement...
Speech.飴でも、舐める？演技をするときに、喉は大切だから喉飴は欠かさないようにしてるの。: Want a sweet? My voice is important when I act, so I always keep throat lozenges on hand.
Speech.わたしは元々役者をしてた。自分にない、色んな感情や人を演じるのは楽しい。もしも演: I used to be an actress. It's fun playing people and emotions different from my own. If you'd like to see me act, shall I perform something for you?
Speech.……あんまり自分で決めるのは好きじゃない。演技をするなら、決める事は出来るけどわ: ...I don't really like making my own decisions. I can decide things when I'm acting... but deciding as myself might be harder.
Speech.誕生日なんだね。おめでとう……演技じゃない、素のわたしからのお祝いだよ。: It's your birthday. Happy birthday... That isn't an act. It's from the real me.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。新年になると、皆の楽しい感情を見れて面白い。演技の参考にな: Happy New Year. It's interesting seeing how happy everyone is at New Year's. I can use it as a reference for my acting.
Speech.別にあんたのことが好きだから渡すわけじゃないんだからね！ 義理だから！……素直に: It's not like I'm giving you this because I like you! They're just courtesy chocolates! ...How was my performance as a girl who can't be honest about her feelings?
Speech.あ、ありがとうございます……こんな私に、お礼だなんて……！……気弱な女の子の演技: Oh, th-thank you... A gift in return, for someone like me...! ...That was a timid girl. Thanks for the return gift.
Speech.嘘……演技をするのはある意味嘘と言えるかも？……でも、そうしたら普段から嘘を吐い: Lies... Acting could be called a kind of lie, couldn't it? ...But then, would that mean I'm lying all the time...? Mm, it's difficult.
Speech.ふふ……こんな素敵なドレスを着て、結婚できるなんて幸せ……結婚式で感動してる人の: Hehe... I'm so happy to be getting married in such a lovely dress... That was someone overcome with emotion at her wedding. I'd like to experience it myself someday.
Speech.願い事……わたしだけの感情が、いっぱい見つかりますように。それと、役者として復帰: A wish... To discover lots of feelings that are mine alone. And if I return to acting, to give all kinds of performances...
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ お返しくれないとイタズラしちゃうぞ！ お菓子をよこせー！: Trick or treat! No gift in return, and I'll play a trick on you! Hand over the sweets! ...That was a child at Halloween. So, will you give me some sweets?
Speech.ふぉっふぉっふぉ。さて、クリスマスはいい子にしておったかな？ ……サンタさんの演: Ho, ho, ho. Now then, have you been good this Christmas? ...That was Santa-san. So, would you like a present?
Speech.誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ ……ありがとう。演技をせずにお礼を言いたかったけど: You're celebrating my birthday? ...Thank you. I wanted to thank you without acting... but I didn't know how I should react.
Speech.ぴょん！ ……ぷー！ ぷー！|……喜んでる時のウサギの演技。嬉しい時はこういう感: Hop! ...Puu! Puu!|...That was a happy rabbit. When they're happy, they show it by making cheerful sounds like these.
Speech.んっ……？ くあぁ……|興味を惹かれてない時のウサギの演技。実際に触った時は、こ: Mm...? Yaaawn...|That was a rabbit that isn't interested. When I actually touched one, it reacted like this.
Speech.ぴょん！？ ふーっ！|……怒ってる時のウサギの反応。地面を足で叩いて不機嫌な反応: Hop!? Hfff!|...That's how an angry rabbit reacts. They stamp their feet to show they're upset, so touch me gently.
Speech.この浴衣、胸元結構きつい……でもこれ以上サイズがないって言われて……でもわりと着: This yukata's quite tight around my chest... But they said there wasn't a larger size... Still, it's fairly easy to wear, so it's not bad... Cuilan puts it on me, too. Huh... That's no different from my usual clothes...
Speech.一応この浴衣でもＭＧには乗れるって聞いた。そういう特別製……？ なんだって。あま: I've heard I can pilot an MG in this yukata, too. It's specially made... or something. Though it could come off if I move too much.
Speech.わたしはユリアみたいに何でもすぐ見つける子が羨ましい……%usernameuse: I envy girls like Julia who find things so easily... Do you like people like Julia, %usernameusernameuserna%? ...Actually, don't answer.
Speech.……ぼーっ…… ……今日は…………%usernameusernameuserna: ...Hmm... Today... I might like to go to the hot springs with you, %usernameusernameuserna%...
Speech.誕生日……何かほしいものある？ %usernameusernameuserna%: Your birthday... Is there anything you want? I want to make you smile, %usernameusernameuserna%... But I don't know what would make you smile most... Even though that's what I want, %usernameusernameuserna%.

Speech.……ふんふふ～ん。らーららー……ふんふふ～……あれ？ ここからのメロディなんだっ: ...Hm-hm-hmmm. Laa-la-laa... Hm-hm-hmm... Huh? How did the melody go from here...?

Speech.願い事……うーん、そうだなぁ。もしも叶うなら、私の本当にやりたい事が見つかったら: A wish... Hmm, let's see. If it could come true, I'd be happy to find what I really want to do.

Speech.『歌姫』じゃない私の誕生日をお祝いしてもらえるのは新鮮だな……本当に、学園に来て: Having my birthday celebrated as me, rather than the 'Songstress,' feels so new... Coming to the academy... I'm really glad I got to be just Sienna.

Speech.うぅ……み、見ないでぇ……|い、今顔が真っ赤になっちゃうし……その、恥ずかしいか: Ugh... D-Don't look...|M-My face is going all red... And, um... it's embarrassing...

Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。一度は実家に帰って挨拶回りをしませんとね。これも: Happy New Year. I must go home and make my rounds of greetings. That's part of my duty as someone who will lead others.
Speech.わたくしの故郷でも、バレンタインデーというのは大切な人に贈り物を送る日でした。だ: In my homeland, Valentine's Day was also a day for giving gifts to those dear to us. So, for all you do for me, these chocolates come with my gratitude and affection...

Speech.……何ともいい香りですね。|これが牛丼……確かにこの香り……食欲をそそります。ふ: ...What a wonderful aroma.|So this is a beef bowl... The smell certainly whets the appetite. Hehe, I'm looking forward to trying it.

Speech.見て見て！ チョコレート！ 登山にはつきものらしいわ！ちょっと握ってたけど寒いか: Look, look! Chocolate! Apparently, it's a must for mountain climbing! I was holding it for a bit, but it's cold, so it shouldn't have melted! Here, I'll share!

Speech.……むぎゅう……ちょっと屋内だと熱いかも……でも、こんなに可愛い衣装だから脱ぎた: ...Mmmph... It might be a little hot indoors... But this outfit is so cute, I don't want to take it off...

Speech.すごい……ぜーんぶ雪よ！|これだったら、雪を使ってお城だって作れちゃうかも……！: Wow... It's all snow!|With this much, maybe we could even build a snow castle...!
Speech.……へ、へ……へくちっ！ ずず……|さすがに雪の上だとちょっと寒いのかも……でも: ...Ah, ah... Achoo! Sniff...|It might be a little cold on the snow after all... But I'm having so much fun, I don't want to leave...

Speech.ひゃあああああああ！？ む、虫！？ご、ごめんなさい……虫だけはダメなの……こ、腰: Eeeeek!? A-A bug!? S-Sorry... I just can't deal with bugs... M-My legs gave out... H-Help me...

Speech.私、誰かのために動くのが好きなの。……ただ、ドジをして逆にお世話をかけちゃうこと: I like doing things for other people. ...Though I often mess up and end up needing their help instead...

Speech.ふふ、ちゃんとハロウィンのためのお菓子は準備してきたわ♪ちょっと登山向けのカロリ: Hehe, I made sure to bring sweets for Halloween♪ Though I ended up with mostly high-calorie sweets for mountain climbing...
Speech.もこもこした、この可愛い服だとホワイトクリスマスも外で楽しめて素敵ね♪: In these cute, fluffy clothes, I can enjoy a white Christmas outside, too. How lovely♪
Speech.えっ、私の誕生日のお祝い……？ 本当に良いのかしら？ふふ、ありがとうね。ふたりで: Huh, you're celebrating my birthday...? Is that really okay? Hehe, thank you. Shall we have a grand celebration, just the two of us♪

Speech.誕生日おめでとう……この程度なら、覚えてるわ。: Happy birthday... I can remember at least that much.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。……何？ 新年でもやることは変わらないから。: Happy New Year. ...What? New Year's doesn't change what I have to do.
Speech.チョコ、あげる。お世話になってるから。ちゃんとカカオ99％。糖質が低いのを選んだ: Here, chocolate. For your help. It's 99% cacao. I made sure to choose something low in sugar.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？……あ、ありがと。: A White Day gift? ...Oh, thank you.
Speech.嘘なんてつく暇はないから。……騙したら怒るから。: I don't have time to tell lies. ...And I'll get angry if you try to fool me.

Speech.クリスマスのお祝い……？ これからトレーニングなんだけど。……なに、その寂しそう: Celebrating Christmas...? I'm about to train. ...Why are you looking at me like I'm lonely?
Speech.誕生日のお祝い……？ ……ありがと。……まあ、祝ってくれるのは嬉しいかも。: You're celebrating my birthday...? ...Thank you. ...Well, I might be happy about it.
Speech.この体操服を着てると、陸上で現役だった時を思い出すわ。……あんまり悲しい顔をしな: Wearing this gym uniform reminds me of when I was still competing in track. ...Don't look so sad. The past is the past... I'm enjoying the present, too.
Speech.……こうして団体競技をすることは少なかったから……少しだけ、楽しいわ。自分が今ま: ...I haven't done much team competition like this... so it's a little fun. I can put all the knowledge I've built up to use, too.

Speech.……誕生日を祝ってくれるの？ ふふ、ありがとう。折角の誕生日だし、ウォーキングく: ...You're celebrating my birthday? Hehe, thank you. Since it's my birthday, and I can manage a walk... shall we walk together?
Speech.……うん、腫れは引いてきたわね。|無理はしちゃダメよ。あとは痛みがなくなるまで安: ...Yes, the swelling's going down.|Don't push yourself. Rest until it stops hurting, all right?

Speech.……大丈夫？ 痛くはないかしら？|私も何度も経験したから怪我が辛いのは分かるわ…: ...Are you okay? Does it hurt?|I've been injured many times, too, so I know how hard it is... Make sure you tell me.
Speech.さーて、今日はどこを食べ歩きしようかなー。もう、この周辺のお店は全部食べちゃった: Now then, where should I go on my food crawl today? I've already tried every shop around here.
Speech.この学校に来た理由はね、好きなだけ暴れられるから！乗ってる間は、敵をどれだけ壊し: I came to this school because I can go wild as much as I like! While I'm piloting, I can smash all the enemies I want! ...Though I sometimes scare people.
Speech.うー、暴れ足りないよー！……ちょっとくらい何か壊してもいいかな？ ……やっぱりダ: Ugh, I haven't gone wild enough yet! ...Could I break just a little something? ...No, I guess I can't.
Speech.……退屈だなぁ。早く戻ってこないかなぁ……待ちくたびれちゃうなぁ……: ...I'm bored. I hope you come back soon... I'm getting tired of waiting...
Speech.聞いたよ！ 誕生日なんだよね！ お祝いに、一緒に遊びに行こ♪どこでもついていくよ: I heard! It's your birthday, right? Let's go out and have fun to celebrate♪ I'll follow you anywhere! Even into the Maze!
Speech.あけましておめでとう！なんだか新しい年ってだけでワクワクしちゃうね♪: Happy New Year! Just knowing it's a new year gets me excited♪
Speech.バレンタインデー？ 知ってる、チョコがもらえる日だよね！もしかして、くれるの！？: Valentine's Day? I know! That's the day you get chocolates! Are you giving me some!? I can't wait...!
Speech.ホワイトデーだって！ お菓子をくれる日なんだよね！……お返しを貰う日？ うう、あ: It's White Day! That's the day you get sweets, right! ...A day for return gifts? Ugh, I didn't give you anything...
Speech.実は私、乱暴な事って大嫌いなんだよね……なーんて、エイプリルフールだよ♪ ……あ: I actually hate being violent... Just kidding! April Fools♪ ...Huh? That's not funny?
Speech.結婚式かぁ。ああいうお嫁さんもいいんだけど……あのヒラヒラとした服、ビリビリに破: A wedding... Being a bride like that looks nice... but I'm scared I might tear that fluttery outfit to shreds...
Speech.願い事？ もう叶ってるんだ♪あ、でも……もっといっぱい、君と一緒に暴れたいかも！: A wish? Mine's already come true♪ Oh, but... I might want to go wild with you lots more!
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ イタズラかお菓子か選んでね？私の希望は……どっちでしょう: Trick or treat! Pick a trick or sweets, okay? Which one do you think I'm hoping for♪
Speech.メリークリスマス！ 今日はご馳走を食べてケーキを食べるんだ♪後片付けでツリーを壊: Merry Christmas! Today, I'm eating a feast and cake♪ I'm looking forward to smashing the tree when we clean up, too! ...Huh? We don't smash it?
Speech.えっ、誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの！？わーい！ それじゃあ、お腹いっぱいになるまで: What, you're celebrating my birthday!? Yaaay! Then let's go on a food crawl together until we're stuffed♪
Speech.体育祭ではパン食い競争にも参加するんだ！ 優勝には関係ない競技だけど、 絶対に一: I'm doing the bread-eating race at the sports festival, too! It doesn't count toward the overall championship, but I'm definitely coming first! If I lead the race, I get the tastiest-looking bread!
Speech.優勝かぁ……今まで関係ない話だって思ってたから、 本当に優勝を目指すんだーってな: Winning... I used to think that had nothing to do with me. Now that we're really aiming for it... it feels strange. Maybe I'm excited.
Speech.このハチマキ可愛いでしょ？ こう、ぎゅって頭に巻いたら不思議とやるぞー！ って元: This headband's cute, right? Wrap it tight around your head, and somehow it makes you feel ready to go! Want a matching one, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Speech.この服を着てると動き出したくなってソワソワしちゃうなぁ…… よーし、ちょっと走っ: Wearing these clothes makes me restless. I want to get moving... Okay! I'm going for a little run!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ えへへ、お祝いに何かしてほしい事ある？ 折角なら、背負って: Happy birthday! Hehe, anything you'd like me to do for you? How about I carry you on my back wherever you want to go? ...Would that be embarrassing?
Speech.あけましておめでとー！ 折角の新年だから、日の出に向かって一緒に走ろ！: Happy New Year! Since it's a new year, let's run toward the sunrise together!
Speech.えへへ、バレンタインデーだね！ チョコレートは運動の後にもいいんだよ！ だから、: Hehe, it's Valentine's Day! Chocolate's good after exercise, too! So, here, have one♪
Speech.わ、ホワイトデーのお返しをくれるの！？ ありがと！ えへへ、嬉しいな！ 運動後に: Wow, you're giving me a White Day gift!? Thanks! Hehe, I'm so happy! I'll eat it after exercise!
Speech.実は私、走るのが嫌いなんだよねぇ……なーんて、嘘だよ♪ ……え？ 全然騙されない: I actually hate running... Just kidding♪ ...Huh? You didn't believe it at all? Guess that one didn't work...
Speech.こうやってみると、結婚式をするのは楽しそうだけど準備が大変そうだよね。 体操服み: Looking at it this way, a wedding seems fun, but getting everything ready looks hard. I wish there were a dress as easy to put on and wear as a gym uniform. Is there one?
Speech.七夕にお願いしたのは、プレクラス-Ａの皆と、ずっと一緒にいれますように！ 前より: My Tanabata wish was to stay with everyone in Pre-Class A forever! They're so, so much more important to me than before♪
Speech.ハッピーハロウィン！ ……体操服のままだと、お菓子を貰えないかな？ うーんうーん: Happy Halloween! ...Will I still get sweets in my gym uniform? Hmm, hmm... What should I say to ask for some?
Speech.メリークリスマス！ ……え？ 寒くないのかって？ ……ちょっと寒いかも……でも走: Merry Christmas! ...Huh? Am I cold? ...Maybe a little... But running should warm me up, so I'm going for a run!
Speech.えっ、誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの？ えへへ、ありがと！ プレゼントのおねだりじゃ: Huh, you're celebrating my birthday? Hehe, thanks! I'm not asking for a present, but... will you help me pick out new shoes?
Speech.はぁ、はぁ……よし、順調……|ここを超えればゴール……みんなのために頑張るよ……: Haah, haah... Good, it's going well...|Once I'm past here, it's the finish line... I'll do my best for everyone...!
Speech.ぐむむ！ 邪魔だけど……が、がまん……！|うう、こんな網に拘束されて……全部めち: Grrr! It's in the way, but... h-hold back...!|Ugh, trapped in this net... I just want to rip everything to pieces...!
Speech.あ、皆だ。おーい！ って、あわわ！|うっかり絡まっちゃう所だった……！ あぶない: Oh, it's everyone. Heeey! Wait, whoa!|I nearly got myself tangled up...! That was close, that was close...!
Speech.さてと、そろそろ来月からの料理計画を練らないとな……あたしが栄養バランスから管理: Right, time to work out the meal plan for next month... I manage everything down to the nutritional balance, so I make sure to plan it properly.
Speech.あたしとお嬢は小さい頃からの付き合いでな……まあ、色々とあったんだよ。お嬢はあた: My lady and I go back to when we were kids... Well, a lot happened. She's like a little sister to me... She's precious to me.
Speech.あたしの口調？ ……まあ、あんまりいい育ちじゃないんだよ。畏まった場じゃないなら: The way I talk? ...Well, I didn't have the best upbringing. If it's not a formal occasion, I talk like I usually do. I mind my manners when it counts.
Speech.……暇だな。そうだなぁ……久々にカービングでもするか？石鹸とか蝋燭はあったよな…: ...I'm bored. Let's see... Maybe I'll do some carving for the first time in a while? There was soap and some candles... What pattern should I use? Flowers might be nice.
Speech.あんた誕生日なんだって？ そういうお祝い事はちゃんとしないとな。プレゼントは準備: I hear it's your birthday. You should celebrate things like that properly. I haven't got a present ready... so I'll take care of you for the day.
Speech.あけましておめでとう……あたしはお嬢と一緒に挨拶周りだ。大変そうだけど、これも貴: Happy New Year... I'm making the rounds of greetings with my lady. Looks like hard work, but that's part of a noble's duty. I've got to support her properly.
Speech.ほら、チョコレート。まあ、普段から世話になってるしな。そんなに手が込んだものじゃ: Here, chocolates. You do a lot for me, after all. They're nothing fancy... but eat them when you're hungry.
Speech.これはホワイトデーのお返しか？そんなに気を遣わせるつもりじゃなかったんだけど……: A White Day gift? I didn't mean to make you go to so much trouble... Thanks. I'll take it.
Speech.あら、旦那様。どうされました？ 私は普段通りですけども。……あー、堅苦しい。お嬢: Oh, Master. How may I help you? I'm behaving as I always do. ...Ugh, that's stiff. Call it a lie for April Fools—I'm imitating myself being a proper maid at my lady's side.
Speech.へぇ、ウェディングドレスか。お嬢が着たらさぞかし似合うんだろうな。……あたし？: Oh, a wedding dress. It'd look wonderful on my lady. ...Me? It wouldn't suit me, so never mind... Don't go imagining it.
Speech.願い事か……お嬢のためにこれからも働けるようにかな。まあ、願うだけじゃなくて自分: A wish... To keep working for my lady, I guess. Though I plan to make that happen myself, not just wish for it.
Speech.さーて、ミリアム達がどうせお菓子をねだってくるだろうし……ちゃんと渡すための準備: Right, Miriam and the others are bound to come asking for sweets... I'd better have some ready for them.
Speech.メリークリスマス。それじゃ、折角だから手伝ってくれないか？お嬢が開催するんだから: Merry Christmas. Since you're here, could you give me a hand? My lady's hosting, so we've got to make it a party that'll impress anyone.
Speech.ん？ ……あたしの誕生日？ 祝ってくれるのか？……いや、なんだ、その……お嬢たち: Hm? ...My birthday? You're celebrating it? ...Well, um... It's my first time being celebrated by anyone besides my lady and the others... It's embarrassing.
Speech.ん？ 待ちきれないか？|ちゃんと蒸らさないとダメだからお預けだ。まあ、その価値は: Hm? Can't wait?|The tea needs to steep properly, so you'll have to. I'll serve you a tea that's worth the wait.
Speech.……うん、言い香りだな。|茶葉の管理も大切だからな……これだけ質がいいなら、美味: ...Yes, that's a good aroma.|Looking after the tea leaves matters, too... With quality like this, it'll make a lovely cup of tea.
Speech.っ……あんたなぁ……！|はぁ……まあ、悪戯に目くじら立てるのも大人げないか……大: Hey... You...!|Haa... Well, getting worked up over a prank wouldn't be very grown-up of me... Just wait quietly.
Speech.……アークトゥルスだとか、融和だとか言ってるが……あたしには、迷惑な話だ。ただ、: ...All this talk of Arcturus and harmony... It's a pain for me. Is just wanting to stay my lady's maid... such a selfish wish?
Speech.昔は本当に荒れてたんだよ。まあ、お嬢に出会って変わったわけなんだが……一歩間違え: I was really wild back then. Meeting my lady changed that... One wrong turn, and my life... could've ended up pretty miserable.
Speech.こうやって、こんな衣装に身を包んでると考えちまうんだよ。 ……いつか、あたしもメ: Wearing something like this gets me thinking... Will the day come when I stop being a maid? Not like me to think that way, I know.
Speech.あー、くそ。メイド服じゃないのは落ち着かないな……もうずっと、あっちの方を着続け: Ah, damn it. I can't settle down without my maid uniform... I've worn it for so long... Ugh, this just feels wrong...!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。あんたが生まれた日だって聞いてたから、お嬢に許可を取って、今日: Happy birthday. I heard it was the day you were born, so I got my lady's permission to come be your personal maid for today. So, your orders?
Speech.あけましておめでとう……なんだ、せっかくの新年なんだ。メイド服じゃなくて、こうい: Happy New Year... Well, it's a fresh year. Wearing something different instead of my maid uniform makes a nice change.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%、ほら。チョコレート。……あんた: %usernameusernameuserna%, here. Chocolates. ...You've helped me with all sorts of things... So, well, this is my thanks.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し？ 本当に律儀だな……ふふ。でも、こうやってくれる気持ちが嬉: A White Day gift? You're really thoughtful... Hehe. Still, it's the thought behind it that makes me happy. Thanks.
Speech.ああ？ なんだ、テメエ！ あたしはもうメイドでも何でもねえんだよ！……って、まあ: Huh!? What do you want, you bastard!? I'm not a maid or anything anymore! ...Well, it's April Fools' Day... Don't take it so seriously. It hurts a little...
Speech.ジューンブライドか……結婚なぁ。ずっとお嬢のメイドとして付き従う事を考えてたけど: June brides... Marriage, huh. I've always thought I'd stay at my lady's side as her maid, but maybe marrying someone someday wouldn't be so bad...
Speech.願い事は決まってんだ。お嬢にミリアムにハリエットにケイトに……それに、あんた。あ: I know what I'm wishing for. My lady, Miriam, Harriette, Kate... and you. Happiness for everyone who worked so hard for me.
Speech.……はぁ、成長したと思ってたんだがなぁ……ミリアム達、相変わらずお菓子を強奪して: ...Haa, I thought they'd grown up... But Miriam and the others were still delighted to steal the sweets... Honestly, they're a handful. They really are.
Speech.メリークリスマス。なんだ、３人とお嬢とあたしでプレゼント交換をしてな……その時に: Merry Christmas. The three girls, my lady and I exchanged presents... and I accidentally bought too many... So here's some for you, too. Take it.
Speech.……あたしの誕生日なんて、よく覚えてたな。嬉しいけど……ああ、やっぱダメだ！ お: ...You remembered my birthday. I'm happy, but... Ah, no, I can't! Nobody besides my lady and the others has celebrated me like this. It's embarrassing!
Speech.……あー、息が詰まる。|メイド服と違って着慣れてないからな……着替えたくなってき: ...Ugh, I feel stifled.|I'm not used to this like I am my maid uniform... I'm starting to want to change.
Speech.なんだ？ あたしに合ってる？|まあ、昔は男と勘違いされるくらいにヤンチャな子供だ: What? It suits me?|Well, I was such a rowdy kid, people used to mistake me for a boy...
Speech.んん……はぁ、疲れたな。|見られたのがあんたで良かったよ。ミリアムとかだと、大騒: Mmm... Haa, I'm tired.|I'm glad it was you who saw me. If it had been Miriam or someone, there'd have been a huge fuss.
Speech.ヒーローが好きなんだけど、子供の頃に見た、『超機神ジャスティオン』ってヒーローが: I love heroes, especially 'Super Machine God Justion,' which I watched as a kid. My dream is to become a hero like Justion someday!
Speech.ん？ リリーに弱点？ ヒーローには弱点なんてないよ！ ……って言いたいんだけど、: Hm? Lily's weakness? Heroes don't have weaknesses! ...That's what I'd like to say, but I can't stand shellfish... A hero shouldn't be picky, but I really can't eat them...
Speech.今度一緒に街で探検しにいかない？ パルクールを練習してるから、一緒に駆け回りたい: Want to explore the city together sometime? I'm practicing parkour, so I'd like to run around with you! Across rooftops, through streets full of obstacles... Too dangerous? ...Fair point!
Speech.うーん、そろそろパトロールの時間だから行かないと……でも%usernameuse: Hmm, it's nearly time for patrol, so I have to go... But what if %usernameusernameuserna% comes back...? Ugh, what do I do~!?
Speech.お誕生日！？ うわわ、どうしよう！ 何の準備もしてない！えーっと、お祝いに……ヒ: It's your birthday!? Whoa, what do I do! I haven't prepared anything! Um, to celebrate... Not as a hero, but just as Lily... could I stay with you...?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ 新年だからこそ、気を引き締めないとね！……とはいえ、ちょ: Happy New Year! A new year means it's time to stay sharp! ...Though maybe I could take a little break to watch a hero movie?
Speech.バレンタインデーはチョコレート絡みでトラブルが起きるから、リリーが取り締まりをす: Valentine's Day means trouble over chocolate, so Lily's going to keep things under control! ...Um, if you'd like chocolates from Lily... after my Disciplinary Committee work, okay?
Speech.えっ、リリーにバレンタインデーのお返しをくれるの！？……うう、受け取るべきか……: What, a gift in return for Lily's Valentine's chocolates!? ...Ugh, should I take it...? Or is it a bribe, so I shouldn't...? I'll take it! Thank you!
Speech.嘘はダメだよ！ 嘘は悲しい思いしか生まれないからね……エイプリルフールに、ジャス: No lies! Lies only make people sad... That's what Lily decided after an April Fools' announcement of a new Justion series fooled me...!
Speech.ジューンブライドかぁ……お嫁さんのドレス姿って素敵だよね。まあリリーはヒーローだ: June brides... A bride in a wedding dress looks wonderful. But Lily's a hero, so weddings are a long way off! ...Still, I might like to wear one just once.
Speech.願い事かぁ……変形合体するＭＧがいつか開発されて乗れますように……！ヒーローアニ: A wish... For a transforming, combining MG to be developed someday, so I can pilot it...! I've dreamed about it a little ever since I saw one in a hero anime...
Speech.ハロウィンだね！ 正義のヒーローはお菓子を強奪する悪い子は見逃さないよ！捕まえた: It's Halloween! A hero of justice won't overlook naughty children stealing sweets! When I catch them, I'll tell them not to play tricks, then give sweets to the good children who listen!
Speech.クリスマスはちょっと憂鬱なんだよね。だって、色んなヒーローのオモチャが出てくる時: Christmas is a little depressing. It's when all sorts of hero toys come out... My wallet gets so light...
Speech.えっリリーの誕生日をお祝いしてくれるの！？ ……えへへ、嬉しいな！ ありがとう！: What, you're celebrating Lily's birthday!? ...Hehe, I'm so happy! Thank you! Um, I'd like a present... Would you watch hero movies with me?
Speech.……あれ？ 何を見てるの？|やっぱり汗をかいて健康的な体作りは大切だからね。あな: ...Huh? What are you looking at?|Working up a sweat and building a healthy body matters. Want to join me?
Speech.……ふぅ、ちょっと休憩。|ヒーローは一日にしてならずだから……大変でもちゃんとト: ...Phew, a little break.|A hero isn't made in a day... So even when it's hard, I've got to keep training!
Speech.……ど、どこ見てるの！？|は、恥ずかしいなぁ……リリーのこんなところ見ても、別に: ...W-Where are you looking!?|Th-This is embarrassing... Looking at Lily there isn't any fun, is it...?
Speech.ヒーロースーツ以外の服を着るのも結構久しぶりだから、ちょっと恥ずかしいんだよね…: It's been a while since I wore anything but my hero suit, so I'm a little embarrassed... Partner, does it suit me? ...It does? Hehe... I'm glad...
Speech.ヒーローとしての想いって、歌だけでも伝えれるんだね。それが分かっただけでも、今回: You can get your feelings as a hero across just by singing, too. Realizing that alone makes me glad I took part in this concert.
Speech.……うーん、なんとかして普段のスーツにヒーローガジェットで、カラオケ機能を組み込: ...Hmm, could I use a hero gadget to put a karaoke function in my usual suit...? I want to make an entrance with my theme song playing...
Speech.うーん、何を歌おっかな……ライブの曲もいいんだけど、ジャスティオンメドレーも歌い: Hmm, what should I sing...? The concert songs are nice, but I want to sing a Justion medley, too... Maybe I'll just sing everything!
Speech.誕生日おめでとう！ うーんうーん……せっかくの誕生日なら、シエナ達を呼んで、皆で: Happy birthday! Hmm, hmm... Since it's your birthday, maybe I should call Sienna and the others over so we can all sing for you? Yep, let's do that!
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ ヒーローとしての挨拶！そしてライブのボーカルとしての挨拶: Happy New Year! A greeting from a hero! And a greeting from the concert vocalist! Twice as much for you!
Speech.……びっくりしちゃった。リリーにってチョコレートがたくさん送られてきて……ね、ね: ...That surprised me. So many chocolates were sent to Lily... H-Hey, I can't possibly eat them all. Will you help me?
Speech.うう……ホワイトデーのお返しが大変だよぉ……誰かに手伝ってほしい……でも、リリー: Ugh... Getting all the White Day return gifts ready is hard... I wish someone would help... But they were sent to Lily, so Lily has to give something back properly...!
Speech.今のリリーは歌って踊れるアイドルヒーローになったんだよ！なんちゃって……え？ あ: Lily's become an idol hero who can sing and dance! Just kidding... Huh? Wait, what's that device...? A video? D-Delete it!?
Speech.こういう結婚とかの時に、お祝いの歌ってあるけど……今ならリリーも歌えるかな？えへ: There are celebration songs for weddings and things... Could Lily sing those now, too? Hehe, if someone I'm close to gets married, I'll give them the best song!
Speech.お願いかぁ……うーん、また皆と一緒にライブで演奏をして、色んな人と一緒に凄い盛り: A wish... Hmm, I'd like to perform live with everyone again and get a huge crowd all excited together... But I'd rather make it happen myself than just wish for it!
Speech.ヒーローはお休み！ 今日は仮装をして楽しんでる子たちのために、ハロウィンで盛り上: The hero's taking a break! Today, I'm going to sing some lively Halloween songs for the children having fun in costume! Walking through town singing together sounds fun, too♪
Speech.ふっふっふ、クリスマスソングならリリーにお任せ！ 今日はリクエスト通りに歌うよ！: Heh heh heh, leave Christmas songs to Lily! I'll take your requests today! ...That's what I'd like to say, but Disciplinary Committee patrol comes first... There's no time to sing...
Speech.えっ、誕生日のお祝い！？ そんな、いいの！？……それなら、一緒にデュエットしてほ: What, you're celebrating my birthday!? Is that really okay!? ...Then I'd like to sing a duet with you! Let's do a karaoke medley!
Speech.はぁ、歌って楽しいね！|今どきはヒーローも歌って演奏出来るから、リリーもアップデ: Ahh, singing is fun!|Heroes these days can sing and play instruments, too, so Lily's getting an upgrade!
Speech.……えへへ、かっこよかった？|ファンサービスってやつだよ！ レイラから教わったん: ...Hehe, was I cool?|That's what they call fan service! Layla taught me!
Speech.はぁ、うーん！ スッキリしたー！|どのくらい歌ったかな？ うーん、でもまだまだ歌: Ahh, mmm! That feels refreshing!|How long have I been singing? Hmm, but I might be able to sing lots more!
Speech.生徒会――いえ、生徒会長を支えて、学園の秩序を維持すること……これは風紀委員会の: Supporting the Student Council—no, the Student Council President—and maintaining order at the academy... That is the Disciplinary Committee's role, and my own guiding principle.
Speech.幼い頃は身体が弱くて、そのときからある健康法を続けているんです。元は武術だったの: I was frail as a child, and I've kept up a certain health exercise ever since. It began as a martial art, adapted into exercises for health... Would you care to join me?
Speech.リリーさんは頑張り屋さんで正義感が強く、風紀委員会に入っただけあって優秀な子です: Lily-san is hardworking, with a strong sense of justice. She's a capable girl, just as you'd expect of someone in the Disciplinary Committee. Though she's so energetic, she can be a little reckless. I hope she doesn't get hurt...
Speech.あの……%usernameusernameuserna%さん？ 寝ているのでしょ: Um... %usernameusernameuserna%-san? Are you asleep? Then I suppose I should leave you be... Hehe. Rest well.
Speech.ふふ、誕生日おめでとうございます。誕生日がいつかの記憶が残っていてよかったです。: Hehe, happy birthday. I'm glad you still remember when your birthday is. It means I can celebrate it with you today.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。まさかこうして%usernameusername: Happy New Year. Back when I lived at home, I never imagined I'd welcome a new year with %usernameusernameuserna%-san... with a gentleman.
Speech.どうぞ、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。バレンタインチョコ: Here you are, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. Your Valentine's chocolate. ...Hehe, don't worry. I haven't put anything strange in it. Though there is something else in there... something you can't see.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返しですか？ そんな律儀に返さなくても……ふふ、でもいただきます: A White Day gift in return? You really needn't have gone to the trouble... Hehe, but I'll gladly accept it. This is a first for me, so I'm rather happy.
Speech.嘘をついてもいい日ですか……でもこういう日こそ、正直でいたくありませんか？なので: A day when we're allowed to lie... But doesn't that make you want to be honest all the more? So... "%usernameusernameuserna%-san, I love you." ...Hehe. Was that a lie, or the truth?
Speech.ジューンブライド……ですか。え？ わたくしのウェディングドレス姿を見てみたい……: A June bride...? Pardon? You'd like to see me in a wedding dress? Then... would you be the one to put it on me, %usernameusernameuserna%-san? Hehe, only joking.
Speech.貴方は叶えたい願いはありますか？ わたくしはそうですね……今の夕闇のような立ち位: Is there a wish you'd like to come true? As for me... perhaps I'd like to find my way out of this twilight I seem to be standing in. ...Hm? Too abstract? Hehe, wishes tend to be that way.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート……？ あら、わたくしにイタズラをしたいのですか？ふふ、: Trick or treat...? Oh my, you want to play a trick on me? Hehe, I don't mind. Provided you've thought through what comes afterward...
Speech.大型の年間イベントとなると、あちこちで浮かれた生徒達を取り締まらないといけないの: Whenever a major annual event comes around, I have to keep overexcited students in line all over the place. It leaves me precious little time to enjoy Christmas myself.
Speech.まさか貴方に誕生日を祝っていただけるなんて……実家にいた頃は、そういう経験皆無だ: I never expected you to celebrate my birthday... Nothing like this ever happened back home. I'll hold your "Happy birthday" close to my heart, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Speech.あら？ そうなんですか？|でもそろそろお話も終わりにしましょう？ 他の人に見られ: Oh? Is that so?|But shouldn't we wrap up our little chat? Someone might see us.
Speech.ふふふ……まったく、もう。|もっとわたくしと戯れていたいのですか？ こちらもヒマ: Hehehe... Honestly, you.|Would you like to keep playing with me? I do have things to do, you know...
Speech.あれは……お仲間かしら？|貴方もあの子達と一緒に、群れのボスのもとへ帰ったほうが: Are those... your companions?|I think you should join them and return to the leader of your pack.
Speech.こっちの世界に来てから、なんだか嘘みたいに平和な時間を過ごしてるなぁ……このまま: Ever since I came to this world, life's been so peaceful it almost doesn't feel real... Maybe I could just stay here and take it easy... Just kidding!
Speech.むむむ……こっちだとタケルちゃん、自分で起きちゃうからわたしが起こせない……毎朝: Hmmm... Takeru-chan wakes up on his own here, so I don't get to wake him... That's supposed to be my job every morning! Takeru-chan really ought to sleep in more!
Speech.めるちゃんとはすっかり仲良しになったんだよ！今度は女子会を開いて、お菓子を持ち寄: Meru-chan and I have become really good friends! We're planning a girls' get-together soon. We'll all bring treats and chat over tea♪
Speech.……むむむ、ヒマだなぁ。タケルちゃんは今何してるんだろ？おーい！タケルちゃーん！: ...Hmm, I'm bored. What's Takeru-chan doing right now? Heeey! Takeru-chaaaan! Taaakeruuu-chaaaan!! Where are youuu?!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ お世話になってるから、お祝いをしてあげないとね！たくさんご: Happy birthday! You've done so much for us, so of course we have to celebrate! I'll make lots of yummy food, so look forward to it!
Speech.あけましておめでと！ ふっふっふ、めるちゃんとおせちを作ったんだ！みんなを呼んで: Happy New Year! Hehehe, Meru-chan and I made osechi! Let's invite everyone over. It's New Year's, so let's relax and enjoy the food!
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーだね！ みんなとチョコレートを作ってるんだ。いっぱい作った: It's Valentine's Day! I'm making chocolates with everyone. We made lots... but of course, my special romantic chocolate is for Takeru-chan♪
Speech.えへへ、ホワイトデーのお返しをタケルちゃんから貰えるなんてびっくり！……これは大: Ehehe, I never thought I'd get a White Day gift from Takeru-chan! ...I'll have to savor every bite♪
Speech.エイプリルフールかぁ……うーん、何を言ってみようかな……タケルちゃんにはいっつも: April Fools' Day, huh... Hmm, what should I say...? Takeru-chan always fools me, but this time I'm definitely going to get him...!
Speech.わぁ……この世界でもジューンブライドがあるんだね！……いつか、あんな風にウエディ: Wow... They have June brides in this world too! ...Someday, I'd love to wear a wedding dress like that and have a wedding of my own.
Speech.こっちの世界にも七夕ってあるんだね。何をお願いしたの？わたしはね、タケルちゃんが: They have Tanabata here too, huh? What did you wish for? I wished for Takeru-chan to be happy forever!
Speech.トリックオアトリート！ ふっふっふ、お菓子をよこさないとイタズラしちゃうぞ～！…: Trick or treat! Hehehe, hand over the candy or I'll play a trick on you~! ...Ugh, now that I think about it, was that a little childish...?
Speech.元の世界では、毎年クリスマスにタケルちゃんとお祝いをしてた気がするんだ。だから、: I feel like Takeru-chan and I celebrated Christmas together every year back in our world. So this year, we're going to eat cake together while we wait for Santa♪
Speech.わっ、お誕生日のお祝い……！？ありがとう！ えへへ、こんな風にお祝いされて嬉しい: Wow, you're celebrating my birthday...?! Thank you! Ehehe, it makes me so happy to have you celebrate like this♪
Speech.……どうしたの？ 変なタケルちゃん♪|こんな風にお買い物出来て幸せだね……これか: ...What's wrong? You're being silly, Takeru-chan♪|It's so nice to go shopping together like this... Let's do it lots more, okay?♪
Speech.うわぁ！？ ……タケルちゃんのえっち……|……タケルちゃんって、変なタイミングで: Wah?! ...Takeru-chan, you pervert...|...You always pick the strangest times to tease me, Takeru-chan! Don't do anything funny!
Speech.……うーん……結構いいかも♪|うっ、でもお値段がちょっとしちゃうかも……やっぱり: ...Hmm... This might be pretty nice♪|Ooh, but it's a little pricey... I'd better think about it some more...
Speech.……確かに平和な世界ではあるが、メイズという戦場もある。勘を鈍らせて帰るわけには: ...This is certainly a peaceful world, but the Maze is still a battlefield. I cannot return with my instincts dulled... I must keep up my basic training.
Speech.たとえ記憶がなくなっても剣技や戦術機の操縦は忘れぬものなのだな……体が覚えている: ...Even without our memories, we haven't forgotten our swordsmanship or how to pilot a Tactical Surface Fighter. The skills our bodies remember remind us that we are soldiers.
Speech.こちらの世界でも見所のあるものが何人もいるのだな。かつて行ったスカラ校舎もそうだ: There are quite a few promising people in this world as well. I saw that at the Scalar School Building, and there seem to be others who would make worthy opponents... I would like to cross swords with them someday.
Speech.……ふぅ、こうして空いた時間に瞑想もよいものだ。最近は想像も出来ないような事ばか: ...Whew. It is good to meditate when I have a moment to spare. So much has happened lately that I could never have imagined...
Speech.誕生日おめでとう……どこの世界でも生まれた日を祝う気持ちは同じなのだな。ふふ、私: Happy birthday... No matter the world, the wish to celebrate someone's birth is the same. Hehe, I shall find you a gift as a small token of my good wishes.
Speech.謹んで新年のお慶びを申し上げる……少し硬い言い回しであったか？だが、一年の計は元: I respectfully offer you my best wishes for the New Year... Was that a little too stiff? Still, the first day sets the course of the year. Proper manners are the way to begin it well.
Speech.今日はバレンタインデーというものらしいな……私も鑑に誘われて、チョコレートを作っ: Today is apparently Valentine's Day... Kagami invited me to make chocolate with her... I wonder if Takeru will like it.
Speech.ホワイトデー……？ というものでタケルから貰ったお返しだが……ふふ。普通の焼き菓: White Day...? This is Takeru's gift in return, as I understand it... Hehe. Even ordinary baked sweets seem too precious to eat when I think of who gave them to me.
Speech.今日は嘘をついていい日とはいうが……やはり私には馴染まんな。とはいえ、そなたが望: They say we may tell lies today... But I cannot quite get used to the idea. Still, if you wish to, you may say whatever you like.
Speech.結婚か……ふむ、私には縁の遠い話だと思っていたが……この平和な世界で白無垢を着て: Marriage... Hmm. I had thought it a distant prospect for me... But perhaps, in this peaceful world, it would be nice to wear a shiromuku...
Speech.七夕か……願いを書くのであれば、そうだな。元の世界に戻れるように……いや、それよ: Tanabata... Let me see, if I were to write a wish... To return to our own world... No, perhaps I should wish for our memories to return first? Hmm, a difficult choice.
Speech.仮装をしている生徒たちが楽しそうにしている様子を見たが……珍しい光景だったな。ハ: I saw students enjoying themselves in costume... It was an unusual sight. Halloween, was it? I brought a box of sweets, but they turned it down...
Speech.鑑たちが計画をしていたパーティーに誘われたのだが……どの様な格好をしていけばよい: Kagami and the others invited me to the party they were planning... What should I wear...? Hm? What I have on will do?
Speech.誕生日を祝ってくれて感謝する。ふふ、タケルと私は誕生日が同じ日でな。折角だ。タケ: Thank you for celebrating my birthday. Hehe, Takeru and I share a birthday. Since we have the chance, let us bring him along and celebrate together.
Speech.ああ……今日はタケルに任せるぞ？|こうして、タケルに手を引かれて歩くというのは…: Yes... I'll leave things to you today, Takeru.|Walking with Takeru leading me by the hand like this... It makes my heart dance.
Speech.少し恥ずかしいぞ……|だが、こうしてタケルに撫でられるというのは悪くない気分だ…: This is a little embarrassing...|But being stroked by Takeru like this does feel rather nice...
Speech.……ふふ、良い風だな。|こうして吹く風は私の覚えている世界と変わらないのだな。: ...Hehe, a pleasant breeze.|The wind feels just the same as it did in the world I remember.
Speech.……こっちの世界だと、可愛いものがいっぱいありますし……猫ちゃんもいっぱいいて…: ...There are so many cute things in this world... and so many kitties... Sometimes my heart skips a beat, and I wonder if I've ended up in heaven.
Speech.こっちでも、毎日の基礎訓練をしちゃうんですよね。メイズ探索もありますし……やっぱ: I still do my basic training every day here. We have the Maze to explore, too... I'm worried my instincts will get dull, so I just can't help keeping active.
Speech.こっちの世界でも、お友達を増やしたいなーって思うんですけどなかなか増えなくて……: I'd like to make more friends in this world, but it's not going very well... I love kitties, so it'd be nice to meet some people who love them too...
Speech.……ふわぁ……ひとりになっちゃうと……んん……眠くなっちゃいます……ぐう……はっ: ...Yaaawn... When I'm all alone... mmm... I get so sleepy... Zzz... Huh?! I-I wasn't sleeping!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます！こういうおめでたいことは、皆で共有しないといけませ: Happy birthday! Something this happy deserves to be celebrated with everyone♪
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます！新年になりましたし、ちゃんとこっちの世界でもお参: Happy New Year! Now that the new year is here, we should go pay our respects properly in this world too!
Speech.純夏さんたちと一緒にバレンタインデーのチョコレートを作ってみたんです！いっぱい作: I made Valentine's chocolates with Sumika-san and the others! We made lots, so I'm giving them out to all sorts of people♪ Of course, Takeru-san gets some too!
Speech.えへへ、ホワイトデーにこんな風に色んな人からお返しを貰えると思ってなかったので、: Ehehe, I didn't expect to get White Day gifts from so many people! It really surprised me! I can't eat all this by myself, so we'll share it together♪
Speech.嘘をついてもいい日ですか……なんだか引っかかるものが……！嘘をついた事でいろんな: A day when it's okay to lie...? Something about that bothers me...! I remember causing all sorts of trouble for people by lying... Auu, auu...
Speech.ふわぁ……綺麗なウエディングドレスですね……わたしにも、あんな綺麗なドレスを着て: Wow... What a beautiful wedding dress... I wonder if I'll ever get to wear a lovely dress like that and have a wonderful wedding...
Speech.七夕は何をお願いしましたか？わたしは皆で、いつまでも仲良くいられるようにってお願: What did you wish for on Tanabata? I wished that we could all stay good friends forever!
Speech.ええっと、ハロウィンって行事があるんですよね！ わたしも仮装しないか誘われちゃい: Um, there's a holiday called Halloween, right? They invited me to dress up too! ...A bell and a tail? That sounds a lot like a kitty~.
Speech.今日はめるさんたちから教えてもらった、クリスマスパーティーをするんです！……こん: We're having a Christmas party today, like Meru-san and the others told me about! ...It's so nice that we can all celebrate happily together...
Speech.えっ、お誕生日のこと知ってくれてたんですか！？ ありがとうございます！えへへ……: Huh, you knew when my birthday was?! Thank you! Ehehe... Just knowing you want to celebrate it makes me happy!
Speech.ふわぁ……気持ちいいです……|たけるさん、とっても上手です……自分でやるよりも、: Ahh... That feels nice...|You're really good at this, Takeru-san... You're much more careful than I am when I do it myself...
Speech.……えへへ、なんですかー？|もう、イタズラは……ちょっとならいいですけど、やりす: ...Ehehe, what is it~?|Oh, you... A little teasing is fine, but don't go overboard, okay?
Speech.……んっ、ふふ、あはは……！|くすぐったいです、たけるさん。でも……なんだか平和: ...Mm, hehe, ahaha...!|That tickles, Takeru-san. But... it's so peaceful. I like it...
Speech.私たち、すっかりこっちの世界にも馴染んできたわね……むしろ、衛士としての勘を忘れ: We've really settled into this world... Keeping our instincts as Surface Pilots sharp is starting to feel like the hard part.
Speech.こっちにも私たちが知ってるのと同じスポーツがあるのね。でも、公式MG競技みたいに: They have the same sports we know here too. But we never had anything like the Official MG Competition, where you compete in Tactical Surface Fighters... Our world didn't have the luxury of doing things like that...
Speech.この世界でも戦術機を整備できる環境を用意してもらえて本当に安心したわ。元の世界に: I'm so relieved they've set us up with the facilities to maintain our Tactical Surface Fighters here. It makes me feel there's still a chance we can get back to our own world...
Speech.まず、この後に生徒会の依頼を確認してから……ああ、そうだ。メイズ探索の方もまとめ: First, I need to check the Student Council's requests... Oh, right. I also need to get the Maze Exploration information together... Things are getting busy.
Speech.今日が誕生日？おめでとうございます！……そうだ、今晩お時間ありますか？もし良かっ: Today's your birthday? Happy birthday! ...Oh, are you free tonight? If you'd like, why don't we all go out for a meal?
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。一年の計は元旦にありと言いますけど、あなたの今年: Happy New Year. They say the first day sets the course of the year. What are your goals for this one?
Speech.これ、受け取っていただけますか？今日は親しい人やお世話になってる人にチョコを贈る: Would you accept this? Apparently, today is a day to give chocolate to people you're close to, or people who've helped you. You've done so much for me, so I wanted to thank you.
Speech.え？これどうしたの？ホワイトデー？……ああ、なるほど。バレンタインデーのお返しを: Huh? What's this for? White Day? ...Oh, I see. A day to give something back for Valentine's chocolate. Thank you. I'll gladly accept it.
Speech.あら？あなたもウソをつきに来たの？今日は軽いウソなら許される日だって聞いてるんだ: Oh? Are you here to tell me a lie too? I heard little lies are allowed today... Huh? That was yesterday? I'm sorry... Wait, that's a lie itself!
Speech.ウエディングドレス……とても綺麗ね……。着られるときが来るといいのだけれど……。: A wedding dress... It's so beautiful... I hope I get a chance to wear one someday... Do I have someone in mind? ...That's none of your business!
Speech.七夕でのお願いって、自分に言い聞かせるためでもあると思うの。言葉にして書くことで: I think Tanabata wishes are also a way of reminding yourself what you want to do. Doesn't putting it into words and writing it down make you all the more determined?
Speech.ハロウィンって収穫を祝うお祭りのはずなんだけど……みんな仮装に力を入れちゃってる: Halloween is supposed to be a harvest celebration... But everyone's putting so much effort into their costumes. Do I have to dress up too? ...Even if you insist, I'm not sure...
Speech.クリスマスはキリストの誕生日だけど、こっちにもあるなんて何だか不思議ね。トナカイ: Christmas celebrates Christ's birth, but it's strange that they have it here too. There seem to be reindeer as well. I saw someone dressed as one in town.
Speech.私の誕生日？ああ、忙しくしてたらすっかり忘れてたわ……。覚えていてくれてありがと: My birthday? Oh, I've been so busy I completely forgot... Thank you for remembering. It means a lot to me.
Speech.きゃあ！？ ……びっくりした。|ごめんなさい。ちょっと加減を間違えちゃって。かか: Eek?! ...You startled me.|Sorry. I used a little too much force. Did any get on you?
Speech.……っとと、ふぅ……|……喉の渇きがもう限界だったわ……汗もすごくかいちゃったし: ...Whoa, whew...|...I was so thirsty I couldn't take it anymore... And I'd worked up quite a sweat... Don't laugh at me.
Speech.ん、どうかしたの？|……何か気になる？じっと見られると恥ずかしいわ。: Hm? What's wrong?|...Is something bothering you? It's embarrassing when you stare like that.
Speech.こっちの世界って、色々と面白そうな場所があるみたいなんだよね。大きい湖とか、樹海: There seem to be all sorts of interesting places in this world. Big lakes, huge forests... I'd love to go see them.
Speech.うーん、すっかりこっちの世界に馴染んじゃったんだけど……ボクの元居た世界に端末と: Hmm, I've really settled in here... But I wonder if I can take a terminal and things back to my own world... I'm not sure I could give them up now...
Speech.もしこっちの世界に生まれてたら、ボクは何をしてたんだろうね？やっぱり探検家？あっ: What would I be doing if I'd been born here? Exploring, I guess? Oh, but maybe I wouldn't, unless Dad was still my dad in this world...? ...Huh? That's how it works, right?
Speech.……うーん、山を登ってみようかな？ 温泉を探すのもいいかなあ？せっかく知らない場: ...Hmm, should I climb a mountain? Or maybe look for a hot spring? We've come all this way to somewhere new, so we should explore!
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！プレゼント考えてみたんだけど、これってのが思いつかなくてさ。: Happy birthday! I've been thinking about a present, but nothing feels quite right. I want to find something you'll really like, so why don't we go look together now?
Speech.あけましておめでとう！新年といえば初日の出！富士山は無いけど、あの高い山なら見ら: Happy New Year! And that means catching the first sunrise! There's no Mount Fuji here, but I think we could see it from that tall mountain! Want to come with me?
Speech.チョコレートを皆で一緒に作ったんだけど、はい！ お裾分け！やっぱりチョコレートは: We all made chocolate together, so here! Have some! Chocolate's great, isn't it? Handy and packed with calories. Perfect for field rations, too.
Speech.ホワイトデー？お菓子をくれるの！ありがとう！うーん、どうしようかな……保存しとく: White Day? You're giving me sweets? Thank you! Hmm, what should I do...? Save them for later or eat them now...? Tough choice.
Speech.これから、一週間くらい山に入ろうと思うんだけど、一緒に行く？え？エイプリルフール: I'm thinking of heading into the mountains for about a week. Want to come? Huh? April Fools' Day...? What do you mean?
Speech.ウエディングドレスかぁ……一度は着てみたいなぁ……。その目は何？ ボクだって女の: A wedding dress, huh... I'd like to try one on someday... What's that look for? I'm a girl too, you know!
Speech.短冊にはなんて書いた？ ボクはねえ、希少な生き物を発見できますようにとか、あとは: What did you write on your wish slip? Mine was something like... I hope I can discover rare creatures, and eat some unusual, delicious vegetables and fruit!
Speech.仮装をしたり、お菓子を貰いに行ったりするらしいよ。ボクも貰えたりするのかなあ？: Apparently, you dress up and go around asking for candy. I wonder if I could get some too?
Speech.クリスマスパーティーかぁ。もみの木が必要って聞いたから取りに行くんだけど、この辺: A Christmas party, huh. I heard we need a fir tree, so I'm going to get one. Where do they grow around here? It's okay to use a Tactical Surface Fighter to carry it, right?
Speech.え？誕生日おめでとう？わぁ、ありがとう！急に言われたからびっくりしたよ！でもすご: Huh? Happy birthday? Wow, thank you! You caught me by surprise! But I'm really happy!
Speech.うわっ！？ さっきの何！？|もしかして新技？面白いね！よーし、ボクも真似してみよ: Whoa?! What was that?!|Was that a new move? That's neat! All right, I'm going to try it too!
Speech.これで……出来た！|端末でやってたら出来なかった技だよ！ 筐体だと違うね！: Like this... Got it!|I couldn't pull that move off on a terminal! It's different on an arcade cabinet!

Speech.お誕生日、おめでとうございます。私からはこの手編みの手袋を贈ります。学園からの支: Happy birthday. These hand-knitted gloves are my gift to you. They should be warmer and more practical than the academy's issued pair. Please accept them without hesitation.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます。新年だとしても、やることには代わりはありません。: Happy New Year. The work remains the same, even at New Year's. An excellent pilot performs consistently, whatever the season.
Speech.バレンタインデーという行事については聞いています。では、チョコレートをどうぞ。友: I have heard about Valentine's Day. Here, some chocolate. A gift to build friendly relations. It is also a sensible nutritional supplement.
Speech.バレンタインデーのお返しですか。気を使っていただき、感謝します。……そうですね。: A gift in return for Valentine's Day? Thank you for your consideration. ...Yes. Since it is a gift for me, I will enjoy it myself.
Speech.嘘をつく日、ですか。なるほど、たしかに有用かもしれません。模擬訓練として、襲撃が: A day for lying? I see. That could indeed be useful. Shall we use a false report of an attack for a training exercise?
Speech.結婚についてですか……私は娘を立派なパイロットに育て上げることが全てです。なので: Marriage...? Raising my daughter to be an outstanding pilot is everything to me. I have no interest in anything else.
Speech.願い事ですか……我が地区レドフカの繁栄です。……そして、ナージャが幸福で健康に成: My wish...? Prosperity for our district, Redovka. ...And for Nadja to grow up happy and healthy.
Speech.ハロウィンという行事は知っています。ナージャのためのお菓子を用意しました。少々、: I know of Halloween. I prepared sweets for Nadja. I made rather too many... so you may have the extras.
Speech.メリークリスマス。あまり華美な装飾などはしていませんが、ナージャと一緒に、お祝い: Merry Christmas. We have not put up particularly elaborate decorations, but Nadja and I are preparing to celebrate together. Would you like to join us?
Speech.私の誕生日……ですか。すっかり忘れていました。ナージャの誕生日は忘れたことはあり: My birthday...? I had completely forgotten. I have never forgotten Nadja's birthday, but... thank you for remembering mine.
Speech.……ふっ、そうですか。|……笑っていた？ いえ、おそらくは気の所為でしょう。: ...Heh. I see.|...Was I smiling? No, you must have imagined it.
Speech.どうしました？|なにか気になることがあれば、遠慮なく言ってください。: Is something wrong?|If anything concerns you, please tell me without hesitation.
Speech.……少し丈が長いですね。|また、少し長さを調整しますか。: ...It's a little too long.|I'll adjust the length again.
Speech.お母様は私にとって絶対的な目標で、憧れなんです。いつか、お母様の隣で胸を張って戦: Mother is the person I aspire to be, and admire more than anyone. Someday, I want to be a pilot good enough to stand proudly beside her in battle... Please watch me.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん、私……ちゃんとできてますか: %usernameusernameuserna%-san, am I... doing all right? I'm always worried that I'm causing trouble for Mother. When you tell me it's okay, I feel so relieved.
Speech.私、甘いものが大好きなんです。でも……お母様に子供っぽいって思われたくなくて、言: I love sweets. But... I don't want Mother to think I'm childish, so I try not to mention it. This is a secret between %usernameusernameuserna%-san and me.
Speech.あれ……いつの間にか%usernameusernameuserna%さん、いなく: Oh... %usernameusernameuserna%-san disappeared while I wasn't looking... I feel lonely... Please come back soon.
Speech.お誕生日、おめでとうございます！ これは私からのお祝いです。お母様と一緒に選んだ: Happy birthday! This is my gift to you. I picked it out with Mother, so I'd be happy if you liked it. I hope you'll accept it.
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます、%usernameusernameuserna%: Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. This year, I'll do my very best on every mission... as a daughter Mother can be proud of, and as a capable pilot.
Speech.あの、%usernameusernameuserna%さん……チョコ、作ってみた: Um, %usernameusernameuserna%-san... I tried making chocolate. Don't tell Mother, okay? She taught me that sweets are a sensible way to recover from fatigue... I hope you like it.
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し……ありがとうございます！ こんなに素敵なものを頂けるなんて: Thank you for the White Day gift...! I never imagined I'd receive something so lovely... M-May I tell Mother? I'll treasure it, and take my time savoring every bite.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん、実は私さっき凄く美味しいお: %usernameusernameuserna%-san, I actually found a shop with really delicious sweets earlier. ...Sorry, that was a lie. So, um... shall we go make it true together later?
Speech.結婚……まだ私には早い気がしますけど、いつかお母様のような素敵な女性になれたら、: Marriage... It still feels a little early for me, but perhaps I'll be able to think about it once I'm a wonderful woman like Mother. What sort of woman do you li— Ah, n-never mind!
Speech.願い事……私はお母様のように立派なパイロットになれるようにと書きました。あとは…: My wish... I wrote that I want to be an excellent pilot like Mother. And... that you'll always stay by my side... Ehehe, I got a little greedy.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート、です！ %usernameusernameuserna: Trick or treat! %usernameusernameuserna%-san, I'll play a trick on you if you don't give me sweets! Except... I don't really know what sort of trick to play... Will you teach me?
Speech.メリークリスマス……です。お母様や%usernameusernameuserna: Merry Christmas... Eating cake with Mother and %usernameusernameuserna%-san was what I looked forward to most today. ...Ehehe, I wish this moment could last forever.
Speech.私の誕生日をお祝いしてくれるんですか……？ 嬉しいです……！ お母様に褒められた: You're celebrating my birthday...? I'm so happy...! It makes my heart feel as warm as when Mother praises me. I'm so glad I met you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Speech.えへへ……|あの……もしよろしければ、その……もっと、頭撫でてほしいです……: Ehehe...|Um... If you don't mind... I'd like you to pat my head some more...
Speech.はうっ……！|いきなりおでこ、突かないでください……びっくりしちゃいますので……: Aah...!|Please don't suddenly poke my forehead... It startles me...
Speech.どうか……しましたか？|え？ ノートを見たい……？ ど、どうぞ……今日はあなたの: Is something... wrong?|Huh? You want to see my notebook...? H-Here... I wrote about you today.
Speech.儂はかなり早い段階でメイズ適性に目覚めての。それ以来そりゃあ厳しい訓練を受けて、: My aptitude for the Maze awakened quite early. Ever since, I've undergone very strict training and honed my mind.
Speech.儂の話し方が古風なのは、恩師の影響なのじゃ。彼女は儂に人の心の機微を教えてくれた: I speak this old-fashioned way because of my dear teacher. She taught me the subtleties of the human heart. ...I was rather lonely underneath it all, and she alone supported me like family. Those memories are precious to me.
Speech.たまには甘いお菓子で一息つくのも、立派な戦術なのじゃぞ。儂のお気に入りは、このク: Taking a break with sweets now and then is a sound tactic, you know. These cookies are my favorite. Would you like one? Hehe, a secret tea time for just the 2 of us.
Speech.そなた、どこへ行ったのじゃ？ 儂を一人にするとは、いい度胸じゃのう。……まあ、寂: Where have you gone? Quite bold of you, leaving me alone. ...Not that I'm lonely... I'm not, but do come back soon and keep me company.
Speech.今日はそなたがこの世に生を受けた記念日じゃな。実にめでたいのう。そなたのようなお: Today marks the day you came into this world. A fine cause for celebration. I'm fortunate to have a man like you as my Commander. Stay by my side, and let me celebrate it every year.
Speech.新年おめでとうなのじゃ。今年も儂がそなたの右腕となり、勝利へと導いてやろう。……: Happy New Year. Once again, I shall be your right hand and guide you to victory. ...What? You want New Year's money? How old do you think I am? We're the same age...
Speech.今日はバレンタイン。チョコレートを渡す良い催しじゃな、糖分は脳の活性化に必要不可: Valentine's Day. A fine occasion for giving chocolate. Sugar is essential for keeping the mind active. ...These are my favorite baked sweets. I'll share them with you as a special favor. Be grateful, now.
Speech.ホワイトデー？ お返しとは律儀じゃな。うむ、せっかくだし、いただくかの。中身は…: White Day? How thoughtful of you to give something in return. Well, since you've gone to the trouble, I'll accept. What's inside...? Baked sweets? You remembered my tastes well. Hehe, is that the secret to your popularity?
Speech.実は儂、本当は八十歳なのじゃよ……ふふ、驚いたかえ？ 今日は嘘をついても許される: Actually, I'm eighty years old... Hehe, surprised? We're allowed to lie today, aren't we? Huh? You thought it was true...? You'd be wise to make that a lie too.
Speech.結婚か。人生における重大な契約の一つじゃな。共に歩む相手を選ぶのは、有効な戦術を: Marriage. One of life's most important commitments. Choosing someone to walk beside may be harder than choosing an effective tactic... Tell me, what sort of board would you lay out?
Speech.短冊に願いを、か。儂はそなたや仲間たちとの平穏が続くようにと書いた……非合理な願: A wish on a slip of paper, hm? I wrote that I wish for our peaceful days together with our friends to continue... Go on, laugh at such an irrational wish. I'm only human. Sometimes I want to put my faith in a wish, too.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリートじゃ！ 菓子をくれぬなら、そなたのＭＧにイタズラするぞ？: Trick or treat! Give me sweets, or I'll play a trick on your MG! ...Hehe, startled? I'm joking. But I am rather fond of sweets. Hand them over.
Speech.メリークリスマス。雪の降る夜も、そなたの隣にいれば寒くはないのう……さあ、今夜は: Merry Christmas. Even on a snowy night, I don't feel cold by your side... Tonight is special. I shall allow you to spend it beside me. You do... want to spend it with me too, don't you?
Speech.儂の誕生日を祝ってくれるのかえ？ 感謝するのじゃ。同年代の異性に祝われたのは初め: You're celebrating my birthday? Thank you. A man my own age has never celebrated it for me before. Next year, the year after, and beyond... I'd be happy if you kept doing so.
Speech.ほれ、たくさん撫でるのじゃ。|うむ、儂からもよしよししてやるぞい。いい子なのじゃ: Come now, give me plenty of pats.|Yes, I'll pat your head too. Good boy.
Speech.そなたの手は大きいのう……|こうして撫でられていると、儂もおなごであることを思い: Your hands are so large...|Being stroked like this reminds me that I'm a woman too.
Speech.くすっ、顔が赤くなっておるのう。|もっと素直に甘えていいのじゃぞ？: Hehe, your face is red.|You can be more honest about wanting to be pampered, you know.
Speech.私たちが操縦する戦術機とこちらのＭＧ……奇妙なほどに共通点がある……。それを解明: The Tactical Surface Fighters we pilot and the MGs here... have an uncanny number of things in common. If we can unravel that, perhaps we can bring new technology home.
Speech.初めて天然の食材を収穫したが、まさか篁示現流が通用しないとは……。私もまだまだ未: I harvested natural ingredients for the first time, but never imagined the Takamura Jigen-ryu would fail me... I still have much to learn...
Speech.ブリッジス少尉や他の皆と共に転移をしたのは不幸中の幸いだった。正直なところ、私一: Being transported here with Second Lieutenant Bridges and the others was a blessing amid misfortune. Frankly, I don't know what would have become of me if I'd been alone...
Speech.う、うぅむ、やはり落ち着かないな……確かに、ヘイワード殿たちが勧めてくれた店で買: U-Um, I still can't quite relax... What I bought at the shop Hayward-dono and the others recommended certainly fits well and is easy to move in... But thinking that I'm wearing something so cute... Ugh...
Speech.誕生日おめでとうございます。あなたの一年が幸多きものになるように願っております。: Happy birthday. I wish you a year filled with happiness.
Speech.新年あけましておめでとう。振袖を着る文化がこちらにもあるのだな。ふふふ……いやな: Happy New Year. So they have the custom of wearing furisode here as well. Hehehe... No, it's just a little nostalgic. I look forward to another year with you.
Speech.今日は菓子を贈って感謝を表す日と聞いた。部下達とピクシス・マスールの方々にも渡し: I heard today is for giving sweets as a sign of gratitude. I've just given some to my subordinates and the members of Pyxis Ma Soeur. I'd very much like to give you some too.
Speech.ほわいとでー……？バレンタインデーのお返し？そんなつもりではなかったのだが…。い: White Day...? A return gift for Valentine's Day? That wasn't what I intended... No, refusing would be rude. Thank you. I'll gladly accept it.
Speech.な、なに！？不知火・弐型が破損しただと！？よし、すぐに現地へ向かう！……ウソだと: W-What?! The Shiranui Second is damaged?! Right, I'll head there immediately! ...That was a lie? What broke was a replica made for testing? —I do not approve.
Speech.家を繋いでいくには跡取りが必要。つまり結婚して子を儲けなければならない。しかして: My family needs an heir to carry on its line. Which means I must marry and have children. Yet I have no betrothed, nor any gentleman I wish to welcome as my husband... None! A-Absolutely none! Yes!
Speech.世界が平和になりますように……短冊に書くだけでそれが叶うのならば私たち衛士は必要: I wish for world peace... If writing it on a wish slip were enough, there would be no need for us Surface Pilots. ...And yet I cannot help wishing for it.
Speech.……とりっく、おあ、とりーと……。いや、その、こういった催しにも進んで参加して、: ...Trick... or... treat... No, well, someone once advised me that taking part in occasions like this and learning about everyday life is important for someone who protects the people...
Speech.このあと催されるクリスマスパーティーで出される料理の一品を私が担当させてもらった: I've been entrusted with preparing one of the dishes for the Christmas party later. I'd be happy if you tried it too.
Speech.ああ、今日は私の誕生日だったか……パーティーを用意したから来てほしい？……偶には: Ah, today was my birthday... You've prepared a party, and want me to come? ...It would be nice to take it easy once in a while... Thank you.
Speech.ふむ、なるほど……|ここのエリアは重要だな。皆にも共有しなければ……: Hmm, I see...|This area is important. I must share this with everyone...
Speech.ここにもコンビニが……ふふっ……|すまない、昔の事を思い出してしまったんだ。: A convenience store here too... Hehe...|Forgive me. It brought back some old memories.
Speech.このシティというエリアは本当に広いな……|案内されたところは……確かこのエリアだ: The area they call the city really is vast...|The place they showed me was... somewhere around here, if I remember correctly...
Speech.こっちの世界の飯って種類多すぎないか？毎回違うもの見つけるたびに、つい試したくな: Doesn't this world have way too many kinds of food? Every time I find something new, I can't help wanting to try it.
Speech.この前ちょっと街を見て回ったんだけどさ、面白いもの多いよな。見慣れない店とか物と: I took a look around town the other day. There's so much interesting stuff. All these shops and things I've never seen before... I keep stopping to check them out.
Speech.ベテランのメイドを見るとさ、すげーなって思うことがあるんだ。動きに無駄がなくて、: Sometimes I look at the experienced maids and think, wow. Not a single wasted movement. It's pretty cool to watch.
Speech.うーん、なんか暇だなぁ……。体動かさないと落ち着かないし、ちょっと走ってくるかな: Hmm, I'm kinda bored... Can't settle down unless I'm moving. Maybe I'll go for a run.
Speech.誕生日おめでと！今日はお前が主役なんだから、遠慮しないで楽しまなきゃ損だぞ！: Happy birthday! You're the star today, so don't hold back! You'd be missing out if you didn't enjoy yourself!
Speech.あけましておめでとさん。せっかくだし今年は楽しいこといっぱいやりたいよな。……ま: Happy New Year! Let's do all sorts of fun stuff this year. ...Well, I'll still do my missions properly. Here's to another good year!
Speech.今日は世話になってるやつにお菓子を渡す日なんだってな。ほら、あたしからもやるよ！: Apparently, today's for giving sweets to people who've helped you. Here, I've got some for you too! It doesn't mean anything weird, okay?!
Speech.え、お菓子くれんの？ あ、この間のお返しか！へへ、それでも嬉しいよ。ありがとな！: Huh, you're giving me sweets? Oh, it's for the other day! Hehe, I'm happy either way. Thanks!
Speech.ごきげんよう。あたくし、本日より気品溢れる令嬢として振る舞うことにいたしましたの: Good day to you. From this day forth, I shall conduct myself as a lady of grace and refinement. ...Pfft, ahaha, just kidding! Apparently, it's April Fools' Day, so we're allowed to lie!
Speech.結婚式って、なんかキラキラしてていいよなー。……あたし？ いやいや、まだそういう: Weddings are all sparkly and nice, huh... Me? No, no, it's way too early for that!
Speech.願い事かぁ……みんなで笑って飯食える毎日、とかかな。平和な世界って、案外そういう: A wish...? Maybe getting to laugh and eat with everyone every day. Maybe that's what a peaceful world really comes down to.
Speech.とりっくおあとりーと！ ……へへ、言ってみたかったんだよな。ほら、お菓子くれよ！: Trick or treat! ...Hehe, I've been wanting to say that. Come on, give me candy! Or I'll play a trick on you~!
Speech.街中キラキラしてるし、なんかテンション上がるよな！せっかくだし今日は難しいこと抜: The whole town's sparkling! Kinda gets you excited, huh? Let's forget the difficult stuff and just have fun today!
Speech.あたしの誕生日……覚えてたのかよ。ま、せっかくだし今日は遠慮なしで楽しませてもら: My birthday... You remembered? Well, since we're celebrating, I'm not holding back today!
Speech.うおっ……ベッドの上で朝飯って贅沢すぎないか？|しかもこれ、普通にうまいな！: Whoa... Isn't breakfast in bed a little too fancy?|And this is actually really good!
Speech.これこれ！なあ、こういうのがお嬢様ってやつだよな？|想像してた通りって感じで、ち: This! Hey, isn't this what being a lady's all about?|It's just how I imagined it. Makes me kinda happy!
Speech.え、朝からここまで全部やってもらっていいのかよ？|なんかダメ人間になりそうだけど: Huh, you're doing all this for me first thing in the morning?|I might turn into a total slacker... But hey, once in a while's fine!
Speech.お茶の世界も、思っていたよりずっと奥深いのね。香りや温度だけで、こんなに印象が変: There's much more to tea than I expected. It's fascinating how much the aroma and temperature alone can change the impression it leaves.
Speech.メイド服って、もっと窮屈なものだと思っていたの。でも意外と機能的で、よく考えられ: I thought a maid uniform would be much more restrictive. But it's surprisingly practical and thoughtfully designed.
Speech.この前使った新鮮な食材、本当に美味しかったわね。……ああいう平穏を知れたことは、: Those fresh ingredients we used the other day were delicious. ...I think having known that kind of peace will give us something to hold on to after we return to our own world.
Speech.この世界は、本当に穏やかな時間が流れているのね。……こういう空気は、嫌いじゃない: Time really does pass peacefully in this world. ...I rather like this atmosphere.
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。あなたにとって良い一年になることを願っているわ。: Happy birthday. I hope the coming year treats you well.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。今年もいい一年になるように気を引き締めて、でも時には緩める: Happy New Year. Let's stay focused and make it a good one... but remember to let ourselves relax sometimes too.
Speech.はい、チョコレート。ふふ……ちゃんと、あなたのためを思って選んだものよ。大事に味: Here, chocolate. Hehe... I chose it with you in mind. Take your time and enjoy it.
Speech.お返しを用意してくれたのね。ありがとう。……もしかして、結構真剣に悩んで選んでく: You prepared a gift in return. Thank you. ...Did you spend quite a while thinking about what to choose?
Speech.ねえ、実はずっとあなたのこと……ふふ、そんなに赤くならないで。今日はエイプリルフ: You know, all this time, I've felt... Hehe, don't turn quite so red. It's April Fools' Day today, isn't it?
Speech.幸せそうな花嫁を見ると、こちらまで温かい気持ちになるわね。誰かと穏やかな時間を重: Seeing a happy bride makes me feel warm inside too. Sharing peaceful days with someone... I think that's a lovely thing.
Speech.願い事を書く文化って、不思議だけれど嫌いじゃないわ。言葉にすることで、少し前を向: The custom of writing down wishes is curious, but I rather like it. Sometimes putting something into words helps you look ahead.
Speech.とりっくおあとりーと、だったかしら。……ふふ、お菓子をくれないなら少し困らせてし: Trick or treat, was it? ...Hehe, if you don't give me sweets, I might make a little trouble for you.
Speech.メリークリスマス。街の灯りが綺麗ね。こういう静かな賑わいは、見ていて落ち着くわ。: Merry Christmas. The lights in town are beautiful. There's something soothing about this gentle bustle.
Speech.誕生日を祝ってもらえるのね。……ありがとう、素直に嬉しいわ。: You're celebrating my birthday for me. ...Thank you. I'm honestly happy.
Speech.ふふっ、おつかれさま。|お茶を淹れたから良ければどうぞ。熱いから気を付けてね。: Hehe, good work.|I've made some tea. Help yourself if you'd like. It's hot, so be careful.
Speech.まさか私がメイドさんになるなんてね……|ちょっと恥ずかしいけれどこれもいい経験…: I never imagined I'd become a maid...|It's a little embarrassing, but it's a good experience... You've let me live out a lovely dream.
Speech.もしよかったら話を聞かせてもらえるかしら？|私に何が出来るかはわからないけれど…: Would you like to tell me about it?|I don't know what I can do... but I want to help you.
Speech.……頭を使うと甘いものが食べたくなるのよ。あんた、今から私と一緒にパフェを食べに: ...Using my brain makes me crave sweets. You're coming with me for a parfait. And of course, you're paying.
Speech.偽善者や自由を縛ってくるようなやつ……特に自分より上に立って見下してくるようなや: I hate hypocrites and people who try to restrict my freedom... Especially those who stand above me and look down on me. The Instructional Commander...? Well, there's an exception to everything.
Speech.私は神楽と同じ顔だけど、あいつみたいに手ぬるいやり方はしない。言い換えれば、あい: I may have Kagura's face, but I don't use her soft methods. In other words, I do what she can't... We divide the work.
Speech.……やっと起きたわね。あんたの寝顔、無防備すぎてバカみたいだったわ。……でも、そ: ...Finally awake, are you? You looked so defenseless in your sleep, it was ridiculous... But maybe I don't mind seeing you look that peaceful.
Speech.今日はあんたの誕生日でしょ。特別に双頭の斧総出で盛大にお祝いしてあげるわ。……感: It's your birthday today, isn't it? As a special favor, all of Double-Headed Axe will throw you a grand celebration. ...Be grateful. I'm personally helping with the preparations.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。まさかあんたなんかと年越しすることになるとはね……本当、人: Happy New Year. Never thought I'd ring in the year with someone like you... Life really is unpredictable. Anyway... I suppose I'll be good to you again this year.
Speech.これ、あげる。ただの義理なんだから、勘違いしないでよね。……でも、一応あんたの好: Here. It's just courtesy chocolate, so don't get the wrong idea. ...But I did make it especially to suit your tastes, so savor it.

Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……なんで、皆さんお菓子を渡: %usernameusernameuserna%-san... Why is everyone trying to give me sweets...? All I did was forget to change after patrolling the pool...
Speech.……うーん、誰もいないのかぁ。んん……ちょっと寂しくなってきちゃったかも……よー: ...Hmm, nobody's here. Mmm... I'm starting to feel a little lonely... All right, I'll go see if I can find someone I know♪
Speech.あけましておめでとう。さっそく驚かせちゃおうって、この服で来たけど……ふふっ、そ: Happy New Year. I wore this to surprise you right away... Hehe, judging by that face, it worked perfectly♪
Speech.あけましておめでとうございます……っ！ こっ、今年の目標は、ドジの回数を減らすこ: H-Happy New Year...! M-My goal this year is to be less clumsy! Huh? Why am I in a swimsuit...? Well, I just spilled a drink on my uniform...
Speech.あけましておめでとう！ えへへ、新年は大好きなんだ！皆がとっても楽しい空気になっ: Happy New Year! Ehehe, I love New Year's! Everyone's having so much fun, and just watching them makes me feel warm inside!
Speech.あたしに夢中になっちゃいそう？|じっくり見てちょうだい、そのための水着なんだから: Think you might fall for me?|Take a good, long look. That's what this swimsuit is for...♪
Speech.あたしの水着を見て、ただで帰れるなんて思わないことね。まずは、じっくり感想を聞か: Don't think you can see me in a swimsuit and just walk away. First, tell me exactly what you think♪
Speech.あっ……！ な、なんでしょうか……？|うう……じ、じっと見られると恥ずかしいです: Ah...! W-What is it...?|Ugh... I-It's embarrassing when you stare at me...!
Speech.あははは……！|ふぅ……こうやって童心に帰って遊ぶのも、悪くありませんね。: Ahahaha...!|Whew... It's nice to feel like a kid again and just play.
Speech.ありがとうって誰かに言ってもらえると、自分がすっごく満たされるの！だから、%us: It makes me feel so fulfilled when someone says thank you! So I'm going to get lots of thank-yous from you too, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. Okay?
Speech.いきますよ、えいっ！ えいっ！|こ、こうして誰かと水をかけ合って遊ぶなんて……わ: Here I go! Take that! And that!|P-Playing and splashing water at each other like this... Is it really okay for someone like me...?
Speech.いつも私を支えてくれる仲間達だからこそ、きちんと休んでほしいですし、楽しんでほし: My friends are always there to support me, so I want them to rest properly and enjoy themselves. Every one of them matters. They're what makes us the Disciplinary Committee.
Speech.うぅ……この格好でひとりだと、心細いです……どこか人気のない、涼しくて、それでゆ: Ugh... Being alone dressed like this makes me nervous... Is there somewhere quiet and cool where I can relax...?
Speech.え、えっと……実はわたし、今度の公式戦にも、水着で出ますっ！……うぅ……う、嘘で: U-Um... I'm actually going to wear my swimsuit for the next official match too! ...Ugh... Th-That's a lie. April Fools' Day really is too much for me...!
Speech.えっ、ホワイトデーのお返し？ えへへ、ありがと！せっかくなら温かい飲み物を入れて: Huh? A White Day gift? Ehehe, thanks! How about I make us something warm to drink, and we have tea together?♪
Speech.えっ、私の誕生日……？ あ、ありがとう……えへへ……こんな風にお祝いをされるなん: Huh? My birthday...? Oh, thank you... Ehehe... I didn't expect you to celebrate it like this... But I'm really happy.
Speech.えーっと、ちょっと位置調整……|男の人の背中って大きいね！ ちょっと普段と感覚が: Um, let me get into position...|A man's back is so broad! This feels a little different from usual...!
Speech.お、お誕生日、おめでとうございます……っ！水着だと喜んでもらえるって、アニスちゃ: H-Happy birthday...! Anis-chan said you'd be happy if I wore a swimsuit... A-Are you happy...?
Speech.お客さん、凝ってますね～|色んな本を読んでしっかり勉強したんだよ♪ 結構気持ちい: My, you're all tense~.|I read all sorts of books and studied up♪ Feels pretty good, doesn't it~?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます、%usernameusernameuserna%さ: Happy birthday, %usernameusernameuserna%-san. Hehe, since we have the chance, why don't we swim together and make a special memory of today?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございます。プレゼントは用意しているので、後でお渡ししますね。: Happy birthday. I have a gift ready for you, so I'll give it to you later. ...Huh? The way I'm dressed is the best gift of all? What do you mean?
Speech.お誕生日おめでとう！ 今日はあなたのやりたいこと、できる限り叶えてあげるよ！それ: Happy birthday! Today, I'll do my best to make anything you want to do happen! So, let's get started. What do you want to do~?!
Speech.お願い事は『もっと%usernameusernameuserna%があたしに夢中: My wish is for %usernameusernameuserna% to fall for me even more... But wishing isn't enough. I have to make it happen. That's why I'm dressed like this—to tempt you♪
Speech.きゃっ！？ まったくもう……|%usernameusernameuserna%さ: Eek?! Honestly...|Go easy on the teasing, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, okay? ...Though I'll allow a little.
Speech.きょ、今日はこの水着姿で、学園内のパトロールをこなすんですよっ！え……？ い、い: T-Today, I'm going to patrol the academy in this swimsuit! Huh...? N-No, it's a lie! It's April Fools' Day! D-Don't take me seriously, please!
Speech.こうやって、皆と一緒に叶えたいお願いを共有するのって、なんだか特別な気持ちになる: Sharing our wishes with everyone like this feels kind of special... I wrote that I hope we can all get along happily♪
Speech.この格好でクリスマスパーティーに参加しても大丈夫でしょうか？サンタの服を用意して: Is it all right to go to the Christmas party dressed like this? I'd prepared a Santa outfit, but brought this one by mistake...
Speech.この格好を仮装だと思いますか？ それとも、悪戯だと思いますか？ふふ……貴方の好き: Do you think this is a costume? Or a prank? Hehe... You're welcome to pick whichever you prefer.
Speech.この水着、濡れたら溶けちゃう素材なの。あたしの大事なトコロを誰にも見せたくないな: This swimsuit is made of a material that dissolves when wet. If you don't want anyone seeing my private parts, hold me close and hide me♪ —Well? Believe me enough to give me a hug?
Speech.ごめんなさい、お菓子を持ってくるのを忘れたわ。だから、イタズラ決定ね。この格好で: Sorry, I forgot to bring sweets. So I get a trick, then. What will happen to me if you play a trick on me dressed like this...?♪
Speech.ご存じないのですか？ 風紀委員の制服として、水着が試験採用されるようになったので: Didn't you know? Swimsuits are being trialed as Disciplinary Committee uniforms... —Just kidding, of course. Hehe, sorry to disappoint you.
Speech.せっかくの休暇ですから、みんなも羽を伸ばしてゆっくりできているといいのですけども: It's a rare chance for a holiday, so I hope everyone can spread their wings and relax... Me? I'm... resting here beside you right now.
Speech.た、誕生日を祝ってくれて、ありがとうございます……！えっと、その……も、もしプレ: Th-Thank you for celebrating my birthday...! Um, well... I-If you're giving me a present... would you walk with me by the sea...?
Speech.ちょ、チョコレート……頑張って、作ってみました……！作ってる時に服が汚れちゃった: Ch-Chocolate... I worked hard to make it...! I got my clothes dirty while making it, but I-I think it tastes all right...!
Speech.と、トナカイ衣装以外で、クリスマスに仮装しようと、チームの皆に言われたんですけど: M-My teammates told me to dress up for Christmas in something other than a reindeer costume... But all I had on hand was a swimsuit... I-Is this okay...?
Speech.どうぞ、バレンタインのチョコレートです。カリナが言うには、感謝を伝えるなら水着と: Here, your Valentine's chocolate. Karina said I should wear a swimsuit to show my gratitude... B-But judging by your reaction, was I tricked...?
Speech.な、なんだか普段よりも、見られてる気がします……！でも、絶対に気のせいですよね。: I-I feel like people are looking at me more than usual...! But I'm sure it's just my imagination. There'd be no point looking at someone like me...
Speech.はい、バレンタインのチョコレートです。水着の理由？ふふふ、このチョコはわたくしの: Here, your Valentine's chocolate. Why the swimsuit? Hehehe, this chocolate isn't finished until it's drizzled over my body—Just kidding. Did you believe me?
Speech.ばーん！ ふふっ、命中ね♪|水も滴るいい男じゃない。さあ、仕返しはしないの？ あ: Bang! Hehe, got you♪|You look quite handsome dripping wet. Well, aren't you going to get me back? Go on, soak me...♪
Speech.ひああっ！？ や、だ、ダメっ！|そ、そんな風になでないでください……！ タコさん: Eeeek?! N-No, don't!|D-Don't stroke me like that...! Not that an octopus can understand me...
Speech.ひううううっ！？ そ、そこはダメです！|しょ、触手が私の水着の中にまで……！？: Eeeeeeek?! N-Not there!|Th-The tentacles are getting inside my swimsuit...?! P-Please help me~!
Speech.ひゃうっ！？|ちょ、ちょっと油断しちゃった……あはは、なんでもない、なんでもない: Eek?!|I-I let my guard down for a second... Ahaha, it's nothing. Nothing at all~!
Speech.ふふっ……とってもきれいですね……！|とってもきれいな夕陽……一緒に見られて、ほ: Hehe... It's so beautiful...!|Such a beautiful sunset... I'm r-really glad we could see it together.
Speech.ほら、バレンタインのチョコレートよ……あーん。どうかしら。水着であーんされるなん: Here, your Valentine's chocolate... Say aaah. Well? Having me feed you in a swimsuit really gets your heart racing, doesn't it?
Speech.わ、わたしなんかに、ホワイトデーのお返しなんて……嬉しくて死んじゃいます……！水: A-A White Day gift for someone like me...? I'm so happy I could die...! If I weren't in a swimsuit, I might've overheated and fainted...
Speech.わ、わたしにウェディングドレスなんて、分不相応ですよね……この水着ですら、勇気が: A-A wedding dress would be far too much for someone like me... Even this swimsuit took courage... Oh! S-So if it were a swimsuit wedding, maybe even I could just about... N-No, that doesn't make any sense...
Speech.わ、わたしの水着姿……どう思い、ますか……？その……ほ、褒めてくれると、とっても: W-What do you think of me... in this swimsuit...? Um... I-I'd be so happy if you complim— N-No! Never mind!
Speech.わ、わたしの願い事は……『これから、家族で仲良くなれますように』……こ、こんなこ: M-My wish is... for our family to get along from now on... Th-The stars won't know what to do with a wish like that, will they...
Speech.わ、私の誕生日ですか！？ あ、ありがとうございます！ すっかり忘れていました……: I-It's my birthday?! Oh, thank you! I'd completely forgotten... I'm sorry I'm dressed like this right now... But I'm so happy you thought of me! Thank you!
Speech.わぁ、ジューンブライド……素敵だね！ うちの校区だと質素倹約がモットーだから、あ: Wow, a June bride... How lovely! Our district's motto is simplicity and thrift, so we don't really hold lavish events like this. A girl can't help dreaming a little, though, can she?
Speech.んうう……こ、ここは落ち着いて……|た、タコさんも私が慌てたらビックリするでしょ: Mmm... I-I need to stay calm...|Th-The octopus will get startled if I panic... N-No, I can't do this~!
Speech.んっ……ちゅっ♪|あたしの愛、受け取ってくれたかしら。ほら……愛のお返しに、愛を: Mm... Mwah♪|Did you accept my love? Come on... Give me some love in return?
Speech.んっ、すみません、何でしょう……？|わたくしにとって、この時間は、かけがえのない: Mm, pardon me. What is it...?|This time is irreplaceable to me.

Speech.ハッピーバレンタイン！ えへへ、皆にチョコレートをあげてるんだ。はい、あなたにも: Happy Valentine's Day! Ehehe, I'm giving everyone chocolate. Here, some yummy chocolate for you too! I made it with lots of care♪
Speech.ホワイトデーのお返し、ありがたく受け取るわ。ちゃんと愛を込めてくれたかしら？全身: I'll gladly accept your White Day gift. Did you put your love into it? I'm wearing a swimsuit so I can feel your love with my whole body...♪

Speech.メリークリスマス、%usernameusernameuserna%。プレゼントは: Merry Christmas, %usernameusernameuserna%. Your gift is me in a swimsuit, of course... Just kidding. Here, an invitation to Chaos Maiden's Christmas party. Let's go together♪
Speech.メリークリスマス！ えへへ、今日はクラスナの皆と一緒にパーティーをしようと思って: Merry Christmas! Ehehe, I'm getting everything ready for a party with everyone in Krasna today! Nina-san and Nadja-san are looking forward to it too♪
Speech.今まで我慢をしていましたけども……もう少しだけ、ワガママになります。ふふ、%us: I've been holding myself back until now... but I'm going to be just a little more selfish. Hehe, you've taught me some bad habits, %usernameusernameuserna%-san...♪
Speech.叶えたい願いを、わたくしは自分で決められるのでしょうか。……決めてもいいのだと、: Can I decide for myself what I wish for? ...I can believe you when you say it's all right for me to choose, can't I?
Speech.実は私は……全てを見通し、何もかもを読み取れる超能力者なのだったー！ ふははー！: The truth is... I'm a psychic who sees through everything and can read absolutely anything! Mwahaha! Just kidding... Did I fool you? It's April Fools' Day♪ ...I can't do quite that much, you know~.
Speech.新年あけましておめでとうございます……新年のお祝いに、今回こそ晴れ着を着たのです: Happy New Year... This time, I really did put on my festive best... But I got splashed with water on the way and had no change of clothes... That's why I'm in a swimsuit...
Speech.次はどこで待ち伏せをしようかしら……とびっきりのドキドキをあげて、素敵な夏の思い: Where should I lie in wait next...? I need to give you a real thrill and make this a wonderful summer memory...♪
Speech.水上スポーツ大会……わ、わたしなんか、絶対に向いてないです……で、でも……今回は: A water sports competition... S-Someone like me definitely isn't suited to that... B-But... this time, I have a reason to give it my all...!

Speech.水着姿だと、すっごく解放的な気分になれてキモチイイわ。ほら、あなたも脱いで。お互: Being in a swimsuit feels so wonderfully freeing. Come on, you undress too. Let's bare everything to each other?
Speech.波の音を聞いていると、心が落ち着きますね……少しのんびりして……あ、あれ？ そう: The sound of the waves is so soothing... Let me relax a little... H-Huh? Did I submit that paperwork...? Oh no! I forgot...!
Speech.海では何をしたら良いでしょうか……泳ぎに日光浴、夜には花火などもいいですね。です: What shall we do at the beach...? Swimming, sunbathing, maybe fireworks at night. But most of all, I want my friends in the Disciplinary Committee to have a chance to relax...
Speech.皆さんと一緒にいる時間は本当にかけがえのないもので……わたくしはいつしか、ここか: My time with everyone is truly irreplaceable... And somewhere along the way, I found myself not wanting to leave...
Speech.短冊には『この夏、皆と安全に海を楽しめますように』と書きました。水着を着てはしゃ: I wrote, "I hope we can all enjoy the sea safely this summer." There's nothing wrong with having fun in a swimsuit, but letting discipline slip and causing an accident at sea would be terrible.
Speech.砂浜を歩くのは足が取られて、普段とは勝手が違いますね。さっきもこけそうになって…: Walking on the sand throws my footing off. It's different from what I'm used to. I nearly fell earlier... Um, could I lean on your shoulder for a moment?
Speech.私、可愛いメモとか手帳を揃えるのが好きなんだ！%usernameusername: I love collecting cute memo pads and planners! Do you have any recommendations, %usernameusernameuserna%-san? If you do, I'd love to hear them!
Speech.私自身、喧嘩とか苦手なんだけど……誰かが仲悪いのを見てるのも苦手なの。だから、皆: I'm not good with arguments myself... But I don't like seeing people at odds with each other, either. So I started doing whatever I could to help everyone live peacefully... and Olga-san invited me to join the team.
Speech.誕生日おめでとう。あなたの欲望に応えるために、水着で駆け付けたわよ。うふふ、どん: Happy birthday. I rushed over in my swimsuit to answer your desires. Hehe, I'll make even your naughtiest wishes come true...♪
Speech.誕生日のお祝い、ありがとうございます。本来なら知り合いのレストランにでも行くとこ: Thank you for celebrating my birthday. Normally, we'd go to a restaurant I know, but dressed like this... Would you walk with me on the sand for a little while? That's what I'm in the mood for.
Speech.誕生日を祝ってくれるなんて、嬉しいわ。プレゼントは、そうね……一緒に海で遊んでも: I'm happy you're celebrating my birthday. As for a present, let's see... Perhaps you could come play at the beach with me. Just the two of us, of course♪
Speech.謹んで新春のお慶びを申し上げます。ふふ、この姿で言われるとは思わなかったでしょう: I respectfully offer you my best wishes for the New Year. Hehe, you weren't expecting to hear that from me dressed like this, were you? Seeing that surprised face is satisfying enough.
Speech.近頃は伝統的なドレスにこだわらず、新しい衣装を選ぶ方も増えているそうですが……も: Apparently, more people are choosing new kinds of wedding outfits instead of traditional dresses... Perhaps someday we'll even see swimsuit weddings. What do you think?
Speech.開放的な時間というのは、とても楽しいものですね……ふふ、わたくしも実家では、厳し: It really is lovely to have time to let loose... Hehe, back home, my days were filled with strict study and training... It's been a long time since I could spread my wings.
Speech.風紀委員会でのクリスマスパーティーにサンタの衣装で参加の予定でしたが、委員長の手: I was planning to wear a Santa outfit to the Disciplinary Committee's Christmas party, but apparently a mix-up by the chair left me with this...
Speech.あけましておめでとう、おにいちゃん。おへやの中、ぽかぽかするから水着きてみた。ん: Happy New Year, Onii-chan. It was warm inside the room so I tried putting on a swimsuit. Nn... but like this it's too cold outside, so I can't go on a helpful walk.
Speech.おにいちゃん、おたんじょうびおめでとー。プレゼントは、リディアがかいたえにっきだ: Onii-chan, happy birthday~! The present is a picture diary drawn by Lydia. There are lots of pages where Onii-chan is smiling. Let's look at it together from the beginning.
Speech.おにいちゃん、まだ帰ってこない。リディア、水着のまま待ってたら、ちょっとさむくな: Onii-chan isn't back yet. Lydia waited in her swimsuit, and it started getting a little cold. When he comes back, I want Onii-chan to hug me tight and warm me up.

Speech.あけましておめでとう。ジーナは、堅苦しいのは嫌いだから～って、こういうお祝い事は: Happy New Year. Gina says she dislikes formal atmosphere, so she leaves these celebrations entirely to me. I wish she'd come out once in a while.
Speech.いつも代わりに戦ってもらってばかりで……本当はもっとジーナの力になりたい。だから: Always having you fight in my place... Honestly I want to be of more help to Gina. So I'll work harder too. Will you watch over me by my side?

Speech.と、トリックオアトリート……ええっと、その……お菓子は、持ってる？ジーナは力で奪: Tr-Trick or treat... Umm, so... do you have treats? Gina says to take them by force... but I think I'd rather eat them together, just the two of us.
Speech.はっ、はっ、はっ……|……ええい、くしゃみが出そうで出ないぞ！ なんとかしてくれ: 哈，哈，哈……|……哎呀，鼻子痒得要命却打不出来！快想想办法啊，%usernameusernameuserna%！
