Speech.わ、私の誕生日祝いですか？ ありがとうございますっ……！えっ、何でも欲しいものを: A-A birthday celebration for me...? Thank you so much...! Eh, tell you whatever I want? In that case... could you stay by my side all day today?
Speech.チェック、オールグリーン……[2]|全火器、並びに遠隔攻撃端末『ストレラ』の待機: Check, all green... | All weapons, as well as the remote attack terminal 'Strela', have been confirmed to transition to standby mode. | Yes, with this we can begin combat at any time... I'll be relying on your strength, Mother.
Speech.ト、トリックオアトリート……！ あ、あの、お菓子をいただければと……！え？ もっ: T-Trick or treat...! U-Umm, I was hoping to get some treats...! Eh? I should be more confident? T-Trick or treat! ...Ugh, this is tough.
Speech.トリック・オア・トリート……このように、もう一度です。今度は迫力を出すイメージで: Trick or treat... Like this, try it once more. This time, imagine projecting impact. | T-Trick or treat! Ugh... As expected, I can't pull it off smoothly like Mother does...
Speech.ナージャ、新しいスーツには慣れましたか？ 着心地に違和感などあれば言ってください: Nadja, have you gotten used to the new suit? Tell me if there's any discomfort in how it fits. | Thank you, Mother. I'm fine... although it's a little embarrassing.
Speech.ナージャ、誕生日おめでとうございます。またひとつ年を重ね、大きくなりましたね。[: Nadja, happy birthday. You've grown another year older and bigger. | Yes! But... when will I ever become a wonderful woman like Mother...
Speech.バレンタインのお返しを、私とお母様に？ わあ、ありがとうございます……！[3]|: A Valentine's return gift for both me and Mother? Wow, thank you so much...! | Since we're here, shall we eat them together? I'll go prepare some tea, so please wait here with Nadja.
Speech.バレンタインの返礼ですか……律義な人ですね、ありがたく受け取ります。\nせっかく:
情人节的回礼吗……真是个守规矩的人呢，我就心怀感激地收下了。
难得有这个机会，我们就一起吃吧。我现在去泡茶。|
Speech.他の校舎の皆さんと話していると、ザルトゥームは広いんだなって思います。行ったこと: Talking with everyone from other school buildings makes me realize how vast Zartum truly is. Places I've never been, food I've never tasted... Just listening to them sparks my interest.
Speech.嘘をつく日をうまく活用できれば、欺瞞作戦の対策になるのではと思い、計画を立ててい: I was devising a plan thinking that if we utilized a day meant for lying effectively, it could serve as counter-measures against deception operations. However, Nadja and the others from Krasna told me that's not what the day is for...
Speech.嘘をつく日を利用して、全部隊に欺瞞情報を撒き、対応訓練を行いたいのですが……[2: I want to take advantage of the day for lying to scatter false intel to all units and conduct response training... | Umm... I don't think April Fools' is that kind of day, though...?
Speech.外の世界に触れたナージャが、これからどのように成長していくのか。あなたも一緒に見: How will Nadja grow from now on, having touched the outside world? Will you watch over her together with me?
Speech.実は……私ナージャの方が母親で、オ、オルガが娘だったんです！……す、すみません。: Actually... I, Nadja, am the mother, and O-Olga was the daughter! ...S-Sorry. No matter how you look at it, that lie was way too unreasonable. Plus it's rude to Mother.
Speech.新型の複座式、訓練は十分にこなしましたが、実戦となるとやっぱり緊張します。[3]: I've practiced enough with the new tandem-seat unit, but when it comes to actual combat, I still get nervous. | It's alright, Nadja, I'm by your side. The two of us should be able to overcome any difficulty.
Speech.機体の反応は……よし。[3]|最終シミュレーションと、齟齬ありません。反応のズレ: Unit responsiveness is... good. | There are no discrepancies with the final simulation. Reaction latency is well within acceptable limits. | It is the trump card created for this decisive battle, so it had better be.
Speech.私と%usernameusernameuserna%で用意したクリスマスプレゼン: This is a Christmas present prepared by %usernameusernameuserna% and me. Please accept it. | Woah... Thank you so much! To think I'd get to spend Christmas with the three of us feels like a dream...
Speech.私とナージャで、それぞれチョコレートを作りました。どうぞ受け取ってください。[2: Nadja and I made chocolates individually. Please accept them. | We made sure to make different flavors, so I want you to compare them. I think both turned out delicious.
Speech.私の誕生日、ですか。特に祝い事だと思ったことはありませんね。しかし、あなたに祝福: My birthday, is it? I have never thought of it as a particular cause for celebration. However, being blessed by you... doesn't feel half bad.
Speech.私の願いは……短冊に書き星に託すというよりは、自分の行動で叶えるものです。[2]: My wish... rather than writing it on a paper strip to entrust to the stars, is something I will fulfill through my own actions. | Yes. Fighting and claiming victory ourselves feels much more like our Krasna style.
Speech.誕生日おめでとうございます。ナージャと相談し、プレゼントも用意しました。……今後: Happy birthday. After consulting with Nadja, we prepared a present for you. ...Please continue to cherish Nadja in the future. She will be very happy as well.
Speech.願い事……前と変わりません。レドフカのために尽力し、ナージャが幸せに暮らせる世界: My wish... remains unchanged from before. To devote myself to Redovka and build a world where Nadja can live happily. And precisely for that reason—we must unite now and fight for the future.
Speech.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……まだ戻ってないんですね。: %usernameusernameuserna%-san... isn't back yet. Then I can practice while I wait... On your next day off, if you'd like, would you join me... Is that too formal? Uuugh, I'm only asking him out, so why am I so nervous...?
Speech.……え？ ホワイトデーだし、いつものお礼も兼ねて、欲しいものならなんでもくれる…: ...Huh? Since it's White Day, and to thank me for everything, you'll give me anything I want...? You can't take that back, you know? I might get greedy and ask for 'all sorts of things'... Hehe.
Speech.あ、あのっ……！|いえ……なんでもありません。い、いつかちゃんとお伝えします。: U-Um...!|No... It's nothing. S-Someday, I'll tell you properly.
Speech.えへへ、星が綺麗ですっ。|こうやってふたりで夜空を見れるような平和がこれからも続: Ehehe, the stars are beautiful!|I hope things stay peaceful, so we can keep looking at the night sky together like this.
Speech.お誕生日おめでとうございますっ！ その……今日って他の誰かと約束してますか？ …: Happy birthday! Um... Do you have plans with anyone else today? ...Huh? Not yet...? Th-Then... would you like to go out now? So we can celebrate, just the two of us.
Speech.この服、どうでしょう……？ 普段より少しだけおしゃれにしてみたんです。べ、別に誰: What do you think of this outfit...? I tried dressing up a little more than usual. I-It's not because I have plans to go out with anyone... Um, could you just tell me whether it suits me?
Speech.す、少しだけわがままを言ってもいいですか？ %usernameusernameu: C-Could I be a little selfish? %usernameusernameuserna%-san... could I have １ day of your time? I'd like us to take it easy together, just the two of us.
Speech.もし今度、少し遠くまで出かけるとしたら……どんな場所がいいですか？ いえ、参考に: If we went a little farther afield next time... what sort of place would you like? No, I'm just asking for reference! I-It's not like I'm making any plans!
Speech.クリスマスって、大切なことを伝えるにはいい日だとは思いませんか？ 私はまだそこま: Don't you think Christmas is a good day to tell someone something important? I don't think I'm ready for that yet... But instead, there's just one thing. Could you save a little time for me on your next day off?
Speech.ジューンブライド……ですね。私はまだそんな先のことより……まずは、大切な人に自分: June brides... Rather than thinking that far ahead... first, I want to find the courage... to tell someone important how I feel, in my own words.
Speech.ハロウィンのせいか、みんなの服がとても華やかです。私も何か仮装したほうがよろしい: Everyone's outfits are so colorful for Halloween. Should I wear a costume too...? Huh? I don't need one because this outfit's cute? Ehehe... Then I'll stay just as I am!
Speech.七夕のお願い事は、秘密です。でもちゃんと%usernameusernameuse: My Tanabata wish is a secret. But someday, %usernameusernameuserna%-san, you'll be the first person I tell. Because it's about our 'future' together...
Speech.今日はエイプリルフールですよね。%usernameusernameuserna%: It's April Fools' Day today, isn't it? %usernameusernameuserna%-san... what would you do if I said I'd like to go on a 'date'?
Speech.今日はバレンタインですね。こういう日ですし、私も少しくらい勇気を出してみようと思: It's Valentine's Day today. Since it's a special day, I thought I'd try being a little brave too. So, um... please give me a little of your time later. What we're going to do is still a secret!
Speech.各校区の復興もだいぶ進んできましたね。もし完全に日常が戻ったら……その……ま、ま: Reconstruction's come a long way in each school district, hasn't it? Once things are completely back to normal... um... w-would you like to go out together again?
Speech.新しい年が始まりましたね。今年は、今までより少しだけ勇気を出せる年にしたいです。: A new year's begun. This year, I want to be a little braver than before. ...For example, asking someone to go out with me. %usernameusernameuserna%-san... would you join me for the first shrine visit of the year?
Speech.（わっ……！ 目が合っちゃった……！）|（やっぱり私……%usernameuse: (Ah...! Our eyes met...!)|(I really do... like you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san...)
Speech.……まだ戻らないの？ じゃあ、その間に授業の資料でも読んでおくわ。学園に入ったば: ...Still not back? Then I'll read through the class materials in the meantime. Just because I newly joined the academy doesn't mean I'm comfortable spending my days knowing nothing.
Speech.あけましておめでとう。新年の挨拶ね……ここ最近、顔を合わせる相手が急に増えたわ。: Happy New Year. A New Year's greeting, huh... The number of people I meet face-to-face has suddenly grown lately. ...I'm not saying it's a hassle. They're comrades I fought alongside with, so I intend to handle this much properly.
Speech.ありがと。学園に入ってからの私は、知らないことばかりだけど、誕生日までこうしてあ: Thanks. Ever since entering the academy, there's been so much I didn't know, but having even my birthday celebrated by you like this... makes me feel like the days spent at Hiiragi School Building have truly become my own.
Speech.ありがとう……|あんたのおかげで、自由と未来を取り戻せた。こんなこと、今日くらい: Thank you...|Thanks to you, I was able to reclaim my freedom and my future. I'm only going to say something like this to you today.
Speech.あんたと私、ウワサになってるみたいよ。恋人なんじゃないかって……くすっ、驚いた？: There seem to be rumors going around about you and me. People wondering if we're lovers... Hehe, surprised? Of course it's a lie. But you don't look annoyed by it...? Hmmm...
Speech.せっかく制服着てるんだし、クリスマスはこの格好で写真を残すのも悪くないかも。……: Since I'm wearing a uniform, taking a photo in this outfit for Christmas might not be a bad idea. ...If you want to be in the photo too, don't make that face and just be honest about it.
Speech.な、何よ……じっとこっち見て……|あんたに見つめられると……その……な、なんでも: W-What is it... staring at me like that...|When you gaze at me like that... um... N-Never mind!!
Speech.ホワイトデー……私はそういうのに疎いし、興味ないけど……あ、あんたはどうするつも: White Day... I'm ignorant about those kinds of things and don't care about them, but... w-what do you plan to do? I just thought I'd ask! Huh...? You prepared properly? H-Hehe, well of course you did!
Speech.仮装？ この格好のままで十分よ。お姉ちゃんと同じ顔なんだから、見間違えたやつを驚: Costumes? Staying like this is more than enough. I have the exact same face as my sister, so I could probably shock anyone who mistakes me for her. ...I don't actually plan on doing that, though.
Speech.前は放課後に友達と寄り道するなんて、自分には縁がないと思ってた。でも今は、そうい: I used to think hanging out with friends after school had nothing to do with me. But now, I think I'd like to try living that kind of ordinary academy life too. ...Kick your butt if you laugh.
Speech.双頭の斧のアジトにも時々顔を出してるわ。ストリートの治安を守ったり、行き場のない: I drop by the Twin-Headed Axe hideout occasionally. They seem to be properly active, keeping order on the streets and taking in kids with nowhere to go. I just don't like how they tease me about my school uniform.
Speech.柊校舎を歩いてると、日に日に、色んな人に挨拶されるようになって……まだ慣れないけ: Walking through Hiiragi School Building, day by day, more and more people greet me... I'm still not used to it, but places I didn't know are gradually becoming part of my daily routine. This kind of thing isn't bad either.
Speech.校舎では、バレンタインが近づくとみんな妙にそわそわするのね。何よ、あんたまでこっ: In the school building, everyone gets strangely restless as Valentine's Day approaches. What is it, don't you look over here too. Whether you'll get anything from me is... a secret until the moment comes. I won't tell you even if you ask.
Speech.短冊に、お姉ちゃんと毎日一緒に登校できますように……って、書くわけないでしょ！: Writing 'I wish I could go to school with my sister every day' on a paper strip... Like I'd ever write that! I only thought about it for a second. Forget it if you saw it. Don't go reading people's wishes without permission.
Speech.結婚？ 今の私には先の話すぎるわ。まずは今の生活に慣れるので手いっぱい。……まあ: Marriage? That's way too far off for me right now. I have my hands full just getting used to my current life. ...Well, but if you don't treat it as 'far off'... that's... a different story, though.
Speech.誕生日なんでしょ。おめでとう。学園に来てからも世話になってるし、今日は%user: It's your birthday, right? Happy Birthday. You've been looking after me since I came to the academy, so today I'll hang out with you, %usernameusernameuserna%. ...What's with that happy face? Don't get carried away.
Speech.風が気持ちいい……|こんなゆったりした時間……本当久しぶりね。なんだか空気が美味: The wind feels nice...|It's been so long since I had such a relaxing time. Somehow, even the air tastes good.

Description.メイズ大深度での指揮統制に特化した機体。\n急遽導入が決定され運用試験中。\nそ:
A machine specialized for command and control in the deep Maze.
Its introduction was decided on short notice, and it is currently undergoing operational testing.
To verify its effectiveness, its fire-control system is sealed.
Mechanisms of unknown purpose can be seen in its details, apparently because it is still unfinished.
Incidentally, its pet name was given by Student Council President Shiouten Kagura.
Description.アマツ初の純正メイズガーダー。アマツは他地区製ＭＧをライセンス生産していたが、メ: Amatsu's first domestically produced Maze Guarder. Amatsu had been license-producing MGs from other regions, but since Maze exploration is an inter-regional competition, it changed policy on the judgment that the key MG must be domestic. However, the new model could not meet the high required specifications and its completion was delayed, so this unit—an experimental demonstrator—was introduced as a stopgap. Also, because the performance gap between the old and new models is large, it also serves as their trainer. There seems to have been quite a commotion over giving it a name crowned with 'Amatsu's dawn.'
Description.低コスト重視で生み出されたメイズガーダー。メイズ内の環境は多岐に渡り、未踏域で現: A Maze Guarder created with a focus on low cost. The environments within the Maze are diverse, and it is unknown whether current MGs can operate in unexplored regions, so the gist of the concept is to devote the held-down cost to producing modified units adapted to each environment and switch them over without delay. Its expandability is poor, but this is a deliberate trade-off based on the assumption that new environments will be harsher than before and a mere function expansion won't suffice. It is small in stature but highly designed and has a strong presence; it does not come across as cheap.
Description.ベース機から改修を重ねた実証実験機。\nベース機の外観を保ちつつ内部は全く別物と:
An experimental demonstrator built up through repeated modifications from a base model.
While retaining the base model's exterior, its internals are so different they might as well be a separate machine in terms of performance.
Separately, there is also a unit that adds modules to the base model to improve performance at low cost, and the development team is competing hard for official adoption.
Description.ノヴァセレスの特徴である貴族階級が生み出した機体。\nドロテア・カークランド率い:
A machine created by the noble class that is characteristic of Nova Celes.
Because it is for the team led by Dorothea Kirkland, the Kirkland family took the lead in completing a stalled development plan.
It is a no-expense-spared, 'all-in' machine—an extremely luxurious piece. Its performance is also second to none within the academy.
Description.ザルトゥーム学園所有の練習機。\nメイズ探索の黎明期、過酷な環境に適応するためベ:
A training machine owned by Zartum Academy.
It is one of many derivatives made from the base model to adapt to harsh environments during the dawn of Maze exploration, and through repeated modifications it left many achievements over a long period.
Even now that it has been retired, it is said that in the right hands it can still hold its own in active service.
Description.治安維持用のＭＧで風紀委員会が搭乗する。輝映の系譜でありベースは旧型機だが、長年: An MG for maintaining public order, piloted by the Disciplinary Committee. It is of the Kiei lineage and its base is an old model, but through years of modifications specializing in mobility and output improvements, it is said that in one respect it rivals even the newest machines. However, it is a peaky machine that is accordingly selective about its pilot.
Description.『パスファインダー』の名はチーム『トリニティ・ジュエル』のリーダー・レイヴェルの: The name 'Pathfinder' was given by Ravel, leader of the team 'Trinity Jewel.' It was praised as satisfying both the freedom/frontier spirit that LOC advocates and the identity of Ravel herself, who is also a famous model. The unit is a large machine over 20 m tall, conveying the strength of someone standing at the front and pioneering the Maze. The canards (auxiliary wings) on the shoulders, chest, and so on are meant to give the large machine high mobility, and are said to be energy-efficient as well.
Description.アマツ製ＭＧ。開発の遅れにより先に本機の実証実験機『黎明』が導入されていたが、よ: An Amatsu-made MG. Due to development delays, this unit's experimental demonstrator 'Reimei' had been introduced first, but at last it saw the light of day. Amatsu fell behind in developing domestic machines, but this one is finished with high performance even compared to other regions' machines. Concerns include poor expandability and poor maintainability, which are trade-offs for meeting the high required specifications, and are also related to the fact that the introduction could not be postponed any longer.
Description.四王天神楽が極秘に開発したワンオフ機。メイズ深層で発見された１万年程前のものとさ: A one-off machine secretly developed by Shiouten Kagura. It was built with reference to the analysis results of a 'mysterious machine' discovered deep in the Maze, believed to be about 10000 years old. Theoretically its potential is extremely high, but because it was developed in secret there was almost no tuning time, and it is said that even a skilled pilot can only draw out 80% of its performance (which is still on par with other MGs). Its villain-like appearance is by Kagura's instruction, though it is unclear whether that's a hobby or a joke.
Description.オベレーグの名は『護符』『魔除け』を意味するが、製作者がこの機体に込めた『護る』: The name Obereg means 'talisman' or 'ward against evil,' but perhaps the 'protecting' its creator put into this machine refers to protection through melee combat. Its feet (instep and heel) are fitted with wheels boasting high torque via dedicated motors installed at the knees, and by skillfully adjusting the output of small boosters mounted on its back flight unit, it can fly, leap, and run freely throughout the Maze. Incidentally, its overall shape is said to be inspired by an insect.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。搭乗する純夏達は: A machine resembling an MG, built with technology that does not exist in Zartum. Those who ride it—Sumika and the others—call it a Tactical Frame. Its control system also uses technology different from an MG's, and Zartum Academy's pilots cannot operate it. As its form suggests, its mobility is well suited to three-dimensional mobile combat in confined spaces like the Maze. It is a humanoid machine of such high completion that it seems all waste has been stripped away, and according to its pilot it is easier to handle than its performance suggests. Its fixed armament is a short blade stored in knife sheaths on both arms. Its main armament includes an 'assault gun' consisting of a 36mm chain gun and a 120mm smoothbore gun, a super-carbon 'long sword,' a shield, and missile containers.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。不知火に近しい部: A machine resembling an MG, built with technology that does not exist in Zartum. While it shares parts in common with the Shiranui, its mobility is of an even higher order. The Tactical Frame's body is centered on a 'carbon actuator,' an electromagnetic telescopic carbon band that expands and contracts depending on voltage; its power is supplied by the machine's main engine, composed of storage batteries and a magnesium fuel cell; and for jumping and flight it uses the jet-jump system mounted at the waist—commonly called the 'jump unit,' which functions as both a jet engine and a rocket motor. This purple Takemikazuchi has both of its maximum outputs boosted by over 70% compared to the Shiranui, and operating it demands high skill that grasps the machine's characteristics. For some reason, it is locked to restrict its pilot to Mitsurugi Meiya.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。ある傑作機の上位: A machine resembling an MG, built with technology that does not exist in Zartum. Developed aiming to be a superior version of a certain masterpiece, with uncompromising technology and materials poured into it. Controlling the machine is extremely difficult, and its procurement and maintenance costs are very high, but in close-quarters mobile melee combat it boasts peak performance. Because it was originally designed on the premise of highly trained, hand-picked pilots and mechanics, its handling and maintainability are compromised to a degree, and mastering it demands very high skill that grasps the machine's characteristics. Once, a prototype was thrown into actual combat mid-defense, and a bright-yellow unit is said to have been delivered to a certain expeditionary base.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。2機造られた、と: A machine resembling an MG, built with technology that does not exist in Zartum. The 2nd unit of a certain demonstrator, of which 2 were built. For comparative testing with the 1st unit, the high-output engine mounted in the waist's jet-jump system (jump unit) is different from the 1st unit's. So it can be distinguished from the 1st unit at a glance, it was painted in a color scheme based on dark purple-gray. After fighting through harsh drills, numerous battles, and life-or-death struggles with unknown enemies, it was heavily damaged in a certain battle and once slated for disposal, but by gathering the remaining spare parts, it was miraculously reassembled.
Description.ザルトゥームに存在しない技術で造られている、MGによく似た機体。ある傑作機を最新: A machine resembling an MG, built with technology that does not exist in Zartum. It was born from a plan to raise a certain masterpiece to performance on par with the latest generation. Previous modified machines had the problem of costing more than building new ones, but this machine succeeds in efficient performance enhancement by making use of the existing machine's structure while replacing electronic armaments and adding modules. Its major feature is improved mobility: thruster units were added to the shoulder armor blocks and the back armament rack, and the waist's jet-jump system (jump unit) was also replaced with a high-output one. In addition, the head sensor was improved to enhance precision artillery capability during high-speed cruising, and its shape has changed greatly from the original machine.
Description.エクスプローラーに試作兵装を搭載した対イザナミ決戦機Ⅰ型。機体バランスは最悪で、: A Type I anti-Izanami decisive battle machine with prototype armaments mounted on an Explorer. Its balance is terrible, and no one but Julia can operate it properly. The EN cannon mounted on the shoulders' rear is originally a long-range rifle, but it took its current form due to Julia's strong demand: 'I want to hold an EN shotgun (with an EN saber) in my hands, and it looks cool on my back!' Both are armaments packed with the cream of Scala's technology, but she rarely even listens to the explanation, so the engineers' feelings are apparently complicated.
Description.エクスプローラーに試作兵装を搭載した対イザナミ決戦機Ⅱ型。両肩部リアに装着した巨: A Type II anti-Izanami decisive battle machine with prototype armaments mounted on an Explorer. It feeds ammunition to the 40mm multi-barrel gatlings on both arms from huge magazines mounted on the rear of both shoulders. Its performance: rate of fire 300-900 rounds/min variable, normal fire 600 rounds/min, maximum fire 1,200 rounds/min, effective range 1.5-3 km—the first in Zartum to reach such performance. Including the front shoulder armor, the weight increase is considerable, making it a machine that abandoned mobility and poured everything into firepower.
Description.レドフカで開発された試作機。複座型で1名は機体制御、もう1名は『ストレラ』と呼ば: A prototype developed in Redfka. It is a two-seater: 1 crew member controls the machine, and the other controls remote attack terminals called 'Strela.' Each Strela carries its own dedicated AI and moves on its own judgment, but overall management must be done by a human. Incidentally, the Strela display strange behavior that ignores gravity. This is said to apply the latest gravity-control technology that has advanced in recent years, but the details are a mystery. Perhaps because of this, their operation is also somewhat unstable, and the skill of the control operator is put to the test.

Description.エリア35以上でアグレッシブ属性のみクリアでレリック【(UR)ブースト（アグレッ: Clearing Area 35 or higher with Aggressive-attribute units only allows the Relic [(UR) Boost (Aggressive)] to be discovered in the Shop.

Description.やりぃ♪ じゃあ、遠慮なく！ パフェの専門店、パンケーキ、ステーキハウス ぜーん: Yay♪ Then I won't hold back! Parfait specialty shop, pancakes, steakhouse—I'm going to ALL of them!
Description.あっ、そうだ、思い出した。いいもの見せてあげる。\\nこれは結成してすぐに取って: Oh, right, I just remembered! Let me show you something nice.\nThis is a photo taken right after we formed. Look, look, isn't it cute?
Description.う～ん、すっごく柔らかいねぇ～、うりうりうり～。\\nきゃって、んっ、うぅう……: Mmm~ it's so super soft~, squish squish squish~.\nEek— wait, ngh, ugh... C-Chiyuru-san...
Description.やったやった！勝ったわ！勝ったわよ！ うん！みんな頑張ったよね！やったね！ この: Hooray, hooray! We won! We won! Yeah! Everyone worked so hard! We did it! I'm so glad to be in this team!
Description.……説明……ううん、普通のお化け屋敷じゃない、恐怖の館。ドキドキして、ちょっとハ: ...An explanation... No, it's not an ordinary haunted house; it's a house of horrors. Heart-pounding, a bit intense, and with a shocking twist at the end.
Description.わたしが食べさせてあげる！はい、これ！ あーん！\\nわわわっ！ す、純夏さん凄: I'll feed you! Here, take this! Say ahh!\nW-Wawa! S-Sumika-san, you're so bold! ...To actually feed me like this...!
Description.みんなのお願いごとをおたすけして、\\nえがおにしたい。みんなのえがお、とっても: I want to help with everyone's wishes and make them smile.\nEveryone's smiles feel so warm and cozy.
Description.……大丈夫です……\\nですが…………いつまで揉んでるんですか、変態。: ...I'm fine...\nHowever... just how long are you going to keep groper-ing me, you pervert?
Description.ふふ……誰かとカラオケに行くなどめったになくてな。\\nつい思い出して、立ち止ま: Fufu... I rarely go to karaoke with anyone.\nI just happened to remember and stopped in my tracks.
Description.翠蘭ちゃんがね、指揮官へのプレゼントは一番あげたいものがいいって！\\nだから私: Suiran-chan said that for a present to the Commander, it's best to give what you want to give the most!\nSo I'm giving you me~♪
Description.この、カオスメイデンというチームは……気づいたら、\\n私のことを知っても受け入: This team called Chaos Maidens... before I knew it, had become a precious place that accepted me even knowing who I was.
Description.一気に全部を知ってもらうんじゃなくて、\\n少しずつ今のわたしの『本当』をみんな: Rather than having everyone know everything all at once,\nI'll gradually convey my current "truth" to everyone—
Description.まだ見ていない景色は沢山ありますわ。\\nその時には……その、ご一緒してもよろし: There are still many sights I have yet to see.\nWhen the time comes... well, may I join you?
Description.私がアークトゥルスに相応しい実力を\\n備えていると判断していただけたからです。: Because you judged that I possess the ability fitting for Arcturus.
Description.ＭＧのことはもっとよく知っておきたいわね。\\n戦術機とすごく良く似てるけど、い: I'd like to learn more about MGs.\nThey're very similar to TSFs, but there seem to be various differences.
Description.本当に私ってば、ダメダメですね……\\n人を助けようとしたつもりが、一緒に助けら: I'm really useless, aren't I...\nI intended to help others, only to end up being saved right alongside them...
Description.うん、想像していたよりも遥かにいいな。\n皆の個性が出ていて、とてもよく似合って:
Yeah, it's far better than I imagined.
Everyone's individuality shines through, and it suits you all very well.
Description.『感度3000倍ぬるぬる液』発売中！ネットの海で出会ったとある２人――彼女達のノ: "3000x Sensitivity Slippery Liquid" now on sale! Born from the chemistry of two people who met in the sea of the internet—please try this new product out in maiden sumo.
Description.とりゃー！捕まえたぞ、犯人めー！\n皆から盗ったものを返せー！:
Toryaa! I caught you, you culprit!
Give back what you stole from everyone!
Description.もしあたしが勝ったら、あたしに心を込めて耳元で\n『愛してる』って囁くというのは: If I win, how about you whisper "I love you" into my ear with all your heart!
Description.皆そなたにいろいろ求めすぎなのじゃ。\nたまには休んでも誰も責めんよ。: Everyone expects too much of thee. Nobody will blame thee if thou takest a rest once in a while.
Description.大会がペア戦なのよ！ 私が勝つから、あんたはただ座ってればいいわ！: The tournament is a tag-team match! I'll win it, so you just sit there and relax!
Description.大賀「カリナ！こちらが似顔絵です！」 カリナ「...さすがいいんちょ～！」: Ooga: "Karina! Here is the portrait!" Karina: "...As expected of the Prez~!"
Description.あたしはこんなの滅多に着ないから、 今のうちにその目に焼き付けといたほうがいいよ: I rarely wear things like this, so you'd better burn this view into your eyes while you can~
Description.なっ！？ 先ほど巻き込んだことをまだ怒っているのか！？ あれはいつも我の逃げ先に: What!? Are you still angry about getting dragged into that earlier!? Elena, who was always at my escape route, is also to blame...!
Description.その……私……シリウスシュガーのみんなのために、もっと何かできることはないかな、: Um... I... was wondering if there was anything more I could do for everyone in Sirius Sugar...
Description.わたくしでよろしければ、喜んで。\\n１から花の扱い方を説明させていただきますわ: If you're fine with me, gladly.\nI shall explain how to handle flowers from step one.
Description.うわー、それはもったいないね！あたしと一緒に外に遊びに行こ！うん、そうしよう、け: Uwaa, that's such a waste! Come play outside with me! Yep, let's do that—it's decided!
Description.美少女に頼られて、おまえめっちゃラッキーじゃん！\\n……で！ 一緒に行くの！？: You're super lucky to be relied on by a pretty girl!\n...So! Are you coming with us or not!?
Description.シルバー系のものが可愛くて好き。\\n落ち着いた色だし……わたしの髪色にも合うか: I like silver things because they're cute.\nIt's a calm color... and it matches my hair color too.
Description.私を嫌い、悪し様に言う者もいる。\\nだが、私が悪者になることで、皆を守れるので: There are those who hate me and speak ill of me.\nHowever, if becoming the villain allows me to protect everyone, I don't care how much I am hated.
Description.あっ……こ、こ、こんにちはっ！お、お待ちしてました！！\\n部屋の前で待っていれ: Ah... H-H-Hello! I-I was waiting for you!!\nI thought if I waited in front of your room, you'd eventually come out...
Description.しゃらぁーっぷ！！ その名前を口にしないで！！\\n手帳の中、見たの！？ 見てな: Shut up!! Don't say that name!!\nDid you look inside my notebook!? Did you or didn't you!!?
Description.ちょ、ちょっと！ 何笑ってるのよ！？\\nぜ、絶対にいつか吠え面かかせてやるんだ: H-Hey, wait! What are you laughing at!?\nI-I'll definitely make you cry uncle someday, so prepare yourself!
Description.１度で全部聞いちゃうのはもったいないでしょ？……だから、またいつかデートに誘うわ: Isn't it a waste to hear everything all at once? ...So, I'll ask you out on a date again sometime. Tell me the rest slowly then, okay?
Description.今はこのエアガンがブームってわけ！\\n結構体を動かすし、パイロット活動の訓練に: Airsoft guns are all the rage right now!\nIt gets you moving quite a bit and serves as training for pilot activities too.
Description.まったく……仕方のない人ですね。\\n出口まで案内しますので、私について来てくだ: Goodness... You really are hopeless.\nI will guide you to the exit, so please follow me.
Description.もっともっと、制御しなければ！この快感を！ この昂りを！ この高揚を！もっと、私: I must control it more, much more! This pleasure! This excitement! This exhilaration! To make them even more mine!
Description.商店街にあるものを見て、これが１番欲しいって思ったの。\\nいつもは自分で買うけ: Looking at the things in the shopping district, I thought I wanted this the most.\nI usually buy things myself, but having someone buy it for me feels special.
Description.お願いだから……いなくならないでぇ……！\\n置いてかないで……あたしを、ひとり: Please... don't disappear...!\nDon't leave me behind... don't leave me all alone...!
Description.んむ……んぅ……すぅ、すぅ……\\n寝床を貸してもらうね。ここでなら、安心できる: Mmm... ngh... zzz, zzz...\nI'll borrow your bed, okay? I feel safe here.
Description.格好悪い行動は大嫌いで、仲間のことはとても大事で……\\n何ものにも囚われない、: I hate uncool actions, treasure my friends deeply...\nand I absolutely love the free-spirited gal vibes that aren't bound by anything!
Description.赤くない！ ゆ、夕日！ 夕日のせい！\\nもう……こんなの……コスパ……悪いのに: It's not red! I-It's the sunset! It's because of the sunset!\nGeez... even though doing this... has such bad... cost performance.
Description.この学園で頑張るつもり。だって、仲間や色々な人を笑顔にできるから…\\n期待して: I plan to work hard at this academy. Because I can make my friends and various people smile...\nLook forward to it, okay? Someday I'll sing for you, Commander.
Description.こういうファッションが趣味だからね♪\\nしっかりキミをコーディネートしてあげる: Fashion like this is my hobby, after all♪\nI'll make sure to style you properly.
Description.ほら、はーやーくー。いいからいいから、早く部屋に帰るわよ。ハイヨー！後輩クン！: Come on, hurry up~. It's fine, it's fine, let's head back to our room quickly. Giddy-up, underclassman-kun!
Description.こちらのお店のお洋服、とても素敵です！見てください、どれも可愛い……！ふふっ、見: The clothes at this shop are so wonderful! Look, every single one is so cute...! Fufu, just looking at them makes my heart flutter.
Description.ははは、あたしらしくないだろ？こんな風に悩んでるなんてさ。\\n悪いな、こんな情: Hahaha, it's not like me, right? Worrying like this.\nSorry for showing you such a pathetic side of me.
Description.喧嘩をするのは仕方ないよ。リリーだってするからね。\\nでも、殴ったり叩いたりす: Fights are unavoidable sometimes. Even Lily gets into them.\nBut hitting or slapping is definitely wrong!
Description.またもや人に籠絡されてしまうなんて……\\nわたくし、スパイの才能がないのかもし: To be won over by someone yet again...\nI might not have any talent for being a spy.
Description.――ここだっ！ あれぇ？ ここにいたと思ったのにぃ…… ねえ、どこにいるの～！？: —Right here! Huh? I thought you were here... Hey, where are you~!? Hey, I'm talking to you~!
Description.そうそう。そうやって走れば疲れが減るわ。 \\nもしわからなければ、何度だって聞: That's it. Running like that reduces fatigue.\nIf you don't get it, feel free to ask me as many times as you need.
Description.お世話になっている指揮官さんへ。感謝の気持ちをお届けです！ これからも末永くよろ: To the Commander who always takes care of me. Delivering my feelings of gratitude! Please continue to take good care of me for a long time to come♪
Description.お、お着替えをしてるだけですから、そんな大変な事になったりしませんよ！: I-I'm just changing my clothes, so nothing crazy like that is going to happen!
Description.え？ そうだよ。そのために資料とか道具とか全部ベッドの上に持ってきたんだから。: Huh? Yeah, that's right. That's why I brought all the documents and tools onto the bed.
Description.こんな風にゆっくりするのもいいね……みんなと過ごすのももちろんだけど。\\nわた: Relaxing like this is nice too... though spending time with everyone is great, of course.\nI'd like to be alone with Takeru-chan again.
Description.ここから見える景色は……まさに平和だな。\\n私はこの景色を知らない……だが、そ: The view from here... is truly peaceful.\nI don't know this scenery... but I feel like I was fighting in pursuit of it.
Description.えっ？ ……これって、雑貨屋で売ってたぬいぐるみ……！たけるさん……これ……いい: Huh? ...Isn't this the stuffed animal sold at the general store...! Takeru-san... is this... really okay? For me to take it...
Description.私は、基本のヘアセットやメイクくらいなら自分でやる。\\n自分でできることは自分: I do my own basic hair styling and makeup.\nI try to do things myself whenever I can.
Description.ううぅ～ん……むにゃむにゃ……\\nえへへ……美味しい……もう……食べられない…: Mmm... mumble mumble...\nEhehe... so tasty... I can't... eat anymore...
Description.星と月しかない。\\n……でも、この６人で一緒に見る夜空は特別で、ちょっと違う気: There are only stars and the moon.\n...But watching the night sky together with the six of us feels special and a little different.
Description.フィーちゃん、勝負だよ～～～～！！\\n……と見せかけて、アニスちゃんにえーいっ: Fii-chan, let me challenge you~~~~!!\n...Or so you thought—take this, Anise-chan!
Description.抜け駆けの独り占めはよくないけど……\\nせめて、今この時間くらいは、いいよね…: Stealing a march to keep you to myself isn't good, but...\nat least for this moment right now, it's okay, right...?
Description.……改めて、綺麗ね。真っ暗な中で揺れるろうそくって。\\n安心するというか、落ち: ...Looking at it again, it's beautiful. A candle flickering in the pitch darkness.\nIt's reassuring, or rather, calming.
Description.おまえみたいなザーコ、ラミがいなきゃ何もできないんだから。\\nしゃーなしで……: A weakling like you can't do anything without Rami, after all.\nGuess I have no choice... I'll keep taking care of you from now on.
Description.ぽやぽやする……\\nおにいちゃんのなでなで、リディアの一番さん。: Feeling all fluffy...\nOnii-chan's headpats are Lydia's absolute favorite.
Description.はーい、ふたりともそこまでー。\\n道端でケンカしないの。他に歩いている人達いる: Alright, both of you, that's enough.\nDon't fight on the roadside. There are other people walking by, you know?
Description.ねえねえ、それよりどう？ 似合う？\\nホント？ 見飽きてない？: Hey, hey, more importantly, how is it? Does it suit me?\nReally? You're not sick of looking at it?
Description.な、なんでぇ～！？ちゃんと練習もしてるし、\\n普段から特訓だって……いだぁああ: W-Why~!? I've been practicing properly,\nand I do special training all the time... Owwwww!!?
Description.お姉ちゃんとして……弟と妹には、\\nカッコいい姿を見せてあげたいなーって思うの: As an older sister... I want to show my younger brother and sister a cool side of myself.
Description.こんな麺料理、初めて見ました。\\n見ているだけでも、わくわくしてしまいます！: I've never seen a noodle dish like this before.\nJust looking at it makes me so excited!
Description.……はぁ、まったく。\\nあたしが必要じゃなくなるまでは面倒をみてやるよ。: ...Sigh, geez.\nI'll look after you until you don't need me anymore.
Description.起きなさい、白銀！\\nもうとっくに約束の時間は過ぎてるわよ！: Wake up, Shirogane!\nThe promised time has already long passed!
Description.タケルもきっと驚くよ！じゃあ見ててね！\\nまずはこうやって後ろから前に紐を渡し: Takeru will definitely be surprised too! Okay, watch this!\nFirst, you pass the string from back to front like this...
Description.携帯食にもバッチリ。冷めてても美味しい。完璧。: Perfect as portable rations too. Delicious even when cold. Flawless.
Description.ある意味裸よりも恥ずかしい格好だから、\\n最初何かの間違いなんじゃないかって驚: It's an outfit more embarrassing than being naked in a way,\nso I was shocked at first, thinking there must be some mistake...
Description.実戦になったら、迷ったりしてる余裕なんてない……\\n今の内に上手く使えるように: In actual combat, there won't be time to hesitate...\nI need to get good at using it while I still can.
Description.行くところがないんでしょ？\\nそれなら私が『行くところ』を用意してあげる。: You have nowhere to go, right?\nThen I'll prepare a "place to go" for you.
Description.私、ワガママって初めて言ったから。\nきっと本当はもっと早く、言ってもよかったん:
That was the first time I've ever spoken selfishly.
I guess I really could have said it much sooner, right...?
Description.……リリーがジャスティオンに変えてもらったみたいに、\nその人をもっと良い方向に:
...Just as Lily was changed by Justion,
I want to guide that person in a better direction too.
Description.カリナ「絵上手いね～。ウチといいんちょ、こんなふうに見られてるんだぁ」\\n真桜: Karina: "You're good at drawing~ So that's how people view me and the Prez."\nMao: "Naughty stuff is a disciplinary violation! Wait, why are you uploading that without permission!?"
Description.マスター！ ボクが清書しましたよー！: Master! I inked the final copy!
Description.普段はしーっかりとサボって、\n必要な時にはバーンって活躍するくらいでいいんだか:
Slacking off properly on regular days,
and making a splash when it really counts is totally fine.
Description.す、すみません！ ご迷惑をおかけして……\nその、あまり動かれると……そ、その…: I-I'm sorry! For causing you trouble...\nUm, if you move too much... t-that's...
Description.さすがにあなたに迷惑を掛けるくらいなら、\nこの程度の勝負、私が受けて立ちますよ:
If it's going to cause you trouble, then
I'll accept a match of this level myself.
Description.別にふたりして同じロッカーに\n入らなくてもよかったですよね……:
We didn't really need to get into
the same locker together, did we...
Description.え……えっと、その……あの……\n……すみません。あまり話をできなくて。: U-Um, well... that is...\n...I'm sorry. I couldn't talk with you very much.
Description.娘の希望で『グリズリームーン』に変身しています。\n――クマに代わって、オシオキ:
I'm transforming into "Grizzly Moon" at my daughter's request.
—In the name of the bear, I shall punish you!
Description.私は今、ハリエットじゃない……\nハリエットじゃないから、恥ずかしくない……:
Right now, I'm not Harriet...
Because I'm not Harriet, I'm not embarrassed...
Description.ボクは後悔したくない！ ケイとハリィ。\n大切になった友達とやり残したことを作り:
I don't want to have regrets! Kei and Harrie.
I don't want to leave unfinished business with friends who became so important to me!
Description.『この剣にかけて、貴方を襲うあらゆるものを打ち払いましょう。\nこの心臓にかけて: "Upon this sword, I swear to strike down anything that attacks you.\nUpon this heart, I swear to remain by your side."
Description.あ、ああ、いえ……申し訳ありません、この世界の…… その、商品名に不慣れなもので: A-Ah, no... I am deeply sorry, I am unfamiliar with... well, product names in this world.
Description.うるさいって何だうるさいって！ あたしは……ちょっと考えが変わっただけだ！: What do you mean, annoying!? I... just had a slight change of mind, that's all!
Description.大人しくして。 ……これ以上、乱暴なことはしたくないわ。: Be quiet. ...I don't want to do anything more violent than this.
Description.もうすぐ夏なのでスイカ割りなんていかがでしょうか！ 夏らしいアマネさん素敵ですね: Summer is coming soon, so how about splitting watermelons! Amane-san looking summery is wonderful!
Description.や、やめてください！ 私の記憶にもないような昔の話など恥ずかしいことを言うのは！: P-Please stop! Bringing up embarrassing old stories that aren't even in my memory!
Description.ふふ……ダンスは勝負じゃないから、勝ち負けはないわよ？: Fufu... Dancing isn't a competition, so there's no winning or losing, you know?
Description.よく頑張ったのう……そなたのことは、 ちゃんと儂が見ておったぞい……: Thou hast worked hard... I was watching thee properly, thou knowest...
Description.ふぅ……いやあ、お客さん凝ってますねえ♪ もうガッチガチ！ 腕の振るいがいがある: Phew... My, customer, you're so stiff♪ Completely rock-solid! It makes it worth putting my skills to work!
Description.鳴滝七彩をリーダーとした落ちこぼれチーム。仲の良さならトップにも負けない。: A team of underachievers led by Nanairo Narutaki. When it comes to how well they get along, they won't lose to top teams.
Description.生駒葵をリーダーにした校舎内トップクラスチーム。規律の取れた連携が強み。: A top-class school team led by Aoi Ikoma. Disciplined teamwork is their main strength.
Description.リーダーのユリアの性格を反映したような自由さが売りの校舎内トップクラスチーム。: A top-class school team whose selling point is freedom, reflecting the personality of leader Julia.
Description.ドロテアをリーダーとした学園でも指折りのチーム。統率の取れたチームワークが強み。: One of the top teams in the academy, led by Dorothea. Well-organized teamwork is their strength.
Description.フルートをリーダーとしたチーム。全員がパイロット以外に別の肩書きを持つ。: A team led by Flute. Every member holds another title besides pilot.
Description.あ、あの、大丈夫ですか？目が覚めたみたいで、良かったです……\\n……そ、それで: A-Um, are you okay? I'm glad you woke up...\n...S-So, well... here is a towel for now.
Description.んっ、あっ、はぁ、はぁ……んぅうううう！やっ、ああ、こ、これ以上は、む、むりぃ…: Ngh, ah, haa, haa... Nnnngh! Ah, aaah, a-any more than this is i-impossible...!
Description.だって、怖くて動けないんです……！お願いです、どうかわたくしの側にいてください…: Because I'm too scared to move...! Please, stay by my side...!
Description.……ふふふ……ぐにゅってしてる……♪これは……面白い。癖になる。お言葉に甘えて…: ...Fufu... It's squishy...♪ This is... interesting. It's addicting. Taking you up on your offer... poke, poke.
Description.はぁ……はぁっ……こ、こんな姿のフルートを、\\nあんまり映さないでくださ～い…: Haa... haa... P-Please don't record Flute looking like this too much~...!
Description.あら、指揮官……ふふ、とても大胆ね。\\nあたし達の裸……そんなに見たかったのか: My, Commander... fufu, how very bold. Did you really want to see us naked that much?
Description.え、えっちなトナカイ！？\\nえっ、ええええ、そ、そんなこと……！: A-A naughty reindeer!?\nE-Eh, w-what... no way...!
Description.レイヴェルをリーダーとする才能豊かなチーム。３人編成を最適解とみなしている。: A talented team led by Ravel. They consider a three-person squad to be the optimal setup.
Description.ん～、やっぱりお母さんの黒豆最高～っ！\\nお母さん！ この黒豆のレシピ、あとで: Mmm~ Mom's black beans are the best after all~!\nMom! Teach me the recipe for these black beans later!
Description.あけましておめでとうございます。ザルトゥーム学園がより素晴らしくなるよう精進いた: Happy New Year. I will devote myself to making Zartum Academy even more wonderful.\nI hope to have your support again this year.
Description.あはは！ 楽しいかも！ ほらほらー！\\nおしくらまんじゅう、押されて泣くなー！: Ahaha! This might be fun! Look, look~!\nDon't cry if you get pushed in the huddling game~!
Description.何事じゃありませんよ！\\nこの変態！ 鬼畜！ 覗き魔！ 極悪人！！: It's not 'nothing'!\nYou pervert! Fiend! Peeping Tom! Absolute villain!!
Description.榊は意識ばっかりで健康じゃない。すぐ怒るのが証拠。: Sakaki is all about mindset and not actually healthy. Getting angry so easily is proof of that.
Description.どんだけ少ない時間で、完璧求めんの！\\n文句と要望だけはご立派に言いやがって！: How much perfection do you expect in such a short time!\nAll you do is voice splendid complaints and demands!
Description.振り返れば指揮官さんがいてくれる……それが一番の勇気になるんです。\\nこれから: Knowing the Commander is there when I look back... gives me the greatest courage.\nI look forward to working with you from now on as well!
Description.撮影は……スタッフを通して……\nぐぅ……出禁……: Filming... through staff...\nUgh... banned from entry...
Description.何をやってるんですか！終わっていいとは言っていませんよ！\n今から３分間！ 限界: What are you doing! I didn't say you could stop!\nFrom now on, for 3 minutes! Keep doing push-ups to your absolute limit!
Description.生徒会直下の治安維持チーム。各校舎から集められた生徒達で構成されている。: A public safety maintenance team directly under the student council, composed of students gathered from various school buildings.
Description.ほら、賭けて賭けてー！それそれ～！ 次もどんどん行こー！: Come on, place your bets, place your bets! Here we go~! Let's keep going for the next one too!
Description.これで皆お揃いね♪ このまま指揮官にも見せに行きましょ♪\nきっと、あたしたちが:
Now we're all matching♪ Let's go show the Commander just like this♪
I'm sure he'll compliment us in a way that will touch our hearts♪
Description.オルガ「対ＭＧ戦と対メイズシフター戦の違いを念頭にあなたの意見を述べてください。:
Olga: "Please state your opinion, keeping in mind the differences between fighting MGs and fighting Maze Shifters."
Nadja: "Y-Yes!"
Description.はぁ……これで取材だけで別に人前に出るってわけじゃないなら、\nまだいいんだけど:
Sigh... If this is just an interview and I don't actually have to go out in public, that's fine.
Like taking photos and getting published in the school magazine...
Description.……イーニァの隣にいられない夜が、 こんなにも寒いとは知らなかった……: ...I didn't know a night without being next to Inia would be this cold...
Description.誰がママですか…… ほら、ちゆるさん。もっと手を上げてくださる？: Who are you calling Mom... Look, Chiyuru-san. Could you raise your hands higher?
Description.マスタぁ！とてもおめでたいことですよね！ こういった嬉しいことはずーーっとつづい: Master! This is a very auspicious occasion, isn't it! I hope happy things like this continue for a long, long time!
Description.やっぱり……クラスナの皆さんといる時のお母様は、 厳しいようだけど、どこか安心し: As expected... when Mother is with everyone in Krasna, she seems strict, but somehow relieved...
Description.……ということでカリナ、あとはお願いします。 もうサボっちゃダメですからね？: ...So with that, Karina, please handle the rest. No more slacking off, okay?
Description.「ほらこっちだよめるちゃん！ 行こ行こー！」\\n「わわっ！ ユリアさん、落ち着: "Come on, this way, Mel-chan! Let's go, let's go~!"\n"Wawa! Julia-san, calm down...!"
Description.あはは、ぱっと見ただのヒモっぽいよね。 でもこれもちゃんとした水着だよ～: Ahaha, at first glance it just looks like strings, right? But this is a proper swimsuit~
Description.あら、一体全体どこを触るつもりなのかしら？ コワ～イ……ふふ♪: My, where on earth do you think you're going to touch? Scary... fufu♪
Description.わたくしは…… 皆さんと一緒にいる資格など、あるのでしょうか。: Do I... even have the right to be with everyone?
Description.わわわ、わたし……どうすれば……！？ あっあっ……えっ！？ あああぁぁ～～～！？: W-W-What should I... do...!? Ah, ah... eh!? Aaaaaahhhh~~~!?
Description.次のダイエットでは必ず激痩せして……！ いえ、いきなりは難しいですから、その次と: On my next diet, I'll definitely lose a ton of weight...! No, that's hard to do right away, so maybe the next time...
Description.水上スポーツ大会に来てるんだけど、ちょ～っと待ち時間があるから、 海の家を回って: I came to the water sports tournament, but since there's a little wait, I'll visit the beach shacks and introduce my top recommended items~!
Description.焼きイカも、味が濃くて美味しいです……！ この歯ごたえ、たまらな……ああ、もうな: The grilled squid has a rich flavor and is delicious...! This chewy texture is irresistible... Ah, it's already gone...!?
Description.レイヴェル、ルナ、おにいちゃん……リディア。 みんなといっしょが、きっといちばん: Ravel, Luna, Onii-chan... and Lydia. Being together with everyone is definitely the greatest treasure.
Description.ここが盛り上がって続いてほしいっていうのは、\nあたしにとっては恩返しの意味もあ: Wanting this place to stay lively and keep going is my way of giving back too♪
Description.その輪が広がっていく中で、最後に皆が笑顔になる……\nそんなビジネスの形が、私の: As that circle expands, everyone ends up with a smile in the end... That kind of business is my dream, you know?
Description.わっ、わあっ！？ ちょっと、同時に引っ張っちゃダメだよ！？\n先生、千切れちゃう: Wah, woah!? Hey, don't pull me at the same time!? Sensei, I'm going to get torn in half!
Description.終わった後に笑顔で、気持ちよかったって言ってもらえると、\nそれだけですごく嬉し: When people smile after it's over and tell me how good it felt, that alone makes me so happy.
Description.……さっき、父さんの話をしたでしょ。\nそうしたら、なんだか人恋しくなっちゃって:
...Just now, I was talking about my father, right?
When I did, I suddenly started feeling a bit lonely and craving company.
Description.あははっ♪ ここからは、私も本気出すってこと！\n皆、ライバルとしてよろしくねっ:
Ahaha♪ That means I'm getting serious from here on out!
I look forward to competing with all of you as rivals!
Description.うん……湯船に浸かってるだけで、\n身体がぽかぽかして、気持ちいい……:
Mmm... Just soaking in the tub
makes my body feel warm all over, it feels so nice...
Description.え、ええと……多分、使用中の札をかけていたはずですが……: U-Um... I'm pretty sure I hung up the 'In Use' sign, though...
Description.める「いらっしゃいませ、指揮官さん！ たくさん食べてくださいね！」\nラミ「ラミ:
Meru: "Welcome, Commander! Please eat up and enjoy!"
Rami: "Getting served by us is super lucky, you know? Cry tears of joy!"
Description.わ、わわわっ！？\nおい！ 急に何すんの、髪ぐっちゃぐちゃになるじゃんか！:
W-Woah, woah, woah!?
Hey! What are you doing all of a sudden? You're completely messing up my hair!
Description.任せて。こっちが今まで頼りにしてきた分、\nこっちも頑張らせてもらうよ。:
Leave it to me. Since I've relied on you so much up until now,
it's my turn to give it my all.
Description.紡いだ絆が、決戦の地に集う。\\n定められた運命を覆し、『箱庭』を壊す時が来た。: The bonds we've forged gather at the site of the final battle.\nThe time has come to overturn our predetermined fate and shatter the 'Miniature Garden.'
Description.オルガをリーダーとするチーム。チームの連携力は、他チームを凌ぐと言われている。: A team led by Olga. Their teamwork is said to surpass all other teams.
Description.ナージャ「どんなに厳しい戦いだったとしても、必ず乗り越えられます……！」\\n: Nadja: "No matter how tough the battle is, we will definitely overcome it...!"\nOlga: "I trust you as well. Together, the two of us surely can..."
Description.ニーナ「えっと……私は、ジーナがここ最近無理をしてると思ったんだ」 \\nジーナ: Nina: "Um... I just thought that Gina has been pushing herself too hard lately."\nGina: "I am merely fulfilling my duty as a pilot and a warrior."
Description.ナージャ「どんなに厳しい戦いだったとしても、必ず乗り越えられます……！」\\nオ: Nadja: "No matter how tough the battle is, we will definitely overcome it...!"\nOlga: "I trust you as well. Together, the two of us surely can..."
Description.いいんちょはいつもがんばってて、サボらないし……\\n委員長のことはウチがぜった: The class rep always works hard and never slacks off...\nso I'll definitely help the chair out―――
Description.これからも見せてくれるんでしょ？\\nあんたと一緒に掴み取った、『未来』ってやつ: You'll keep showing it to me from now on too, right?\nThat thing called the 'future' we grasped together.
Description.これから先もずっと、\\nあなたの隣でたくさんの思い出を作らせてくださいね。: Please let me make lots of memories\nby your side, always, from now on too.
Description.すみません……でも、その……\\n今のことは、あまり意識しないでください……: Sorry... but, um...\nplease don't think too much about what just happened...
Description.それは―――無慈悲な一撃だった。魅力は無限大。: That was―――a merciless blow. Her charm is limitless.
Description.もう、そろってからかわないでください～！: Come on, please don't tease me now that we're all together~!
Description.仕方ないわね……\\nじゃあ、本当にひと口だけ味を見てあげる。: Oh, fine...\nThen I'll really just take one bite to taste it.

DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「刻痕」が最も少ない敵を優先して敵横一列に威力{威力}で攻撃し、「刻痕」を1つ付:
Prioritizes the enemy with the fewest "Scar" stacks and attacks an enemy row with power {威力}, inflicting 1 "Scar".
Each 1 "Scar" lowers ATK by 8% and damage dealt by 5% (stackable). "Scar" is removed when the user falls. If the target already has 4 or more, no new "Scar" is applied.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「創作」状態ではない場合、敵単体に威力{威力}で攻撃する。「アイデア」を所持して:
If not in "Creation" state, attacks a single enemy with power {威力}. If the user has "Idea", performs an additional attack with power {威力2}.
While in "Creation" state, restores 1.5% of the user's Max HP.

If not in "Creation" state, attacks a single enemy with power {威力}. If the user has "Idea", performs an additional attack with power {威力2}.
While in "Creation" state, restores 30% of the user's Max HP.

If not in "Creation" state, attacks a single enemy with power {威力}. If the user has "Idea", performs an additional attack with power {威力2}.
Additionally, restores HP equal to {cure}% of the total damage dealt.
While in "Creation" state, restores 1.5% of the user's Max HP.

If not in "Creation" state, attacks a single enemy with power {威力}. If the user has "Idea", performs an additional attack with power {威力2}.
Additionally, restores HP equal to {cure}% of the total damage dealt.
While in "Creation" state, restores 30% of the user's Max HP.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「呼応」が最も少ない敵を優先し、敵単体に威力{威力}で3ヒットEN攻撃する。\n:
Prioritizes the enemy with the fewest "Resonance" stacks and deals a 3-hit EN attack to a single enemy with power {威力}.
If the target is in "Resonance" state, temporarily lowers DEF by 3.5% per 1 "Resonance" before attacking (stackable, up to 10).
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「呼応」が最も少ない敵を優先して敵単体に威力{威力}でEN攻撃し、対象と自身に「:
Prioritizes the enemy with the fewest "Resonance" stacks and deals an EN attack to a single enemy with power {威力}, granting 1 "Resonance" each to the target and the user (cannot be removed).
If the target is in "Resonance" state, temporarily lowers DEF by 3.5% per 1 "Resonance" before attacking (stackable, up to 10).
If the user has 10 or more "Resonance", this skill does not trigger.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「失勢」が最も多い敵を優先し、敵横一列に1行動の暗闇を付与する。暗闇状態は{ku:
Prioritizes the enemy with the most "Disarray" stacks and inflicts 1 action of Blindness on an enemy row. While blinded, skills miss with a {kurayami}% chance.
Additionally, until the user finishes 1 action, lowers the target enemy's ATK by 25% and DEF by 20% (stackable). The ATK/DEF debuffs are removed when the user falls.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「失勢」が最も多い敵を優先し、敵横一列の行動速度を1行動の間{spd}低下させ（:
Prioritizes the enemy with the most "Disarray" stacks, lowers an enemy row's Action Speed by {spd} for 1 action (stackable), and inflicts 1 action of Blindness. While blinded, skills miss with a {kurayami}% chance.
Additionally, until the user finishes 1 action, lowers the target enemy's ATK by 25% and DEF by 20% (stackable). The ATK/DEF debuffs are removed when the user falls.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「攻勢」状態ではない場合、自身が含まれる味方横一列に対し、自身が1回行動を終える:
If not in "Onslaught" state, grants a shield equal to ATK × {shield}% to the ally row containing the user, lasting until the user finishes 1 action. The shield is removed if the granter falls.
While in "Onslaught" state, attacks 2 enemies with power {威力}.
DescriptionTemplates[]::Template.「攻勢」状態ではない場合、自身にかけられたデバフを全て解除し、自身に「攻勢」を付:
If not in "Onslaught" state, removes all debuffs on the user and grants "Onslaught" to the user (cannot be removed by others). "Onslaught" negates debuffs aimed at the user and reduces damage taken by {dmg}% (stackable).
While in "Onslaught" state, temporarily raises the user's ATK by 25% (stackable), attacks all enemies with power {威力}, and removes "Onslaught".

EX Gauge at 3 or more: consumes 2 EX Gauge and restores {cure2}% of the damage taken.

Message.舞亜なら他に似合う服がある: There are other clothes that would suit Maia.
Message.いっそ服を着ないと楽だぞ: It'd be way easier if you just didn't wear clothes.
Message.これから知ってもらおう: Let's let people get to know them from now on.
Message.みんなゾリャーを知りたがってる: Everyone wants to get to know Zorya.
Message.どんな質問が来るんだ？: What kind of questions are coming?
Message.似た者同士か……？: Are you two cut from the same cloth...?
Message.俺も水着新調するかな……: Maybe I should get a new swimsuit too...
Message.困ったら頼ってほしい: If you ever get into trouble, I want you to rely on me.
Message.夜に花火やりたい！: I want to do fireworks at night!
Message.応援しに行こうか？: Shall we go cheer them on?
Message.意外と気が合うんだな。: Turns out we get along surprisingly well.
Message.水着が見れてラッキーだった。: I was lucky to get to see the swimsuits.
Message.答えにくいものはないか？: Are there any questions that are hard to answer?
Message.リディア、海で迷子にならないようにな？: Lydia, make sure you don't get lost at the beach, okay?
Message.ルナ、食べすぎには注意しろよ？: Luna, be careful not to overeat, okay?
Message.俺も見ていいか？: Can I take a look too?
Message.お祭りっぽいからか？: Is it because it feels like a festival?
Message.なら編集も気遣わないとな。: Then we need to be careful with the editing too.
Message.もっとお色気があると良かった。: It would've been better with more sex appeal.
Message.結構ＮＧな所は多いのか？: Are there a lot of bloopers/outtakes?
Message.俺も慣れた気がする。: I feel like I've gotten used to it too.
Message.手伝いを頼んでみるか？: Should we try asking her for help?
Message.流石に怒るぞ？: She's definitely gonna get angry, you know?
Message.流石ＭＧ企業のお嬢様だな。: As expected of an MG corporation heiress.
Message.目のやり場に困る。: I don't know where to look.
Message.適材適所だぞ。: It's all about putting the right person in the right place.
Message.最初の話相手は俺だぞ。: I was your very first conversation partner.
Message.ジーナが姉だと思う: I think Gina is the older sister.
Message.ジーナもニーナも同じ: Gina and Nina are both the same.
Message.ニーナが姉だと思う: I think Nina is the older sister.
Message.みんなも着てるから気にするな: Everyone else is wearing it too, so don't worry about it.
Message.メイズに潜ってみるか？: Want to try diving into the Maze?
Message.模擬戦でデータを集めるか？: Should we gather data through mock battles?
Message.露出が多いから恥ずかしいとか？: Is it because it's revealing and embarrassing?
Message.公私混同はよくないぞ: Keep your work and personal life separate
Message.みんな、コトハのことよろしくな: Everyone, please take good care of Kotoha.
Message.コトハはツンデレだからな: Well, Kotoha is a tsundere after all.

Message.＠T_Commander\\nえへへ、初めて挨拶をしちゃいました。\\nこれにお: ＠T_Commander\nHehe, that's my first message to you on here.\nCan you reply to it?
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはい！ そうやってお友達が増えたら、\\nここでや: ＠T_Commander\nYes! As you make more friends,\nyou can chat with them here!
Message.あれ？ それってそいつのアカウント？\\n怪しい名前だから通報しようかと思ってた: Huh? That's his account?\nThat name looked shady. I was thinking of reporting it.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうです、%usernameusernameuse: ＠T_Commander\nYes, that's you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san!\nNow you can chat with all sorts of friends!
Message.＠T_Commander\\nあ、これ%usernameusernameuser: ＠T_Commander\nOh, so this is you, %usernameusernameuserna%.\nI thought it was some weird account.
Message.おそらく、生徒会所属だからでしょう。\\n彼は正式な生徒とは違いますもの。: I imagine it's because he's with the Student Council.\nHe isn't a regular student, after all.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nなんか特別って感じで面白いよね～。\\nあたしも変わっ: ＠Nanairo_N\nIt's fun having a name that stands out like that~.\nI wish I could pick an unusual name too.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nさて、改めてカラフルブーケの生駒葵だ。\\nよろし: ＠T_Commander\nLet me introduce myself again. I'm Ikoma Aoi of Colorful Bouquet.\nI look forward to working with you.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nというか何よあの紹介！\\n別に緊張なんてしてなかったんだから: ＠Aoi_I\nAnyway, what was that introduction supposed to be?!\nI wasn't nervous!
Message.＠Uruu_N\\nそりゃ、うるうはそうだろうけど……\\n初対面で臆病な奴と思: ＠Uruu_N\nWell, of course you were, Uruu...\nI just don't want his first impression of me to be that I'm a coward!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\n葵も場を和ませるために言っただけだから。\\nそんな変な: ＠Kurara_K\nAoi was just trying to break the ice.\nShe didn't mean anything by it, okay?
Message.＠Maia_Y\\nそういうことだったのね……\\nまあ、そういう事なら納得して: ＠Maia_Y\nOh, so that's what she meant...\nWell, if that's all it was, I'll let it go.
Message.＠Kurara_K\\n……気づいてないかもしれないけど、\\nこのやり取り、指: ＠Kurara_K\n...You might not have noticed,\nbut the Commander can read all of this, you know?
Message.＠T_Commander\\n別に悪意はないし、ビビってもないから！\\nそこだ: ＠T_Commander\nI didn't mean anything bad, and I'm not scared of you!\nJust don't get the wrong idea!
Message.何でこういう時に限って用事があるんだろうね～\\nあたし達も一緒に遊びたかったな: Why do we always have something to do at times like this~?\nWe wanted to hang out too.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nあれー？ 白奈ちゃんも用事があったの？\\nそっちはど: ＠Shirona_I\nOh? You had something to do too, Shirona-chan?\nWhat was it?
Message.へー、白奈ちゃんってたまに追加課題してる\\nよねぇ。やっぱり期待されてるからか: Huh, you get extra assignments every so often,\ndon't you, Shirona-chan? Maybe they expect a lot from you?
Message.それで、ちゆるの用事は？\\n同好会の活動って聞いた。: What about you, Chiyuru?\nI heard it was something to do with your club.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nいやー、部室をまた爆発させちゃってさぁ。: ＠Shirona_I\nWell, I kinda blew up the clubroom again.
Message.そのせいで会長から反省文と申請書を何枚も\\n書かされちゃう羽目になったんだよね: So now the president's making me write a whole pile\nof apologies and application forms!
Message.＠Aoi_I\\n＠Uruu_N\\nシリウスシュガーの特訓を見てきたのよね？\:
＠Aoi_I
＠Uruu_N
You went to watch Sirius Sugar's special training, right?
How was it?
Message.＠Senka_H\\nこ、怖いです恐ろしいです！\\nわたしならあんな訓練耐えれ: ＠Senka_H\nS-scary! Absolutely terrifying!\nI'd never survive that kind of training...!
Message.＠Uruu_N\\n優しそうな顔をしていたけど、\\n意外とスパルタだったのね。: ＠Uruu_N\nHe looked so gentle.\nI didn't expect him to be such a taskmaster.
Message.私から見れば合理的な訓練だったな。\\n一部は我々も取り入れてもいいかもしれない: The training made sense to me.\nPerhaps we should try some of it ourselves.
Message.限界までイジメて、マズいドリンクを飲ませて、\\n無理やり返答を強制するやり方を: You mean pushing us to our limits, making us drink something disgusting,\nand forcing us to answer?!
Message.＠Uruu_N\\n心配せずとも、あのままやるつもりはないぞ？: ＠Uruu_N\nDon't worry. I wasn't planning to copy it exactly.
Message.……はたから見てる私たちからすると、\\n何をさせられるのか不安なんだけど。: ...For those of us who weren't there,\nthis isn't very reassuring. What are you going to make us do?
Message.なーんか平和よねぇ……\\n最近は変な噂も聞かないし。: It's been pretty peaceful lately...\nHaven't heard any weird rumors, either.
Message.＠Kurara_K\\n……シリウスシュガーの変な噂を\\n実は楽しみにしてたで: ＠Kurara_K\n...You were actually looking forward to hearing\nmore weird rumors about Sirius Sugar, weren't you?
Message.＠Senka_H\\nうぐ……だ、だって！ 最近は真面目に\\nシミュレーター訓: ＠Senka_H\nUrk... W-well! All I hear about lately\nis how hard they're working at simulator training!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nあまりそういう噂で楽しむのはよくないぞ？\\n順調なのは: ＠Kurara_K\nYou shouldn't take so much pleasure in rumors like that.\nIsn't it good that things are going well for them?
Message.まあでも、実際話題性は凄かったものね。\\n柊校舎では噂になってたもの。: Still, they really did get everyone talking.\nThose rumors were all over the Hiiragi School Building.
Message.そういえば先日の噂の大本を調べたんだが……\\nあまり内容は変わらなかったな。: Speaking of which, I looked into where that last rumor started...\nIt hadn't changed much in the telling.
Message.シリウスシュガーに酷い訓練をするぞと\\n彼が自分から言い出したらしい。: Apparently, he was the one who said\nhe'd put Sirius Sugar through some brutal training.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nえっ、あの噂って原文ママなの？: ＠Aoi_I\nWait, so that rumor was word for word what he said?
Message.うおっしゃー！\\n稼いだー！ 最高ね！: Awww yeah!\nGot paid! This is the best!
Message.あはは……ラミさん頑張ってましたからね。: Ahaha... You really worked hard, Rami-san.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nあのバカみたいな練習、無駄かと思ってたけど、\\nこんないい: ＠Meru_M\nI thought all that ridiculous training was a waste of time,\nbut if this is what we get out of it, maybe it's pretty great after all!
Message.でも、校舎で変な目で見られる……: But people at school keep giving us weird looks...
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nそりゃ、あんたは見られないでしょ。\\n普段から変な目: ＠Chiyuru_T\nWell, of course you haven't.\nPeople give you weird looks all the time.
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\n事実なら失礼ではないでしょう……: ＠Chiyuru_T\nSurely it isn't rude if it's true...
Message.シリウスシュガーがこんなに強くなってるなんて\\n本当に驚いたわ。: Sirius Sugar's gotten so much stronger.\nI was genuinely surprised.
Message.＠Senka_H\\nふふ、ありがとうございます。\\nでも最後までやれば分かり: ＠Senka_H\nHehe, thank you.\nStill, had we fought to the end, it could have gone either way.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nシリウスシュガーとは重みも状況も違う。\\nあれは君た: ＠Nanairo_N\nWe're in different situations, with different things at stake.\nThat victory was yours.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nいやー、そういわれちゃうと照れちゃうな～♪\\nまあ、これも実: ＠Aoi_I\nAww, you're making me blush~♪\nWell, let's just call it skill, shall we?♪
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nあまり調子乗らないでよね！\\n本気で挑めば結果は変わ: ＠Chiyuru_T\nDon't get too full of yourself!\nIt'll be a different story if we come at you seriously!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nはいはい、ヒートアップしないの。\\n今回は彼女たちの勝: ＠Kurara_K\nAll right, all right. No need to get worked up.\nThey won this time.
Message.私たちも次は負けないように、\\n頑張ればいいだけよ。: We just have to work hard\nso we don't lose next time.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n＠Maia_Y\\nうん、凄い向上心。\\nわたし:
＠T_Commander
＠Maia_Y
Yeah. They're really determined to improve.
We can't let them beat us.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nやっほー♪ こっちもフォローしたよ～♪\\nうちに: ＠T_Commander\nHeyyy♪ I followed you too~♪\nCan't wait for you to come over to us~.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n改めて、紫雲沙耶と申します。\\n今後ともお見知り: ＠T_Commander\nAllow me to introduce myself again. I'm Shiun Saya.\nIt's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nふふ、アニスよ♪\\nまた色々とお話しましょうね♪: ＠T_Commander\nHehe, it's Anis♪\nLet's chat some more soon, shall we?♪
Message.＠Julia_B\\nもう勝ったつもりでして？\\n勝負は分かりませんことよ。: ＠Julia_B\nHave you already decided you've won?\nThe outcome is far from certain.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nふーん？ まあ、やる気があるなら\\n楽しませてくれそ: ＠Nanairo_N\nOh? Well, if you're that eager,\nthis should be fun♪
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\n＠Meru_M\\nじゃ、試合の日は期待してるからね～: ＠Nanairo_N\n＠Meru_M\nThen I'll be looking forward to our match~♪
Message.……こうしてみると分かりますが、\\n面白い手段ですね。: ...Seeing it play out like this, I understand.\nWhat an interesting approach.
Message.あえて相手の警戒を引き出すことで、\\n対応を誤らせる作戦ですか。: Deliberately putting the opponent on guard\nso they make the wrong move?
Message.ああもう！ 危ない作戦ね！\\n見ててハラハラするわ！: Ugh, this plan is dangerous!\nIt's nerve-racking to watch!
Message.桃園さんが前線を張ると信じていなければ。\\nその役割を果たさなければ成立しませ: It depends on trusting Momozono-san to hold the front line.\nIf she can't do her part, the plan falls apart.
Message.それだけのことを出来ると信じられる練習を\\nこの短い期間で重ねてきたのですか。: They've trained enough in such a short time\nto have that much faith in her?
Message.ひええ……わたしならあんなの、\\n３秒でギブアップしちゃいます……: Eeee... I'd give up on that\nin ３ seconds...
Message.＠Uruu_N\\nそこはもうちょっと頑張りなさいよ。: ＠Uruu_N\nAt least try to hold out a little longer.
Message.我々に勝てる実力を手に入れたからこそ、\\n選べた奇襲作戦というわけか。: So they could attempt that surprise attack\nbecause they'd grown strong enough to beat us.
Message.……突拍子がない戦略に見えて、\\nシリウスシュガーは勝ちを見据えていますね。: ...The strategy may seem outlandish,\nbut Sirius Sugar clearly has victory in its sights.
Message.うぐぐ……悔しいわ……！\\nまさか作戦負けするだなんて……！: Ugh... This is so frustrating...!\nI can't believe we were outplayed...!
Message.＠Senka_H\\n今回は噛み合っただけだからね。\\n次にやれば結果は分から: ＠Senka_H\nEverything just happened to fall into place this time.\nWho knows how it'll go next time~♪
Message.しかし、見事だったぞ。\\n桃園の実力もだが……鳴滝の戦略だと聞いた。\\nあれ: Still, it was impressive.\nMomozono's skill was part of it... but I hear the strategy was Narutaki's.\nThat was what really cost us the match.
Message.でも%usernameusernameuserna%さんは\\n何度も通用しない: But %usernameusernameuserna%-san said\nwe can't keep relying on the same trick.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n今日来てたんだってね～♪\\nフォローしておいたよ: ＠T_Commander\nI heard you dropped by today~♪\nI followed you! Nice to meet you~♪
Message.よ、よろしくお願いします！\\n……絶対に負けませんから！: N-nice to meet you!\n...We won't lose!
Message.＠Meru_M\\nへー、やる気があるのは良いね♪\\nまあ期待してるよ～。: ＠Meru_M\nOh, I like that enthusiasm♪\nI'll be looking forward to it~.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\n＠Meru_M\\n心折れないのは立派ですが……\\n:
＠Nanairo_N
＠Meru_M
Your refusal to give up is admirable...
But victory will be ours.
Message.＠L_Cuilan\\nそれはこちらのセリフですわ。: ＠L_Cuilan\nWe could say the same to you.
Message.いやー、熱い試合だったねぇ……！\\n最後の最後まで展開が読めなかったよ！: Wow, what a match...!\nI couldn't tell how it would end until the very last moment!
Message.なんというか最後は華々しさのない、\\n泥臭い試合でしたね……: Well, the ending wasn't exactly flashy.\nIt came down to a gritty struggle...
Message.実力は圧倒的にカオスメイデンが上でした。\\nですが、精神的支柱のバーンズさんを: Chaos Maiden was overwhelmingly stronger.\nBut once Barnes-san, the one they relied on for moral support, was out,\nthey were shaken, and that cost them the match.
Message.普段に比べて精彩を欠いていました。\\n多少は立て直せたようですが……: They weren't performing anywhere near their usual level.\nThey did seem to recover somewhat, though...
Message.そこに関してはシリウスシュガーの皆が、\\n一生懸命頑張った成果だよね！: That's down to everyone in Sirius Sugar\ngiving it everything they had!
Message.それに、最後に何か話して握手してるよ！\\nいやー、いい試合を見れたなぁ！: And look, they're talking and shaking hands at the end!\nWow, I'm glad I got to see that match!
Message.ですが、本当に番狂わせですね。\\nこの試合でシリウスシュガーの勝利を予想\\n: Still, what an upset.\nAnyone who predicted Sirius Sugar would win this match...\nmust have been backing quite the long shot.
Message.こうして今見ている私も、\\n本当に勝ったのかと驚くばかりだ。: Even watching it happen,\nI can hardly believe they actually won.
Message.あいつら、よく頑張ったわね……\\nまた柊でお祝いしてやりましょうよ！: They really gave it their all...\nLet's throw them another celebration back at Hiiragi!
Message.皆さん、改めてお疲れ様でしたわ。\\n……本当に、勝ててよかったですわ。: Once again, well done, everyone.\n...I'm so relieved we won.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nふふ、こちらの言葉ですわ♪\\nあなたを信じてよか: ＠T_Commander\nHehe, we should be saying that to you♪\nI'm glad we put our faith in you.
Message.＠T_Commande\\nでも、あのしごきは許してないからな！\\n絶対に仕返: ＠T_Commande\nBut I still haven't forgiven you for that brutal training!\nI'll get you back for it!
Message.……あれはあれで面白かった。: ...It was fun in its own way.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n意外と白奈ちゃんは気に入ってるよね～。\\nまあ、でも: ＠Shirona_I\nYou really took to it, didn't you, Shirona-chan? Who'd have thought~.\nStill, thank you. Really♪
Message.おかげでこれからも実験が出来るよ！: Thanks to you, I can keep doing my experiments!
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\n部屋を爆発させるんだし、\\nそれは禁止されてよかった: ＠Chiyuru_T\nConsidering you keep blowing up the room,\nmaybe banning those would've been a good thing?
Message.本当にありがとうございます！\\nまだまだこれからがありますけど……: Thank you so much!\nWe still have a long way to go, but...
Message.ぐぬぬ……なんで舞亜とうるうが教師役なのよ！\\n私だって先輩として教えたかった: Grr... Why do Maia and Uruu get to teach?!\nI wanted to show them the ropes as their senpai too!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nそういう心持ちだったからじゃないか？\\n教える方が気負: ＠Kurara_K\nPerhaps that attitude is why?\nIt doesn't help if the teacher gets too carried away.
Message.でも、うるうさんが選ばれたのは意外ね。\\nあの子は教えるのに緊張してそうだし。: Still, I'm surprised they picked Uruu-san.\nI'd have thought teaching would make her nervous.
Message.＠Senka_H\\n舞亜が横にいるなら、言葉が足りない\\n部分などは問題なく: ＠Senka_H\nWith Maia beside her, she should have no trouble\nfilling in anything Uruu leaves out.
Message.＠Senka_H\\nそれに、うるうもこういう経験を積んでおくと\\n今後にも役: ＠Senka_H\nBesides, getting this kind of experience now\nshould help Uruu in the future.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\n……確かにそうね。経験しておけば、\\nいざという時のためにも: ＠Aoi_I\n...That's true. Having the experience\nwill help when she really needs it.
Message.……ラミさんあたりと喧嘩になって、\\nトラブルを起こすのに賭けるわ。: ...I'd bet she'd get into a fight with someone like Rami-san\nand cause trouble.
Message.いやぁ～！ 流石原生帯だったねぇ！\\n色々と興味深い体験だったよ！: Wow~! The Primal Belt didn't disappoint!\nThere was so much fascinating stuff to experience!
Message.この経験が出来ただけでも、\\n教えてもらった甲斐があるってものだね！: That experience alone\nmade all those lessons worth it!
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nそりゃ筋金入りのメイズオタクだし。\\n新しいエリアは: ＠Shirona_I\nWell, she's a die-hard Maze geek.\nOf course a new area gets her excited.
Message.＠Rami_K\\nそういうラミちゃんだって、\\n結構嬉しそうにお宝漁りしてた: ＠Rami_K\nYou say that, Rami-chan,\nbut you looked pretty happy hunting for treasure yourself, didn't you?
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nあったり前でしょ！？\\nお金稼げるんだから最高よ！: ＠Chiyuru_T\nOf course I was!\nI get to make money! What's not to love?!
Message.喜ぶのはいいですが、油断はしないように。\\n危険な場所には変わりありませんから: There's nothing wrong with enjoying yourselves, but don't let your guard down.\nIt's still a dangerous place.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\n私が注意する前に言ってくれてありがとうね。\\n稼げる: ＠Nanairo_N\nThank you for saying it before I had to.\nNo pushing yourselves too far just because there's money to be made, all right?
Message.先ほどメイズ帰りのシリウスシュガー……\\nというか、指揮官が運ばれていましたけ: Earlier, I saw Sirius Sugar coming back from the Maze...\nOr rather, I saw the Commander being carried away.\nWas he all right?
Message.＠L_Cuilan\\nメイズシンドロームだったからね。\\nまあ命に別状はない: ＠L_Cuilan\nHe had Maze Syndrome.\nHis life's not in danger, though~.
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nあー、そうだったんだ。\\nあれってキツいのよねぇ……: ＠Chiyuru_T\nOh, so that's what it was.\nThat's really rough...
Message.むしろ、今まで発症してなかったのね。\\n通過儀礼みたいなものだから意外だわ。: I'm more surprised he hadn't had it before.\nIt's practically a rite of passage.
