Message.たまに、トレブルクインテットみたいなチームが羨ましくはなりますね……トラブルも起: Sometimes I envy teams like Treble Quintet... A team full of sensible people who don't cause trouble.
Message.うええ、これ大丈夫なの！？ ちょっとメイズシフターヤバいんじゃない！？: Whoa, are they going to be okay?! Those Maze Shifters look like serious trouble!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\n……いくら優秀なパイロットでも、流石にあの群れはキツいと: ＠Kurara_K\n...Even an excellent pilot would have a hard time with that swarm.
Message.……ふうむ、風紀委員に通報をしている生徒もいるみたいだな。: ...Hmm. It seems some students have already reported this to the Disciplinary Committee.
Message.……って、他のＭＧが来たけど……これってトレブルクインテットよね？: ...Wait, more MGs just arrived... That's Treble Quintet, isn't it?
Message.もしかして、トリニティ・ジュエルの皆さんを助けに来たんでしょうか！: Could they have come to help everyone in Trinity Jewel?!
Message.おお、これは盛り上がるねぇ～！: Ooh, now this is getting exciting~!
Message.ＬＯＣの上位チームが組むなら、メイズシフターの群れ相手でもなんとかなりそうね……: If LOC's top teams join forces, they should be able to handle even a swarm of Maze Shifters...
Message.急に流出事件が起きたとか報道されてるけど、情報が伏せられて何も分からないし、評価: The news suddenly says there's been a data leak, but they're keeping the details under wraps, so we don't know anything. And now the evaluation project has been suspended too.
Message.うう、なんだかザワザワしてて学園も怖いです……: Ugh, everyone's so on edge... Even the academy feels scary...
Message.んー、何が起きたのかなー？\\n教えてくれないかな～？: Hmm, what happened~?\nWon't someone tell me~?
Message.そうねぇ……やっぱり気になっちゃうわよね。: Yes... You can't help wondering, can you?
Message.噂では、トリニティ・ジュエルがデータを持ち出した実行犯で風紀委員会に拘束されてる: Rumor has it Trinity Jewel took the data and is being held by the Disciplinary Committee.
Message.へえ……悪いことをするものねぇ。そこまでやっちゃうと構って貰うどころじゃなさそう: Oh... How naughty of them. If they went that far, getting attention is the least of their problems.
Message.＠Anis_B\\n構って欲しいからでやる事じゃないですからね？ ……トリニティ: ＠Anis_B\nThis isn't something you do just to get attention, you know? ...I've heard Trinity Jewel is an ambitious team, especially its leader, but would they really do something like this?
Message.ライバルチームのトリニティ・ジュエルの皆が大ピンチみたいなんです！ 助けるために: Our rivals in Trinity Jewel seem to be in serious trouble! We're gathering any information that could help them! If you know anything, please reply to Ｆｌ∞ｔｙ!\n＃HelpTrinityJewel
Message.最近、フルートちゃんの流れてくるねー: Flute-chan's posts keep popping up in my feed lately~.
Message.まあ、めっちゃ噂流れてきてるしね。新型ジェネレーターの情報流出して、レイヴェル達: Yeah, those rumors are everywhere. The ones saying data on the new generator got leaked and Ravel and the others did it.
Message.私も聞いたわね。珍しいスキャンダルだからか、噂がとても広まってきているのよね。: I've heard them too. Perhaps it's because scandals like this are so unusual, but the rumors have spread far and wide.
Message.うちの校舎でも聞いたわ！ 特にレイヴェルが酷い奴だって言う噂！: We've heard them at our school building too! Especially the ones about how awful Ravel is!
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n陸上をしてた頃、レイヴェルさんみたいなタイプがいたわ。: ＠Shirona_I\nBack when I did track and field, I knew someone like Ravel-san. She tended to make enemies.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nまあ、自他ともに厳しい強気な子っていうのは、どうしても悪: ＠Shinka_H\nYeah, when you're strong-willed and hard on yourself and everyone else, you tend to attract the wrong kind of attention~. Wait, was that person...?
Message.最近は暗い話題ばっかりでしたね！ なので、生徒会長さんから許可を貰ってイベントを: It's been nothing but gloomy news lately! So I've put together an event with permission from the Student Council president! It's called...\n＃FindTheFakeStudentCouncilPresident!
Message.生徒会長の許可は得ているらしいが……ニセ会長か。わざわざなぜ会長を？: It seems the Student Council president has approved it... But a fake president? Why choose her, of all people?
Message.この大変そうな時期に、ちょっとだけ心配になりますわね……: It's a little worrying, with things already looking so difficult...
Message.頑張ってニセ会長を捜す。: I'll do my best to find the fake president.
Message.……偽物か本物か分からない生徒会長が学内を視察することで、騒動を起こしたりする生: ...Is the idea to have someone who might or might not be the real Student Council president going around the academy, to keep would-be troublemakers in check?
Message.＠Maia_Y\\nそういうこと♪ もしよかったら探してみてね～。: ＠Maia_Y\nThat's right♪ Give it a try if you'd like~.
Message.確かに、生徒会長のような方がスカラでも歩いておりましたね……捜してみるのも一興で: Indeed, I saw someone who looked like the Student Council president walking around Scalar as well... Perhaps looking for her could be rather fun?
Message.こっちでも、お礼を言わせてください！ 本当に本当にぽよなリスナーの皆……ありがと: Let me say thank you here, too! To all my really, really poyo listeners... thank you so much! I seriously love you all!\n＃LoveYouAll!
Message.色々と助けてくれてありがとうね。フルートたちも感謝してるし、私も助かったよ。: Thanks for all your help. Flute and the others are grateful, and you really helped me out, too.
Message.本当に色々とあって大変だったわねぇ……しばらくはゆっくりしたい気分かも。: So much happened... It's been exhausting. I think I'd like to take it easy for a while.
Message.トレブルクインテットの皆さんに、%usernameusernameuserna%: Everyone in Treble Quintet, and %usernameusernameuserna%-san! Thank you for all your hard work!
Message.それで、お祓いいつ行く？ 多分原因は%usernameusernameusern: So, when are we going for that purification ritual? %usernameusernameuserna%'s probably the cause.
Message.@T_Commander\\nいやいや、失礼とはいうけどあたし達から離れてもこん: @T_Commander\nHey, you can call us rude, but you still get caught up in all this trouble even when you're away from us. It's pretty clear what the common factor is...
Message.@T_Commander\\n……はたから見ているが、流石に大騒動にこのレベルで: @T_Commander\n...Speaking as an outsider, getting caught up in this many major incidents is, frankly... Well, you see my point?
Message.まあ、噂に聞こえてるだけでも大事件に巻き込まれてるしねぇ……いやまあ、%user: Well, even the rumors have you caught up in one big incident after another... Not that I think it's %usernameusernameuserna%'s fault.
Message.もしも、トリニティ・ジュエルの情報を知ってたら教えて欲しいんだけど何か知らないか: Does anyone know anything about Trinity Jewel? I'd appreciate any information.
Message.＠Rosie_H\\nすみません、私もあまり詳しくは……: ＠Rosie_H\nI'm sorry. I don't know much either...
Message.んー、それなら仕方ないわ。ありがとうねー。: Hmm, that's all right, then. Thanks~.
Message.……なんだか大変そうね。トレブルクインテットの人たちも忙しそうだし……: ...Things sound difficult. Everyone in Treble Quintet seems busy, too...
Message.トリニティ・ジュエルの潔白を信じているって言ってたものね……データ流出の犯人だっ: They did say they believe Trinity Jewel is innocent... People are blaming them for the data leak, but after competing against them as rivals, they probably believe more strongly than anyone that they wouldn't do something like that.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\n根も葉もない噂やトラブルは以前にも巻き込まれましたものね: ＠Shinka_H\nBaseless rumors have caused trouble before, after all...
Message.あんまり他人事だと思えないし、困ったときはお互い様だからあたしもちょっと調べてあ: I can't just think of it as someone else's problem. We should help each other when things get tough, so maybe I'll do a little digging, too.
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nそうですね！ 私もぜひ手伝わせてください！: ＠Chiyuru_T\nYou're right! Please let me help, too!
Message.……ふむ、風紀委員会が何やら大変そうだが何が起きているか知っているか？: ...Hmm. The Disciplinary Committee seems to have its hands full. Does anyone know what's happening?
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nうう……わ、分かりません……とりあえず怖いので、私は自室待機し: ＠Aoi_I\nUgh... I-I don't know... It's scary, so I'll stay in my room for now...
Message.＠Uruu_N\\nうるうはいつも通りだけど……でも確かにバタバタしてるわね。: ＠Uruu_N\nSame old Uruu... But yes, they really are rushing around.
Message.へー、気になるしちょっと野次馬でもしてこよっかな。: Oh? Now I'm curious. Maybe I'll go see what all the fuss is about.
Message.＠Rami_K\\n朽葉、あまり風紀委員会を困らせるものではないぞ……ふむ。今か: ＠Rami_K\nKuchiba, don't make more trouble for the Disciplinary Committee... Hmm. Perhaps I should go and keep an eye on things...
Message.＠Aoi_I\\n葵。それだと風紀委員の迷惑に葵の方がなっちゃうわよ？: ＠Aoi_I\nAoi. Wouldn't that make you the one getting in the Disciplinary Committee's way?
Message.む、それはそうか……しかし、何か大きなトラブルが起きていなければいいのだが。: Hm, you have a point... Still, I hope nothing serious has happened.
Message.前に話してたけど、本当に%usernameusernameuserna%が騒動の: We were just talking about this, and %usernameusernameuserna% really did turn out to be at the center of it all...
Message.事件の話を聞いて慌てて見に行ったら、風紀委員会の方々に囲まれて怒られていました…: When I heard about the incident, I rushed over to see, and there he was, surrounded by the Disciplinary Committee and getting scolded...
Message.＠Meru_M\\n無茶なことをしたのはフルートたちなので仕方ないんですが……小: ＠Meru_M\nFlute and the others did do something reckless, so we deserved it... But Xiaohua-san was seriously scary...\n＃TakingThisToHeart!
Message.……ＡＤ社に双頭の斧も関わるような騒動だったらしいな。%usernameuser: ...Apparently even AD Company and Double-Headed Axe were involved. Trouble really does love %usernameusernameuserna%.
Message.@T_Commander\\n……それ、胸を張ってわざわざ言うこと？: @T_Commander\n...Is that really something to be proud of?
Message.@T_Commander\\n流石にこのペースで巻き込まれるのは、どこかでお祓い: @T_Commander\nWith how often you get caught up in trouble, shouldn't you go somewhere for a purification ritual?
Message.まあ、%usernameusernameuserna%のせいってわけじゃないから: Well, it's not %usernameusernameuserna%'s fault. But I've had enough of days this hectic for a while.
Message.そうだねぇ。すごく大変だったから、しばらくの間はゆっくりしたいかも……: Yeah. It's been exhausting, so I think I'd like to take it easy for a while...
Message.私はまだもうちょっと忙しいかなぁ。色々と大変な事があったけど、おかげでビジネスチ: I'll probably be busy a little longer. It's been a lot to deal with, but I did spot a few business opportunities along the way.
Message.@T_Commander\\nフォローさせてもらった。これも何かの縁だ。また何か: @T_Commander\nI've followed you. Our paths crossed for a reason. I may call on you again.
Message.@T_Commander\\nええっと、改めてトリニティ・ジュエルのルナ・メロウ: @T_Commander\nUm, let me introduce myself again. I'm Luna Mellow from Trinity Jewel. It's a pleasure.
Message.おお、これでレイヴェルちゃん達もお知り合いですね！: Oh, now Ravel-chan and the others know you too!
Message.＠Flute_M\\nああ。また何かの機会に戦うことはあるだろう。それまでに実力: ＠Flute_M\nYes. I'm sure we'll face each other again. I'll have honed my skills further by then, so you can look forward to it.
Message.……あー、フルートが焚きつけちゃったからやる気になっちゃった。: ...Ah, Flute got them fired up. Now they're raring to go.
Message.こりゃ次は負けないようにしっかりと備えておかないとダメだよねー: Well, we'd better be ready. We can't let them beat us next time~.
Message.さっき、カオスメイデンの機体がガレムグラード山脈に行ってたけど何かしら？: I saw Chaos Maiden's machines heading toward the Garemgrad Mountains earlier. What's that about?
Message.＠Kurara_K\\n普通にメイズに潜るんじゃないの？: ＠Kurara_K\nAren't they just going into the Maze?
Message.＠Senka_H\\nそれがポータルがない場所に飛んでたのよ。なんかあったかなー: ＠Senka_H\nThat's the thing. They were flying somewhere with no portal. I wondered if something was going on.
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nこの前映画で見たの！ 山籠もりで秘密の特訓よ！ 己の感覚: ＠Kurara_K\nI saw it in a movie the other day! Secret training up in the mountains! They get stronger by making their senses one with their MG... or something like that!
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nカオスメイデンなら、確かにやりそうね……映画の特訓。: ＠Kurara_K\nChaos Maiden really might try it... Training from a movie.
Message.……シリウスシュガーのみんなが不在なのね。\\n誰か知ってる？: ...No one from Sirius Sugar is around.\nDoes anyone know where they are?
Message.＠Shinka_H\\n生駒さん達に映画を貸して、ついでに一緒におでかけしてたか: ＠Shinka_H\nI lent Ikoma-san and the others a movie, then went out with them, so I haven't seen anyone...
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nわたしも見てないかなー。珍しいよね: ＠Shinka_H\nI haven't seen them either~. That's unusual.
Message.ちょっと、ＭＧについて教えて欲しいことがあったのだけど……まあ仕方ないわね: I had something I wanted to ask about MGs... Well, I suppose it can't be helped.
Message.確か、今日は%usernameusernameuserna%さんが帰ってくる日だ: If I remember right, %usernameusernameuserna%-san is coming back today.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nそういえばそうだねー。めるちゃんなんて、この前見たときソ: ＠Shinka_H\nOh, that's right~. Meru-chan was so restless the last time I saw her!
Message.なるほどね！ そう言うことなら納得だわ！: Now I get it! That makes sense!
Message.＠Shinka_H\\n＠Noelle_A\\n＠Julie_S\\nあれ？ 行:
＠Shinka_H
＠Noelle_A
＠Julie_S
Huh? I saw Sirius Sugar in the administrative district, but %usernameusernameuserna% wasn't with them.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nちょっと色々あってTweety見れなかったんですけど、M: ＠Shinka_H\nA few things came up and I couldn't check Tweety, but if it's about piloting an MG, shall I come over tomorrow and help you, Shinka-san?
Message.＠Meru_M\\nありがとう、桃園さん。それで、何があったの？ ちょっと心配し: ＠Meru_M\nThank you, Momozono-san. So, what happened? I was a little worried...
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nええっと……説明が難しいんですけども、メイズの調査です！: ＠Shinka_H\nUm... It's hard to explain, but we were investigating the Maze!
Message.＠Meru_M\\nほう、そのような話があがっていたのか。こちらは知らなかったが: ＠Meru_M\nOh? I hadn't heard there was a plan for that...
Message.＠Aoi_I\\n%usernameusernameuserna%さん絡みだった: ＠Aoi_I\nIt involved %usernameusernameuserna%-san. It was an urgent matter...
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nなるほど、そういうことだったのか……ＬＯＣからまだ日が: ＠Nanairo_N\nI see, so that's what happened... It hasn't been long since LOC, yet things are already hectic again.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nまあ、それでも全体のパイロットのレベルも上がるしいいことが多い: ＠Aoi_I\nStill, it does help all the pilots improve. There are plenty of positives, aren't there?
Message.＠Maia_Y\\nいや、こんだけ事件とかに巻き込まれたらそんな事いってられない: ＠Maia_Y\nYeah, well, try saying that when you keep getting dragged into one incident after another!
Message.＠Maia_Y\\n＠Rami_K\\n確かに、あたしももう一度誘拐されるのは流: ＠Maia_Y\n＠Rami_K\nTrue... I really wouldn't want to get kidnapped again...
Message.な、なんと！ トレブルクインテットもメイズラッシュに参加しちゃいます！ みんな、: G-guess what! Treble Quintet is joining Maze Rush too! Everyone, cheer us on, pretty please!\n＃WeWontLose♪
Message.トリニティ・ジュエルは今回のメイズラッシュに参加する。ぜひ見てくれ: Trinity Jewel will be taking part in this Maze Rush. Be sure to watch.
Message.カラフルブーケはメイズラッシュに参加を表明する。是非とも、我々の活躍を応援してい: Colorful Bouquet is announcing its participation in Maze Rush. We hope you'll cheer us on.
Message.……色んなチームが宣伝してて、凄いわね。: ...So many teams are promoting themselves. Wow.
Message.＠Julie_S\\n新しいイベントだものね。特に危険な階層に挑むから注目度も高: ＠Julie_S\nIt's a new event, after all. They'll be tackling especially dangerous floors, so it's getting a lot of attention. People are cheering them on, and apparently there's even some unofficial betting.
Message.こういうのってお祭りって感じで楽しいね！: This feels like a festival! It's fun!
Message.＠Julie_S\\n＠Shinka_H\\n＠Noelle_A\\nちなみに、:
＠Julie_S
＠Shinka_H
＠Noelle_A
By the way, apparently this event was the Student Council president's idea.
Message.＠Maia_Y\\nえー！？ 生徒会長主催のイベントなの！？ それで勝ったら凄い: ＠Maia_Y\nWhat?! The Student Council president is hosting it?! Winning that would be a huge achievement! Shinka, let's enter!
Message.……選ばれるのは、各校舎でも実績と実力を認められたチームだけよ？ まずプレクラス: ...Only teams recognized by their school buildings for their skill and achievements get chosen, you know? Pre-Class teams aren't even eligible.
Message.＠Laura_K\\n一応実況を見てたけど、カオスメイデンがかなりの無茶をしたら: ＠Laura_K\nI was following the live commentary. Apparently Chaos Maiden did something pretty reckless.
Message.シリウスシュガーは残ってるみたい！ 頑張れー！: Sirius Sugar is still in it! Go, go!
Message.うんうん！ このまま優勝しちゃえー！: Yeah, yeah! Go all the way and win!
Message.メイズ内部の破壊に関して、今回のメイズラッシュでの特例です。\\n真似をした場合: Regarding damage to the Maze's interior: an exception has been made for this Maze Rush.\nAnyone caught imitating it will be punished.
Message.……まあ、やっぱり怒られるわよね。: ...Well, of course they'd get a warning.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nむむむ……天井を破壊しちゃうとか卑怯じゃない！？: ＠Shinka_H\nHmph... Isn't smashing the ceiling playing dirty?!
Message.＠Julie_S\\n確かに卑怯に見えるかもしれないが、メイズ内では何が起きても: ＠Julie_S\nIt may look that way, but anything can happen in the Maze. We bear some responsibility for failing to respond.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nか、カッコいい……！ そうなのね！ 分かったわ！: ＠Aoi_I\nS-so cool...! Oh, I see! I get it now!
Message.勝てなくてぴえんでしたが……応援のおかげで深くまで潜れちゃいました！ 皆さんぽよ: We didn't win, so... pien. But your support helped us get so far down! Thanks for all the poyo cheering, everyone!\n＃StillStingsThough!
Message.……有名どころのチームもほとんど脱落しちゃったわね。実況から、ついに煌晶帯に潜っ: ...Nearly all the big-name teams have been eliminated. According to the live commentary, they've finally reached the Crystal Belt.
Message.＠Shinka_H\\n煌晶帯……確かクリスタルがいっぱいあるんだっけ？ ふふ、: ＠Shinka_H\nThe Crystal Belt... Isn't that full of crystals? Hehe, it sounds so lovely and sparkly♪
Message.＠Laura_K\\n噂によると、直撃するとＭＧも溶かすようなプラズマ照射をして: ＠Laura_K\nApparently they fire plasma beams that can melt even an MG with a direct hit.
Message.でも、クリスタルがいっぱいって面白そうだね！: But all those crystals sound fun!
Message.＠Noelle_A\\nわたし達もちょっと踏み込んだことはあるけど、あそこは危険: ＠Noelle_A\nWe've ventured in a little way ourselves, but it's far too dangerous... The danger is on a whole different level.
Message.というか、シリウスシュガーも戻ってきてないけど……まさか煌晶帯に到着したのかしら: Come to think of it, Sirius Sugar hasn't come back either... Could they have reached the Crystal Belt?
Message.＠Kurara_K\\nはっ！？ 確かにそうね！ シリウスシュガー頑張れー！ 優: ＠Kurara_K\nOh! You're right! Go, Sirius Sugar! You can win this!
Message.こちらでも募集いたします。\\n煌晶帯でのトラブルが発生した可能性があるため、\:
We are also recruiting here.
There may have been an incident in the Crystal Belt,
so we are seeking personnel for a rescue team.
Please contact the Disciplinary Committee directly.
Message.ええ……だ、大丈夫なのかしら？: Oh... W-will they be all right?
Message.＠Laura_K\\n聞いてきたが、どうやら指揮官機の信号がロストしたらしい。念: ＠Laura_K\nI went to ask. Apparently they've lost the signal from the Commander's machine. This is a precaution.
Message.なるほど……つまり大丈夫な可能性もあるのね！: So... They might still be okay!
Message.うう～！ いけたら救助に行きたかったなぁ……: Ugh~! I wish I could go help rescue them...
Message.＠Noelle_A\\n救助だから、暴れられないわよ？: ＠Noelle_A\nIt's a rescue mission. You wouldn't get to run wild, you know?
Message.＠Shinka_H\\nあー、そうなんだ。なら我慢できそう！: ＠Shinka_H\nOh, right. Then I think I can bear sitting it out!
Message.ええっと……そういう話じゃないとは思うんだけど……: Um... I don't think that's the point...
Message.……なんだかんだすごいチームになっちゃいました！\\n＃救助チーム、マジで激熱！: ...We've ended up with quite a team!\n＃RescueTeamSeriouslyAmazing!
Message.各チームからの選抜と考えると、確かにな……とはいえ、救助目的でひたすら潜るだけに: With people selected from each team, I suppose it is... Though their purpose is rescue, so they'll likely just keep heading down.
Message.うわー！ なんか選抜チームって恰好いいわね！ あたしもいつか選ばれたいわ！: Wow! A handpicked team sounds so cool! I want to be chosen someday too!
Message.＠Julie_S\\nふふ、頑張っていればきっといつかなれるわ。: ＠Julie_S\nHehe, keep working at it and I'm sure you will.
Message.ジュリーは、なんとなくカオスメイデンのバーンズさんを目指すと良さそうよね。: Somehow, I think Barnes-san from Chaos Maiden might be a good role model for Julie.

Message.＠Lucie_M\\nえへん！ ボクたちも成長するんだからね！: @Lucie_M\nEhem! We grow up too, you know!
Message.＠Lucie_M\\nはい……お仕事のこと、褒めてもらえましたし……: @Lucie_M\nYes... and we were praised for our work...

Message.＠Harriet_M\\nそれは調子乗りすぎだ……でもまあ、立派になったもんだ。: @Harriet_M\nThat's getting too carried away... But well, you really have become splendid.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nなんか、前にも言った気がするな……それ。\\nあた: @T_Commander\nFeel like I said that before... that.\nI'm not your mother.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうだそうだ！ 呼んじゃダメなんだよ ボクも喜ぶか: @T_Commander\nThat's right, that's right! You shouldn't call her that! I thought she'd be happy and told her directly, but got a noogie!
Message.メイド服以外の服を着ると、ムズムズすんな……: Wearing clothes other than a maid uniform makes me feel all restless...
Message.＠Lucie_M\\nあ、リュシー様！ 新しい服着るの！？ 見せて見せて！: @Lucie_M\nAh, Lucie-sama! Are you wearing new clothes!? Show me, show me!
Message.＠Lucie_M\\nわ、私も少し気になるかも……: @Lucie_M\nI-I might be a little curious too...
Message.リュシー様の新しい服……ど、どんな格好でも似合いそう……うう、妄想が止まらない…: Lucie-sama's new clothes... N-No matter what look, it'd suit her... Ugh, my delusional fantasies won't stop...
Message.……あー、まあ期待してるところ悪いが礼服みたいなもんだぞ？: ...Ah, well, sorry to burst your bubble, but it's basically like formal attire, okay?
Message.りゅ、リュシー様の礼服……それはそれでとても良いですね！: L-Lucie-sama's formal attire... That's super great in its own way!
Message.＠Harriet_M\\nリュシーだったら、執事服なんて言うのも似合いそうね。: @Harriet_M\nIf it's Lucie, something like a butler suit would suit her too.
Message.確かに……とても格好良さそうです。: Indeed... It seems like it would be very cool.
Message.私も着てみたい！: I want to try wearing one too!
Message.……最近、ミリアム達が成長をしてる姿を見てると、\\nなんだか感慨深くなるんだよ: ...Lately, watching Miriam and the others grow up,\nsomehow makes me deeply moved.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n……まあ、あいつらを見守る立場からは卒業かもな。嬉: @T_Commander\n...Well, maybe I'm graduating from the position of watching over them. Happy yet sad... it's a strange feeling.
Message.＠Lucie_M\\nふふ、リュシーったら本当にお姉さんみたいだわ。: @Lucie_M\nFufu, Lucie really sounds like a big sister.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n誰が母親だ！ ……だけど、確かに子供の面倒を見るの: @T_Commander\nWho's a mother! ...But, caring for children really feels like this, I guess.
Message.ふふ……リュシー、本当にわたくしたちが子供の時のお母さまみたいになってるわ。: Fufu... Lucie really looks like our mother back when we were children.
Message.……あー、なんだ。思い出してきた。\\nそういえばお嬢の奥様と旦那様も感動してた: ...Ah, what was it. I'm remembering now.\nCome to think of it, the Young Lady's Madam and Master were moved back then too.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nお嬢が昔、おてんば娘だったのは知ってると思うんだが: @T_Commander\nI think you know the Young Lady was a tomboy in the past... so Madam and Master were worried too, right? But she became serious so she could make me her maid.
Message.あなたたち、こっちの世界に来てから何か新しく始めたこととかあるかしら？: Is there anything new you girls have started doing since coming to this world?
Message.@Chizuru_S\\n急にどうしたんだ、委員長？: @Chizuru_S\nWhat brought this on all of a sudden, Committee Chair?
Message.ふと気になったのよ。せっかく平和なんだし、何か新しいことに挑戦するべきなんじゃな: It just randomly crossed my mind. Since it's peaceful after all, shouldn't we challenge ourselves with something new...
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nボクはゲームかなぁ。対戦ゲームとか端末のゲームとか色々: @Chizuru_S\nFor me, games, I guess. Playing PvP games, mobile terminal games, all kinds~.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nふむ、私は意図して新たに始めたということは無いが、散歩: @Chizuru_S\nHmm, I haven't intentionally started anything new, but the frequency of going out for walks has increased a bit. I also hope it might serve as some sort of trigger to awaken memories.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nわたしもお買い物とかですね！: @Chizuru_S\nI go shopping and things like that too!
Message.……みんな、新しいことに挑戦してるのね。私も何かに挑戦すべきかしら？: ...Everyone is challenging new things, huh. Should I challenge something too?
Message.あー、しまった！ 依頼先で財布忘れた！: Ah~ shoot! I forgot my wallet at the client's place!
Message.@Takeru_S\\nああ、白銀のだったのね。ここで聞こうと思ってたのよ。私た: @Takeru_S\nAh, so it was Shirogane's. I was planning to ask here. Someone delivered it saying it might belong to one of us.
Message.@Takeru_S\\n私じゃなくて、拾ってくれた人に感謝しなさい。全く……違う: @Takeru_S\nDon't thank me, thank the person who picked it up. Honestly... you aren't slackening off just because this is a different world, are you?
Message.いやー、ゲームが楽し過ぎて……: Well~, games are just way too fun...
Message.改めて思うけど……端末で簡単に連絡が取れるのって凄いわよね。: Thinking about it again... being able to easily contact each other via terminal is amazing, isn't it.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\nああ、慣れた今では手放せないものになっているな。: @Chizuru_S\nYeah, now that we're used to it, it's become something we can't part with.
Message.@Meiya_M\\n通信機器は私たちの世界にも色々あったけど……手軽で、使える: @Meiya_M\nThere were various communication devices in our world too, but... being handy and having such a wide usable range is truly amazing. I wonder if we could somehow memorize it and reproduce it back in our original world?
Message.こういうものがあれば、戦場で不意に孤立しても連絡が取れるし、連携の精度も高まるわ: If we had something like this, even if isolated unexpectedly on the battlefield we could establish contact, and coordination precision would increase too. It seems usable for reviewing task documents as well.
Message.@Chizuru_S\\n確かに持って帰れたらいいんですが……元の世界の知識も曖: @Chizuru_S\nIndeed, it would be great if we could bring it back... but when our knowledge of our original world is hazy, can we really return with it remembered?
Message.頑張って覚えても、元の世界に帰ったらなんだっけ？ ってなっちゃいそうだよね。: Even if we try hard to memorize it, once we return to our original world, we'd probably end up like 'what was it again?'.
Message.@Kei_A\\nぐっ……言い返せないわ。 確かに気持ちが逸ってたわ……: @Kei_A\nGugh... I can't talk back to that. I really was getting ahead of myself...
Message.まあ、あったら便利だけどなくても何とかなるんじゃないかなー？ サバイバルだってそ: Well, it'd be convenient to have, but we'll probably manage without it, right~? Survival is pretty much like that anyway!
Message.榊と彩峰が何やら言い争いをしていたのだが……詳しいことを知っているものはいるか？: Sakaki and Ayamine were arguing about something... Does anyone know the details?
Message.@Miki_T\\nこっちの世界でも仲の悪さは変わんねーんだな……: @Miki_T\nEven in this world, their bad relationship hasn't changed, huh...
Message.@Meiya_M\\nあ、ボク知ってるよ！ 確か、依頼先のやり方で喧嘩しちゃった: @Meiya_M\nAh, I know! Pretty sure they fought over the way to handle things at the client's place.
Message.うん、依頼先の人はやり方は好きにしていいって言ってたけど……: Yeah, the client said we could do it however we liked, but...
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\nだとしても、マニュアルがあるなら従うべきでしょ！ なのに: @Mikoto_Y\nEven so, if there's a manual, you should follow it! But Ayamine went ahead and did it her own way without permission!
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\n時間優先。さっさと済ませたほうがいい。: @Mikoto_Y\nTime takes priority. Better to finish quickly.
Message.@Kei_A\\n今後もお願いされるかもしれないんだから、丁寧にやるのが当然でし: @Kei_A\nWe might be asked again in the future, so doing it thoroughly is only natural! Doing a sloppy job just troubles the client!
Message.ねえ、勝手に山に入ったら怒られるかな？: Hey, will I get scolded if I enter the mountain without permission?
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n……当たり前でしょ。ちゃんと手続きをして申請をしないとだ: @Mikoto_Y\n...Of course. You have to go through proper procedures and apply.
Message.あー、やっぱりそうだよね。結構探検というか、行ってみたい場所があるんだけど……う: Ah~, thought so. I have quite a few places I want to explore or visit, but... mm, such a pain.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣、客人である以上は郷に入れば郷に従うべきだ。: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi, as long as you're a guest, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Message.まあでも、気持ちは分かるな。手続き面倒くさいんだよなぁ……: Well, but I get the feeling. Procedures are such a pain...
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nねー、面倒だよね。代わりに誰か手続きしてくれないかなぁ…: @Takeru_S\nRight~, it's a pain. I wonder if someone would do the procedures for me...
Message.それでやるっていう奴はいないだろ……: No one's gonna say they'll do it for that reason...
Message.そういえば、生徒会長さんに山に行っていいかってお願いしてきたよー！: Speaking of which, I asked the student council president if we could go to the mountain~!
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\nえっ、ピクニック！？ わたしもいきたい！: @Mikoto_Y\nEh, a picnic!? I want to go too!
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n美琴が行くんだぞ。ピクニックじゃなくてサバイバルに決まっ: @Sumika_K\nMikoto is the one going. It's obviously gonna be survival, not a picnic.
Message.@Mikoto_Y\\n良かったじゃない。折角の山登りなんだから楽しんできたら？: @Mikoto_Y\nIsn't that great. Since it's a mountain climb after all, why not enjoy it?
Message.＠Meiya_M\\nそうなんだよねぇ。一応、ここの近くの山は学園の管理外で外部: @Meiya_M\nYeah, that's right. Apparently, the mountains near here aren't under academy management and there are outsiders, so for our safety, a supervisor is necessary.
Message.おい、なんかオレ、オチが読めたぞ。: Hey, somehow I can read the punchline.
Message.うーん……端末の容量が足りない……: Mmm... The terminal storage isn't enough...
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\nあー、分かるぞ美琴。使ってないゲームは削除していかないと: @Mikoto_Y\nAh~, I get it, Mikoto. If you don't delete games you aren't playing, storage really exceeds its limit in the blink of an eye.

Message.＠Miki_T\\nみたいだねー。うーん、結構やってないのもあるから消していこっ: @Miki_T\nSeems so~. Mmm, there are quite a few I haven't been playing, so maybe I'll delete them.
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nしかし、タケルはよく知っていたな。: @Takeru_S\nStill, Takeru was remarkably knowledgeable about that.
Message.もしかして、前に壊れたって半泣きで生徒会の人へ相談にいってたのって……: Could it be that the person who went to consult the student council almost crying because it broke before was...
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n純夏！ 飯奢ってやるから内緒にしといてくれ！: @Sumika_K\nSumika! I'll treat you to a meal so keep it a secret!
Message.うう、お金が足りないよ……: Ugh, I don't have enough money...

Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n容量が空いたから、気になる新作ゲームを色々と買ってたら: @Chizuru_S\nSince storage freed up, I was buying various new games I was curious about... Plus folk art crafts I liked...
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣……あなたまで白銀みたいな無駄使いをしていたらダメよ: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi... You shouldn't waste money like Shirogane does.
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\nおい、俺は関係ないだろ！: @Chizuru_S\nHey, I have nothing to do with this!
Message.＠Takeru_S\\n私にであれば可能な限り善処するが、余人に無心を頼むのは感: @Takeru_S\nIf it's to me, I'll deal with it as best as I can, but asking others for money isn't praiseworthy. I think you should reflect on yourself before it becomes a major issue.
Message.あっ、それいいね！ ボクもお小遣いが足りない時は奢って貰おう！: Ah, that sounds great! I'll ask people to treat me too when my pocket money isn't enough!
Message.ダメな方で共鳴しないの！: Don't resonate on the bad side!
Message.鎧衣さんとタケルちゃん、ふたりともこっちの世界満喫してるね……: Yoroi-san and Takeru-chan, both of you are enjoying this world to the fullest, huh...
Message.ねえねえ、彩峰さんどこにいるのー！？ 依頼の日だよー！: Hey hey, Ayamine-san, where are you~!? It's the day of the commission~!
Message.＠Kei_A\\nええええ！？ わたしの方が遅刻ー！？ 今行くねー！: @Kei_A\nEhhhh!? I'm the one who's late~!? Coming right now~!
Message.……これどう考えても、彩峰が待ち合わせ無視して、さっさと依頼に行ったよな？: ...No matter how you look at this, Ayamine ignored the meeting point and rushed straight to the request, right?
Message.＠Kei_A\\n彩峰！こういう行き違いを防ぐために、一度集合するって話だったで: @Kei_A\nAyamine! We talked about gathering once to prevent this kind of miscommunication, didn't we!
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n早く着いて先に作業していれば早く終わる。何も問題はない: @Chizuru_S\nArriving early and working ahead finishes it early. No problem at all.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n問題大ありよ！ そのせいで鑑さんが困ってるじゃない！: @Kei_A\nThere's a HUGE problem! Thanks to that, Kagami-san is troubled, isn't she!
Message.＠Kei_A\\nあなたねぇ……！ 帰ってきたらお話があるからね！: @Kei_A\nYou...! We need to talk once you get back!
Message.やっぱり、やきそばパンは至高。: Yakisoba pan is supreme after all.
Message.こっちだと知らない食べ物も多いですし、なにより食事が美味しくて、ついつい食べ過ぎ: There are many unfamiliar foods over here, and above all, meals are delicious, so you end up accidentally overeating, don't you.
Message.＠Miki_T\\nそうね。和食もあるし、選択肢が多くて助かるわ。: @Miki_T\nIndeed. There's Japanese food too, and having many choices is a big help.
Message.ジャンクフードも美味いんだよなぁ……特に深夜に食うのは反則レベルだ。: Junk food is super tasty too... Eating it late at night is straight-up foul level.
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nあー、夜にゲームしながら食べるとなおさら美味しいよねぇ。: @Takeru_S\nAh~, eating it at night while gaming makes it taste even better~.
Message.……あなたたち、夜更かしして間食してるの？: ...Are you guys staying up late and snacking?
Message.柊校舎の屋上、悪くない。: The rooftop of Hiiragi building, not bad.
Message.見晴らしも良くて風も気持ちいい。: The view is great and the breeze feels good.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n気分転換によさそうですね！: @Kei_A\nSeems good for a change of pace!
Message.＠Kei_A\\n行政地区の建物は基本的に屋上が未開放だからなぁ。: @Kei_A\nBuildings in the administrative district basically don't have open rooftops, after all.
Message.私は一度あがったことがある。良い景色であった。: I've gone up once. It was a fine view.
Message.＠Kei_A\\n……嫌な予感がするんだけど、ちゃんと許可は貰ってるわよね？: @Kei_A\n...I have a bad feeling about this, but you got proper permission, right?
Message.＠Kei_A\\n多分じゃないわよ！？ ちゃんと許可は取らないと迷惑がかかるでし: @Kei_A\nDon't say 'probably'!? If you don't get proper permission, it causes trouble!
Message.＠Chizuru_S\\n榊は堅苦しい。空は自由。: @Chizuru_S\nSakaki is stiff. The sky is free.
Message.こっちの世界、飯が美味いから太りそうなんだよな……\\n運動量増やすべきか？: The food in this world is so good I feel like I'll gain weight...\nShould I increase my exercise?
Message.＠Takeru_S\\nうう……わたしもあんまり人の事言えないかも……食べすぎち: @Takeru_S\nUgh... I can't really talk about others either... I might turn squishy from overeating.
Message.＠Sumika_K\\n食は人の天なりと言う。自堕落な食事は禁物だぞ。: @Sumika_K\nThey say food is heaven to the people. Self-indulgent eating is forbidden.
Message.＠Meiya_M\\nそうですね！何事も体が資本ですから！体にいいものを食べない: @Meiya_M\nThat's right! Health is wealth for everything! We must eat things good for the body!
Message.強化装備や軍装が入らなくなっちゃったら大変よ。: It'd be disastrous if fortified equipment or military wear stopped fitting.
Message.ボクはいくら食べても太らないけどなあ。: I don't gain weight no matter how much I eat, though.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n鎧衣、その発言は世界を敵に回すわよ。: @Mikoto_Y\nYoroi, that statement will make an enemy of the whole world.
Message.＠Mikoto_Y\\n羨ましい。私は胸がキツくなる。: @Mikoto_Y\nJealous. Mine gets tight around the chest.
Message.＠Kei_A\\nそれはそれで世界を敵に回す発言です……: @Kei_A\nThat is a statement that makes an enemy of the world in its own right...
Message.新しいパイロットスーツ……\\n脱ぎ着するのにちょっとコツがいりますね。\\n脚: The new pilot suit...\nTaking it on and off takes a bit of a knack.\nMy leg got caught in a weird spot and I panicked...
Message.＠Meru_M \\n無理に引っ張って壊さないようにしなさいよ。\\n支給品なん: @Meru_M\nDon't force-pull it and break it.\nIt's issued equipment, after all.
Message.＠Meru_M \\n普段の制服と違って特殊な素材ですから、着るのが少し手間かも: @Meru_M\nUnlike regular uniforms, it's a special material, so putting it on might take a bit of effort.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n一癖二癖あるスーツよね。\\nでもちゃんと考えて着れば、慣れ: @Meru_M\nIt's a suit with a quirk or two.\nBut if you put it on thoughtfully, getting used to it won't take much time.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも……少し時間がかかりそう。\\nマニュアルがないと前: @Meru_M\nI'm... probably going to take a bit of time too.\nWithout a manual, I feel like I'd put it on backward...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうですね……訓練のとき以外でも着脱練習できれば…: @T_Commander\nIndeed... If we could practice putting it on and off outside of training too...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはいっ！ あとは数をこなすしかないですね。頑張りま: @T_Commander\nYes! All that's left is to do it repeatedly. I'll do my best!
Message.＠T_Commander\\n必ず本番までにスムーズに着られるようにしますね。: @T_Commander\nI will definitely make sure to put it on smoothly before the actual performance.
Message.天穹の操縦マニュアルを読み込んでるんですけど\\n機能がたくさんあって覚えるのが: I'm thoroughly reading the Tenkyu operation manual,\nthere are so many functions it's hard to memorize them all.\nBut it really is an awesome unit!
Message.＠Meru_M \\nめるちゃんなら気合でいけるいける！: @Meru_M\nMeru-chan can totally do it with willpower!
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしもマニュアルはまだよくわからないけど、確かにすごくいい: @Meru_M\nI don't really understand the manual well yet either, but I can certainly tell it's a super good unit.
Message.＠Meru_M \\n基本の操作は今までの機体と共通してますから、\\nそんなに: @Meru_M\nBasic controls are shared with previous units,\nso there's no need to panic that much.
Message.＠Meru_M \\nめるってば読むことに集中しすぎて、徹夜したりしてそう……: @Meru_M\nKnowing Meru, she's probably concentrating so hard on reading that she stays up all night...
Message.＠Rami_K \\nうぅ……図星です……\\n実際昨日も遅くまで読みふけってし: @Rami_K\nUgh... Hit the nail on the head...\nActually yesterday too I was engrossed in reading until late...
Message.＠Meru_M\\nほら言わんこっちゃない。作戦の前に寝不足で体調崩したりしない: @Meru_M\nSee, what did I tell you. Don't ruin your condition from sleep deprivation before the operation, okay?\nIt's not early today either, go to sleep now.
Message.『双頭の斧』一斉検挙……ＭＧ競技ともまた違う対人の作戦……しかも今度はこちらから: Simultaneous roundup of 'Double-Headed Axe'... A person-versus-person operation, different from MG competitions... Plus this time we're taking the initiative... Somehow I feel a bit hesitant.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n……そうですわね。ですが、彼らは人々の安全を脅かす存在でもあ: @Meru_M\n...Indeed. However, they are also entities that threaten people's safety.\nThere's no need for us to hesitate... That is how we should think.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n＠Nanairo_N\\nそーそー！\\n悪いことしてるやつ:
＠Meru_M
＠Nanairo_N
没错没错！
做坏事的家伙，就让大家一起狠狠收拾掉！
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\n相手は違法パイロットの組織よ。\\n卑怯な手を使ってく:
@Chiyuru_T
The opponent is an illegal pilot organization.
They might use cowardly tricks.
Don't let your guard down~.
Message.＠Rami_K\\n……相手がどう動くか、予測しにくい。\\n罠とか仕掛けられて: @Rami_K\n...It's hard to predict how the opponent will move.\nTraps might be set as well.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……！\\nはいっ、私も皆さ: %usernameusernameuserna%-san...!\nYes, I will protect everyone with all my power too.\nLet's all return safely together!
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはい！ みんなで互いに助け合っていけば、何も危ない: @T_Commander\nYes! As long as everyone helps each other, nothing should be dangerous...!
Message.作戦本番まで時間はありませんわ。引き続き、その少ない時間を可能な限り天穹の習熟に: There is little time until the actual operation. Let's continue striving to familiarize ourselves with Tenkyu as much as possible within that brief time.
Message.来たる作戦に向けて、エネルギーと気合をしっかり補充しようと思うんです！\\nなの: For the upcoming operation, I plan to properly replenish energy and spirits!\nSo today, I'm getting the jumbo cutlet curry at the cafeteria!
Message.＠Meru_M \\nいいねいいね！ いっぱい食べるめるちゃん好きだよ。\\nあ: @Meru_M\nNice, nice! I love Meru-chan eating a lot.\nMaybe I'll get pumped up with a jumbo burger and mega-portion fries too~.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも……マカダミアナッツ大盛りを食べ納めしておく。\\n: @Meru_M\nI'll... eat a mega portion of macadamia nuts one last time too.\nNuts really are supreme.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nむしろわたくしは本番を見据えて、ここしばらくはバランスの良い: @Meru_M\nRather, looking ahead to the main performance, I intend to keep a balanced diet in mind for a while.
Message.＠Nanairo_N\\nそれが正解ね。というか、調子に乗って食べ過ぎて、スーツ: @Nanairo_N\nThat's the right answer. I mean, don't get carried away, overeat, and end up like 'I can't fit into my suit anymore~!', okay?
Message.このスーツ、すごくピチッとしてる。普通の制服とは全然違う感覚。: This suit is super tight. A completely different feel from normal uniforms.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nわかるー！ でも素材が柔らかくて意外と動きやすいよね。: @Shirona_I\nI know, right~! But the material is soft and surprisingly easy to move in.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n＠Chiyuru_T\\n天穹には間接思考制御が未搭載:
＠Shirona_I
＠Chiyuru_T
天穹没有搭载间接思考控制，所以要用这套服装来弥补，是这么说的吧。规格不同，习惯起来应该会很辛苦。
Message.会長が言うには、天穹を動かすのに絶対必要なものなんですよね。: According to the president, it's something absolutely necessary to pilot Tenkyu, right.
Message.＠Meru_M\\nええ。これから双頭の斧の検挙という大作戦も控えていますし、早: @Meru_M\nYes. We have the big operation of arresting Double-Headed Axe ahead, so we must quickly get used to the unit and suit.
Message.＠Meru_M\n＠Nanairo_N\nうん。でもいくら黎明と似てると言っても:
＠Meru_M
＠Nanairo_N
嗯。不过就算和黎明很相似，我还是有点不安，不知道能不能在作战前好好操控……
Message.＠T_Commander\\nありがとう。あなたがそう言って見守ってくれていると: @T_Commander\nThank you. Knowing that you say so and watch over us makes me feel strangely relieved.
Message.みんな、天穹の操作マニュアルってもう読んだ？: Has everyone read the Tenkyu operation manual already?
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nいや、まだ全然。着替えたばっかだし、これから読もうと思: @Shirona_I\nNo, not at all yet. Just changed clothes, was thinking of reading it now.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nあたしもパラパラって斜め読みしただけかなー。とりあえず: @Shirona_I\nI just skimmed through it loosely too~. Anyway, if we try moving it we'll get it!
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nちゆるさん……ちゃんとマニュアルには目を通してください: @Chiyuru_T\nChiyuru-san... Please properly go through the manual. Though, the volume is large so I understand how you feel, but...
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n私も少し読みましたけど、黎明とは細かいところで意外と違: @Shirona_I\nI read a bit too, but there are surprisingly different parts from Reimei in small details, so I'm confused. Basic parts are the same, but... can we really operate it well?
Message.＠Meru_M\\nわたしも同じ。でも、少しでも早くみんなの役に立てるように、今: @Meru_M\nSame for me. But to be of help to everyone even a bit faster, I'll summarize just the key points and share them now.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nまぁ！ 白奈さん、すごく助かりますわ！ すぐに目を通し: @Shirona_I\nMy! Shirona-san, that helps so much! I'll go through it right away.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\n白奈めっちゃ真面目じゃん。ラミもそれ見ておくわ。サンキ: @Shirona_I\nShirona is super diligent. Rami will check that out too. Thanks.
Message.作戦日が近づいてきて、なんだかそわそわしてきちゃった。: As the operation day approaches, I've gotten kind of restless.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nわかります！ 私も落ち着かないです。: @Shirona_I\nI understand! I can't settle down either.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n＠Shirona_I\\nわたくしたちの連携があれば大丈夫で:
＠Meru_M
＠Shirona_I
只要有我们的配合就没问题。不过，面对未知事态也必须做好心理准备。
Message.こういう時は、甘いものでも食べて気合いを入れたいとこだけどねー。: At times like this, I'd like to eat something sweet to pump myself up, though~.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nラミはとっくに気合い十分だし。白奈はどうやって気持ちを: @Shirona_I\nRami is already full of motivation. How are you calming your mind, Shirona?
Message.＠Rami_K\\nわたしは今日のために運気を上げるおまじないをしてる。: @Rami_K\nFor today, I'm doing a lucky charm ritual to boost good fortune.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nおまじない？ なになに、気になる！: @Shirona_I\nA lucky charm? What, what is it, I'm curious!
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\n右足から機体に乗り込むと、悪いことを避けられるらしい。: @Chiyuru_T\nSupposedly, boarding the unit with your right foot first lets you avoid bad things. That's what came up in online fortune-telling. So I'm practicing it.
Message.特別なパイロットスーツと天穹……わたしたちだけに与えられた大切な切り札。失敗でき: Special pilot suits and Tenkyu... Important trump cards granted only to us. We cannot fail.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nそうですね。これを着ていると、なんだかすごく気が引き締: @Shirona_I\nThat's true. Wearing this somehow makes my tension tighten up.
Message.＠Meru_M\\n＠Shirona_I\\n選ばれたからには、シリウスシュガー:
＠Meru_M
＠Shirona_I
既然被选中，就让他们见识一下Sirius Sugar至今为止的成果吧。
Message.……ま、やるからには、全力ね。: ...Well, if we're doing it, we go all out.
Message.でも無理は禁物だよ？ 危なくなったらすぐみんなでフォローし合うからね。: But don't overdo it, okay? If it gets dangerous, we'll immediately support each other.
Message.＠Chiyuru_T\\nそういう意味ではわたし、一番フォローされそう。不器用だ: @Chiyuru_T\nIn that sense, I'll probably be supported the most. I'm clumsy and might drag everyone down.
Message.＠Shirona_I\\nそんなことないです！ 白奈さんはいつも私たちを助けてく: @Shirona_I\nThat's not true! Shirona-san is always saving us!
Message.そうだよ！ 白奈ちゃんには何度も救われてるんだから、自信持って！: That's right! We've been saved by Shirona-chan many times, so have confidence!
Message.ええ、わたくしたちは最高のチームですわ。堂々としていてくださいな。: Yes, we are the best team. Please stand tall and proud.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\n要求していた追加の物資と装備、事前に渡したリスト通りに用: @Kagura_S\nThe additional supplies and equipment I requested, can they be prepared according to the list provided beforehand?
Message.＠Kotoha\\nええ、問題なく手配済みです。……ですが、いくら秘匿回線とはい: @Kotoha\nYes, arranged without issue. ...However, no matter how confidential the line is, what do you intend to do if 'that thing' happens to see this communication?
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nだからこその暗号化でしょ。それにもし見られていたとしても: @Kagura_S\nThat's why it's encrypted. Besides, even if it were seen, as long as we don't do a decisive 'line crossing', they won't do anything directly.
Message.『ヤツ』にとってみれば、ストリートで這いつくばる私たちの行動なんて、ただの虫けら: To 'that guy', our actions crawling on the streets are seen as nothing more than the intimidation of insects.
Message.＠Kotoha\\n……相手の傲慢さに助けられている部分があるにせよ、警戒は必要: @Kotoha\n...Even if there's a part where we're saved by the opponent's arrogance, vigilance is required. Just in case, we shouldn't delve too deeply into further talk.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\n当然よ。あんたも日々の学園生活の中で、せいぜいボロを出さ: @Kagura_S\nNaturally. You be careful not to reveal any flaws in your daily academy life either. ...Then, I leave the supplies matter to you.
Message.＠Kotoha\\n頼まれていたもの、指定のポイントに隠しておきました。リストの: @Kotoha\nWhat you asked for has been hidden at the designated point. In addition to items on the list, I've included a few luxury treats from myself.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\n確認したわ。……って、なんでこんなに甘いお菓子ばかり入っ: @Kagura_S\nConfirmed. ...Wait, why are there only sweet treats in here? They shouldn't have been on the request list I gave you.
Message.＠Kotoha\\n……あなたが最近、ろくに休息を取らずに動き回っていると推測し: @Kotoha\n...Because I inferred that you've been running around recently without proper rest. It's a proposal to at least take in sugar and rest your brain and body a little.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nそんな甘いものをゆっくり食べてる余裕なんてないわ。……で: @Kagura_S\nI don't have the luxury to slowly eat sweet stuff like that. ...But throwing it away is a waste, so I'll distribute them to my subordinates.
Message.＠Kotoha\\n彼らに配るのは構いませんが、あなた自身もちゃんと食べるのです: @Kotoha\nDistributing to them is fine, but you must eat properly yourself too. ...If you collapse, everything goes down the drain.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\n言われなくてもわかってるわよ。細かいことぐだぐだと。あん: @Kagura_S\nI know without you telling me. Nagging about tiny details. Do you think you've become my mother or something? That's what you call uncalled-for meddling.
Message.＠Kotoha\\nそれであれば、物資の提供はお節介でしょうか。: @Kotoha\nIn that case, is providing supplies meddling as well?
Message.＠Kagura_S\\n昨日提供してもらった資材のおかげで、地穴帯にある防衛拠点: @Kagura_S\nThanks to the materials provided yesterday, reinforcement of the defense base in the cavern zone is somehow finished. With this, even if there's a Maze Shifter raid, it should hold up.
Message.＠Kotoha\\nそれは重畳です。ですが、あくまでメイズの拠点は一時的な隠れ家: @Kotoha\nThat is excellent. However, the base in the Maze is ultimately a temporary hideout. Please do not consider reckless interception or combat that expands damage.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nわかってるわよ。ああ、それと、しばらく忙しくなるから、連: @Kagura_S\nI know. Ah, also, I'll be busy for a while, so I won't be reachable.
Message.＠Kotoha\\n……わかりました。これが『最後』にならないことを祈ってます。: @Kotoha\n...Understood. I pray this won't be the 'last'.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nフン、誰に言ってんのよ。\\n……………………あんたこそ: @Kagura_S\nHmph, who are you talking to.\n........................You better not screw up either.
Message.＠Kotoha\\nええ、お互いの役割を、全うしましょう。どうか、ご無事で。: @Kotoha\nYes, let's fulfill our respective roles. Please stay safe.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nアホバカ間抜け、返事しろ。そっちの状況教えなさい。こっち: @Kagura_S\nFool idiot dummy, reply. Tell me your situation over there. I'm still inside the Maze too. But I've already merged with 'them'.
Message.＠Kagura_S\\nいつもなら秒で返してくるくせに、なんで何の反応もないわけ: @Kagura_S\nWhen usually you reply in seconds, why isn't there any reaction. You idiot Kagura. You're actually reading this, right? Making fun of me?
Message.＠T_Commander\\nなんで真横にいるのに、わざわざメッセージで送ってく: @T_Commander\nWhy are you sending messages on purpose when you're right next to me! No one is re-reading them!
Message.＠T_Commander\\nはぁ？ あいつが返事してくるから、ちょっと付き合っ:
＠T_Commander
哈？　是那家伙会回消息，我才稍微陪她一下而已！
话说，你在旁边装睡，偷看我的设备屏幕了吗！？
Message.えーっと、ライブ用に連絡はこっちで取ろうね。: Umm, let's use this for live performance contact, okay.
Message.＠Sienna_C\\n分かった！ あれ？ 公式アカウントみたいなの作らないの？: @Sienna_C\nGot it! Huh? Aren't we making an official account? Lilly loves Justion's official account, though.
Message.あはは……流石にやらないかな。私はあんまりそういうのには詳しくないし……: Ahaha... We probably won't go that far. I'm not very detailed about that kind of stuff...
Message.＠Sienna_C\\n＠Lilly_L\\nところがどっこい。実はもうアカウン: @Sienna_C\n@Lilly_L\nGuess what, though. Truth is, the account is already made~.
Message.＠Layla_J\\nおお！ 凄い！ リリーたちのバンドアカウントだ！: @Layla_J\nOoh! Awesome! It's Lilly and the team's band account!
Message.前から準備していたな？ しかし、あまり呟いていないな。: You've been preparing for a while, huh? But you haven't tweeted much.
Message.あー、それはほら……路上ライブの時があったからさぁ……: Ah, well that's... because there was that street live time...
Message.……なるほど、ならば運用は少し考えたほうが良さそうだな。: ...I see, then we should probably think a bit more about how to run it.
Message.＠Layla_J\\n@Reivel_B\\nあんまり手伝えることはないかもしれ: @Layla_J\n@Reivel_B\nI might not be able to help with much, but if there's anything I can do, consult with me, okay?
Message.そういえば、みんなはどういう経緯で楽器演奏を始めたの？\\n軽く話したけど、ちょ: Speaking of which, how did everyone end up starting to play instruments?\nWe talked briefly, but I'm a bit curious.
Message.＠Sienna_C\\n私はライブハウスでバイトしてる友達がいたんだけど……その: @Sienna_C\nI had a friend working part-time at a live house... I was invited back then, and ended up playing drums a bit.
Message.＠Sienna_C\\nな～んにもわからないから必死に勉強して、でも結局話がおじ: @Sienna_C\nKnowing absolutely nothing, I studied frantically, but in the end the project fell through—a bitter memory... But since it's being put to use here, all's well that ends well!
Message.＠Sienna_C\\nモデルの企画でバンドを組んだのが初めてだな。あくまで服の: @Sienna_C\nForming a band for a modeling project was my first time. It was strictly for promoting clothes, but even so I approached it seriously back then.
Message.……な、なんかみんな凄い経歴がある！？ リリーにもエピソードが必要だったりする！: ...Wh-Why does everyone have such amazing backgrounds!? Does Lilly need a story too!?
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nいや、まずリリーはオーディションでシエナの熱烈な支持で選ば: @Lilly_L\nNo, first of all Lilly was chosen with Sienna's passionate support in the audition, so you're the most dramatic...
Message.映画なら、このままスターに駆け上がるだろうな。: If it were a movie, you'd climb straight to stardom from here.
Message.うう、みんなが凄いせいで、逆に私が一番エピソードが弱いかも……歌い始めたのも、家: Ugh, because everyone is so awesome, conversely my episode might be the weakest... Starting to sing was just because my family praised me...
Message.練習で忙しいから、サボテンくんの面倒を見るのが遅れて心配かも……: Because practice keeps me busy, taking care of Saboten-kun gets delayed and I'm a bit worried...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nえっ？ いいの？ それならお願いしちゃおうかな。: @T_Commander\nEh? Is it okay? In that case, maybe I'll ask you to do it.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうなんだけど……うう、心配になっちゃって……: @T_Commander\nThat's true, but... ugh, I just get worried...
Message.＠Sienna_C\\nシエナって、ペットとか飼うと構いすぎちゃいそうだよね。: @Sienna_C\nSienna seems like she'd dote way too much if she kept a pet.
Message.＠Layla_J\\nそうだな……確かに、シエナは心配して過干渉になりそうなイメ: @Layla_J\nThat's true... Indeed, Sienna gives off an image of getting overly intrusive out of worry.
Message.リリーと同じタイプだね！ 犬とか構いすぎてたまに「疲れるからこっちくんな！」みた: Same type as Lilly! Pay too much attention to dogs and sometimes they bark like 'I'm tired, don't come over here!'!
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nあはは……私はそこまでじゃないかも……: @Lilly_L\nAhaha... I might not be that extreme...
Message.……うう……ライブに出るって知られてから、色んな人から電話がかかってくるよ……協: ...Ugh... Since people found out I'm performing live, all kinds of people have been calling... saying they want to assist, or offer help...
Message.＠Sienna_C\\nそういうのはガツンといって切ってやれ。求めない時に擦り寄: @Sienna_C\nTell those people off firmly and hang up. Guys who cozy up when you didn't ask just get in the way.
Message.@Reivel_B\\nさっすがレイヴェルだねぇ……きっちり割り切ってるね。まあ: @Reivel_B\nAs expected of Reivel~... drawing a sharp line. Well, I properly block those kinds of things too, though.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nううん！ そこまでやってもらわなくても大丈夫だよ！:
＠T_Commander
不用！　还不用做到那种地步！？
而且这种事必须由我自己来！
Message.＠T_Commander\\n本当に善意で言ってくれてるのかもしれないし、なかな: @T_Commander\nThey might genuinely be saying it out of goodwill, so I find it hard to speak up...
Message.＠Sienna_C\\nダメだよー！ ストップ迷惑電話！ そういうのはちゃんと断: @Sienna_C\nNo way~! Stop nuisance calls! You have to properly refuse those!
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nお、風紀委員っぽいね: @Lilly_L\nOoh, sounds like a Disciplinary Committee member.
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nぽいじゃなくて風紀委員だよ！？ もう、でも困ったら相談して: @Lilly_L\nI'm not 'like one', I AM a Disciplinary Committee member!? Geez, but if you're in trouble, consult with me! I'll help out!
Message.うう……なんだか筋肉痛……普段トレーニングしてるからそんなことはないはずなのにぃ: Ugh... somehow my muscles ache... I train regularly so this shouldn't happen, and yet...
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nおそらく姿勢の問題だろうな。マッサージでもしてやろう。それ: @Lilly_L\nProbably a posture issue. I'll give you a massage. Also, do you want advice on how to stand?
Message.＠Reivel_B\\nいいの！？ それなら教えて教えて！ すっごい助かる！: @Reivel_B\nIs that okay!? Then teach me, teach me! That helps so much!
Message.……こうやって見てるとさぁ。レイヴェルってかなり面倒見が良いよね: ...Looking at it like this. Reivel is pretty caring, isn't she.
Message.＠Layla_J\\nそうだね。最初に出会ったときは競争だったし、レイヴェルさん: @Layla_J\nThat's true. When we first met it was a competition, so I had an image of Reivel-san being strict and a bit scary, but...
Message.レイヴェルは前から優しかったよ？ だって、リリーが見回りしてると困ってる人に声を: Reivel was kind from before, you know? Because when Lilly goes on patrol, I often see her calling out to people in trouble, and the other day Lilly too—
Message.＠Lilly_L\\n……それ以上言うなら、教えるよりも説教が先になるぞ？: @Lilly_L\n...Say any more than that, and a lecture comes before teaching, got it?
Message.ひえええ！？ それだけは勘弁して～！: Hieeee!? Spare me from just that~!
Message.＠Lilly_L\\n……全く、油断も隙もないな: @Lilly_L\n...Honestly, can't drop my guard for a second.
Message.前まで音楽用語とかさっぱりだったけど、今はなんとなく意味がわかるようになったよ！: Before, I didn't understand music terminology at all, but now I somehow grasp the meanings! Isn't that great!
Message.＠Lilly_L\\nおお、凄いじゃん！ やっぱり興味を持ったり関わると覚えるの: @Lilly_L\nOoh, awesome! Having interest or getting involved really makes learning faster.
Message.＠Layla_J\\nうん、その気持ちはすごく分かる。私は逆に、覚えなきゃいけな: @Layla_J\nYeah, I totally get that feeling. Conversely for me, when there's something I have to memorize, I often tie it to musical terms.
Message.＠Sienna_C\\n自分の好きなジャンルを絡めて覚える方法は一番わかり易いよ: @Sienna_C\nConnecting things to a genre you like is the easiest way to memorize stuff~
Message.たしかにな。私も記憶をする際には、服やブランドに関連付けて覚えている。: Indeed. When I memorize things, I tie them to clothes or brands.
Message.＠T_Commander\\nこの流れだと、めっちゃ無趣味な人みたいだよね……: @T_Commander\nIn this flow of conversation, you sound like someone with zero hobbies...

Message.＠T_Commander\\nそうですね。選り好みせずにお手伝いしないと、ですよ: ＠T_Commander\nYou're right. We should help wherever we're needed, without picking and choosing.
Message.＠T_Commander\\n確かに、モチベーションがあった方が頑張れそうですね: ＠T_Commander\nTrue. Having something to work toward would help us try harder.
Message.……その、不束な妹ですが、みなさんよろしくお願いしますね。: ...Um, my incompetent little sister, please take care of her everyone.
Message.あぁ！？ 誰が狂犬よ？: Ah!? Who is a mad dog?
Message.ああ、すぐにこの学園の新たなボスになるんだからな！: Yeah, because I'll become the new boss of this academy soon!
Message.う、うん……あれ？ なんか、いいようにされたような……？: U-Yeah... Huh? Feels like I got taken advantage of somehow...?
Message.そ、そんなことしないわよ！ ……とにかく、お姉ちゃんは心配しなくていいから。: I-I won't do that! ...Anyway, big sister doesn't need to worry.
Message.そんな、心配もさせてもらえないなんて……私はコトハにとって必要ない、ということで: To think I'm not even allowed to worry... Does that mean I'm unnecessary to Kotoha...?
Message.ち、違う、そんなわけないでしょ！ その、お姉ちゃんが気にかけてくれるのは、嬉しい: N-No, that's not it! Um, I'm happy big sister cares... I was just a bit embarrassed...
Message.ちょっとお姉ちゃん！ 悪くないって言っただけでしょ！: Wait big sister! I only said it wasn't bad!
Message.でも一度衝突しといた方が、後々仲良くなれるかもよ？: But clashing once might make us get along better later, you know?
Message.どうもこうも、まあ、悪くないんじゃない？: Regardless, well, isn't it not bad?
Message.なんか無駄に尖ってるね。さすが狂犬。: Somehow unnecessarily sharp. As expected of a mad dog.
Message.なんだか今更な気もするけど、柊校舎に通うことになったわ。改めてよろしく。: Feels a bit late now, but I'll be attending Hiiragi campus. Nice meeting you again.
Message.ふふ、よかったです。それではこれからも、コトハをしっかり見守っていますからね。: Fufu, I'm glad. Well then, I'll keep a close eye on Kotoha from now on as well.
Message.ふふ、安心しました。コトハが楽しんでいるようで。: Fufu, I'm relieved. Kotoha seems to be enjoying herself.
Message.ふふ、私はお姉ちゃんですから。もっと素直に甘えてくれてもいいんですよ？: Fufu, I am the older sister after all. You can depend on me more honestly, you know?
Message.ま、一応よろしくしといてあげる。: Well, I'll greet you for now.
Message.よ、よろしくお願いします……それで、あ、あの！ えっと……%usernameus: N-Nice to meet you... So, u-um! What kind of relationship do you have with %usernameusernameuserna%-san...?
Message.コトハなら嫌なことは嫌だとハッキリ言うでしょうから。『悪くない』ということは、そ: Kotoha would clearly say no to what she dislikes. Saying 'not bad' means she's enjoying it somewhat, right?
Message.ボスの強さは半端じゃないぞ！: The boss's strength is no joke!
Message.ラミさん、同じ校舎の仲間なんですから、仲良くしてくださいまし。: Rami-san, since we're comrades in the same campus, please get along.
Message.上等じゃない……！ どっちが格上かわからせてあげるわ！: Bring it on...! I'll show you who's superior!
Message.何か困ったことがあったら、何でも言ってくださいね！: If you have any trouble, feel free to say anything!
Message.同じ柊校舎に通う仲間として、切磋琢磨していこう。: As comrades attending the same Hiiragi campus, let's encourage and improve each other.
Message.学園での生活はどうですか？: How is life at the academy?
Message.拳を交えることで分かりあい、友情が芽生える……漫画でよくあるパターン。: Understanding each other by crossing fists, sprouting friendship... a common manga pattern.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nずいぶんやる気ね。いいわ、やりたいなら、受けて立つ。\\n時間: @Aoi_I\nYou're quite motivated. Fine, if you want to, I'll take you on.\nI'll contact you again when there's time.
Message.＠Aoi_I\\nへえ、いいじゃない！\\n私もふたりの勝負、見てみたいわ！: @Aoi_I\nHeh, isn't that great!\nI want to see your match too!
Message.＠Kotoha\\nせっかく同じ校舎にいるんだ。\\n機会があるなら、一度１対１: @Kotoha\nSince we're in the same campus.\nIf there's an opportunity, I'd like to spar 1-on-1 once.
Message.＠Senka_H\\nわ、わたしも気になります……\\nおふたりとも、すごく強い: @Senka_H\nI-I'm curious too...\nBoth of you are extremely strong...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nあんたは一体何目線なのよ……: @T_Commander\nWhat perspective are you even speaking from...
Message.＠T_Commander\\nちょっと、なんであんたが最初に答えるのよ！: @T_Commander\nWait, why are you the first one answering!

Description.アマツ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。主となるエリアには柊校舎の他、飲食店や商店、住: A district based on the culture of the Amatsu region. The main area includes the Hiiragi school building along with restaurants, shops, and residences, making it a comfortable place to live. The Hiiragi school building is equipped with various facilities, allowing for a cultured life without inconvenience.
Description.スカラ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。スカラ校舎含めて校区全体が、複雑に入り組んだ城: A district based on the culture of the Scala region. Including the Scala school building, the entire district has an intricate, fortress-like architectural structure, the result of continuous unplanned expansion. With a school spirit that accepts students regardless of origin, it is a melting pot of peoples.
Description.ノヴァセレス地区の文化を基盤とした校区。ユーロ・タワーは学園のランドマークであり: A district based on the culture of the Nova Celes region. The Euro Tower is the academy's landmark, a skyscraper visible from anywhere. Because Nova Celes is economically developed, the school building is well-equipped, with various commercial facilities.
Description.リバティ地区の文化を基盤とした校区。ＬＯＣは創造性あふれる個性豊かな生徒が多く、: A district based on the culture of the Liberty region. LOC is full of creative, individualistic students, and many hold titles besides pilot. Except for drills and special classes, all basic classes are fully remote.
Description.各校区から独立した商業区域。映画館やショッピングモール、ゲームセンターに飲食店な: A commercial zone independent of each school district. It has cinemas, a shopping mall, an arcade, and restaurants, making it a place of relaxation for the students. The Special Training School, a retraining facility, is also located within the City.
Description.学園の行政機関が集中している区域。伝統的な建築物から近未来的な衣装を取り入れたビ: The area where the academy's administrative organs are concentrated. From traditional buildings to ones incorporating futuristic designs, the scenery blends tradition and modernity. It is mainly a district where non-students lodge, and the Instructor-Commander also stays in the dormitory here.
Description.レドフカ地区の文化を基盤とした校区に存在する。所属はレドフカ出身者しか認められて: Located in the district based on the culture of the Redfka region. Membership is granted only to those from Redfka, and it is known for strict education and training and high loyalty. There is little interaction with other school buildings.

Message.も、もしもし、桃園めるですっ！\nあの……今少しよろしいでしょうか？ 明日のお昼:
H-Hello, this is Meru Momozono!
Um... do you have a moment right now? I was thinking about the menu
for the bento lunch I'm bringing tomorrow...
Message.何かリクエストはありますか？ この前はパスタにしましたし、\nハンバーグや餃子も:
Do you have any requests? Last time we had pasta,
and we have Hamburg steak and gyoza pretty often, right?
I thought you might get tired of having the same things all the time...
Message.あなたには、飽きずにいつまでも……\nその、私のお弁当を食べてほしいから……:
Because I want you to... well, keep eating my lunches forever
without getting tired of them...
Message.あっ……そうだ！ オムライスなんてどうですか？\nそういえば、まだ作ってなかった:
Ah... I know! How about omurice?
Come to think of it, I haven't made that for you yet. I'm actually pretty confident in it.
Maybe I'll make the same thing for myself to bring along.
Message.それで……よろしければ、明日もお昼ご一緒しませんか？\n晴れるそうなので、ぜひと:
So... if you'd like, would you join me for lunch again tomorrow?
They say it's going to be sunny, so I'd love to eat out in the school courtyard...
Message.えへへ……最近お昼休みはいつもあなたを独り占めしてて、\n他のみんなに少し申し訳: Ehehe... I've been keeping you all to myself during lunch breaks lately, so I feel a little bad for everyone else...
Message.それじゃ、明日のお昼も楽しみにしていますねっ。: Well then, I'm looking forward to lunch tomorrow too!
Message.もしもし、えっと、桃園めるです！ 今よろしいでしょうか？\nその……もしよければ:
Hello, um, this is Meru Momozono! Do you have a moment right now?
Um... if it's alright, I wanted to ask about our next study session... while I still have the chance.
Message.その……あなたっていろんな女の子達から人気ですから……: You see... you're really popular with a lot of different girls, so...
Message.あ、ごめんなさい！ なんでもないです！\nもちろん、お忙しいなら全然断ってくれて:
Ah, I'm sorry! It's nothing!
Of course, if you're busy, please feel free to decline!
Message.でももし、また勉強会をしてくれるなら、\nまたふたりきりであの教室でやりたいです:
But if we do have another study session,
I'd love to study just the two of us in that classroom again... ehehe.
Message.次からは前よりも長く時間を取れればいいなって思っています。\nそれだけあなたと一:
I hope we can spend more time together next time than before.
That way, I can be with you longer...
Message.今度は何か美味しいお菓子や飲み物を持っていきますね！\nふたりで食べながら楽しく:
I'll bring some delicious snacks and drinks next time!
I hope we can have fun studying while enjoying them together!
Message.それでは楽しみにしていますね。\n新しい参考書とかいっぱい買わなきゃ……！:
Well then, I'll be looking forward to it.
I'll need to buy lots of new reference books...!
Message.あっ……%usernameusernameuserna%さん、お疲れ様です。\n:
Ah... thank you for your hard work, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Um... thank you so much for listening to my advice today.
I'm really glad I talked to you.
Message.そうじゃないと、いつまでもウジウジ悩んでしまって……\nきっと本番も集中できなか:
Otherwise, I would have kept moping around endlessly...
I probably wouldn't have been able to focus during the real thing either.
I wouldn't even have been able to make use of this concentration skills that everyone complimented me on.
Message.……あ、そうだ。もし一斉検挙作戦が始まったら、\nあまりお話しできる機会がないと:
...Ah, that's right. Once the roundup operation begins,
I don't think we'll have much chance to talk, so I wanted to say this now.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%さん……\n私達の命……%use:
%usernameusernameuserna%...
We are entrusting our lives... to you, %usernameusernameuserna%.
I believe in you.
Message.だから%usernameusernameuserna%さんも、私を――私達を信じ:
So I would be really happy if you, %usernameusernameuserna%, could trust me—trust us—and lead us.
We will fulfill our duty with everything we've got.
Message.だから――当日はよろしくお願いいたしますね。: So—please take good care of us on that day.
Message.もしもし、鳴滝です。\nその、お時間は大丈夫でしょうか？:
Hello, this is Narutaki.
Um, do you have a moment to talk?
Message.今日はありがとうございましたわ……\nデートに誘ったのはわたくしなのに、色々とエ:
Thank you so much for today...
Even though I was the one who asked you out on a date, you ended up escorting me in so many ways.
Message.ふふ、でも結果的に良かった気がしますわ。\n初めてのエスコートをして頂いた相手が:
Fufu, but in the end, I feel it turned out well.
Having you as the person who escorted me for the very first time...
Message.……もしよろしければ、またデートをして頂けますか？: ...If you don't mind, would you go on another date with me?
Message.今日の事はとても勉強になりましたもの。\nだから、今度こそはちゃんとしたデートを:
I learned a lot from today's experience.
That's why I want to have a proper date next time.
Message.ふふ、次は今日みたいな失敗はしませんわ。\n一緒に楽しむことが大切……ですわよね:
Fufu, I won't make the same mistakes next time.
The important thing is enjoying our time together... right?
Message.だから、楽しみにしていてくださいませ。\n二人で一緒に楽しい時間を過ごせるデート:
So please look forward to it.
I'll plan a date where the two of us can have a wonderful time together♪
Message.そういうことで、またお誘いしますわね。\nでは……失礼します。:
With that said, I'll invite you again sometime.
Well then... good night.
Message.もしもし、鳴滝です。\nお時間は大丈夫でしょうか？:
Hello, this is Narutaki.
Do you have a moment?
Message.ふふ、お時間を頂きありがとうございます。\n今日は本当に助かりましたわ。:
Fufu, thank you for making time for me.
You were a huge help today.
Message.ゲームセンターの件は特に……あのままだと、\n何も見つからないまま沈んだ気分で帰:
Especially regarding the arcade... If you hadn't been there,
I would have gone home feeling down without finding anything.
Message.それで、頂いたぬいぐるみの名前を考えましたの。\nふふ、ちゃんとした普通の名前で:
So, I came up with a name for the plushie you gave me.
Fufu, it's a perfectly normal name.
Message.ナデシコちゃんって名前を付けましたの。\nええ、わたくしの育てている花の名前から:
I named it Nadeshiko-chan.
Yes, I named it after the flowers I grow♪
Message.どうしてナデシコにしたのかって？\n……その、それは……秘密、ですわ。:
Why did I choose Nadeshiko, you ask?
...Well, that's... a secret.
Message.ただ、わたくしの気持ちを込めて付けましたの……\nそ、それだけですわ！:
I just put my feelings into it when giving it that name...
Th-That's all there is to it!
Message.ナデシコちゃんは大切に致しますわね。\n……また、この子の様子を見に来てください:
I will take good care of Nadeshiko-chan.
...Please come check on her again sometime, okay?
Message.ええ……それじゃあ、また。\n失礼いたしますわ。:
Yes... Well then, see you later.
Goodbye.
Message.もしもーし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\n今日は色々と付:
Hellooo, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Thanks for hanging out with me today♪
Message.まあ、ちょっと調子を崩しちゃったけど、\nすっかりいつものあたしに戻ったよ！: Well, I got a bit out of sorts, but I'm completely back to my usual self now!
Message.でも、考えてみたんだけどさぁ。\n%usernameusernameuserna:
But you know, I was thinking about it.
You're at fault too, %usernameusernameuserna%!
Message.最近、すっごい楽しくなっちゃったからさぁ。\nそのせいで、ずっと一緒に遊びたいな:
Because things have been so super fun lately,
I ended up wanting to hang out with you all the time!
Message.だから、あたしらしくない行動だってしちゃって、\nまだまだいられるように……って:
That's why I acted out of character and tried so hard...
just so I could stay around longer.
Message.……って、ちょっと恥ずかしいこと言っちゃったかな？\nでも、これってあたしの本音:
...Wait, did I just say something embarrassing?
But hey, those are my true feelings, okay?
Message.だから、ちゃんと責任取って、\nもっといろいろと面白い事に付き合ってよね！:
So take responsibility and keep joining me
for all kinds of fun things!
Message.今日はありがとうね？\nちょっとあたしの情けない姿を見せちゃったかな……:
Thanks for today, okay?
I guess I showed you a pretty pathetic side of me...
Message.まあ、流石にああいう態度になっちゃうとねぇ……\n流石にちょっと悲しかったなぁ。:
Well, when people take an attitude like that...
It really made me a little sad, as expected.
Message.あの時も言ったけど、\n昔から態度が変わっちゃう子っていっぱい居たからね。:
Like I said back then,
there have always been lots of kids whose attitudes suddenly changed.
Message.これって何回経験しても慣れないんだよねぇ……: No matter how many times I experience this, I never get used to it...
Message.だからこそ、シリウスシュガーの皆も、\nキミもあたしに変わらず付き合ってくれるの:
That's why I'm so happy that everyone in Sirius Sugar,
and you as well, treat me the same as always♪
Message.……実はあたしの居場所がなくなっちゃうかも。\nなんて、不安になってたんだけど。: ...To be honest, I was getting anxious that I might lose my place here.
Message.でも、そんな不安は杞憂だったみたいだね！\nんー、この学園に来てからあたしって恵:
But it seems those worries were completely unfounded!
Hmm, maybe I've been really blessed since coming to this academy♪
Message.だから、キミたちともっと一緒に居られるように、\nちょっとはあたしも頑張ってみる:
So I'll try my best to do my part too,
just so I can stay with you all even longer♪
Message.もしもし～？ %usernameusernameuserna%、あけおめ～！\n:
Hello~? Happy New Year, %usernameusernameuserna%~!
...Wait, I guess this greeting's expiration date has passed by now, hasn't it?
Message.いやぁ、餅パ楽しかったね～！\nまあ、さすがにあんだけの量あったからか、食べ切れ:
Man, that mochi party was so much fun~!
Well, as expected with that amount, we couldn't finish it all though.
...What should we do with the leftovers? Hand them out to everyone in Sirius Sugar?
Message.え？ また餅パやればいい？\nまあ、それはそうかもしれないけど、お正月はもう終わ:
Huh? Just host another mochi party?
Well, that might be true, but isn't New Year's already over?
Message.もし第１回をふたりでやったなんて言ったら、\nめるちゃん達ってばきっと別のおモチ:
If I tell them we held the 1st one with just the two of us,
Meru-chan and the others will definitely burn with a different kind of jealousy~
Message.ん？ なんのおモチかって？\nふふ、それは乙女のヒ・ミ・ツ♪:
Hmm? What kind of jealousy?

Becoming selfish... it sounds simple when put into words,
and yet making that choice on my own would have been difficult, you know?
Message.今だってあなたの声を聴いて、とっても安心してるわ。\nでも次は電話越しじゃなくて:
Even now, hearing your voice makes me feel so relieved.
Next time, don't just do it over the phone... hug me tight and whisper in my ear.
Your words of love for me, that is♪
Message.私が自分に対して、それだけしか価値がない……なんて思ったら、\n私を大切にしてく:
If I thought to myself that I only had that much value...
It would be rude to everyone who treasures me.
Message.色々とありがとうね！ クラスナの皆とお話をして……ちょっとだけ\n%userna:
Thanks for everything! After talking with everyone in Krasna...
I think I understand a little bit of what you were saying, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Message.……でもでも、おにいちゃんのおねがいなら、\nリディア、いっぱいぽかぽかえがおに:
...But but, if it's big brother's request,
Lidia will be full of warm, happy smiles.
Message.いっぱいいっぱい、えにっきかいたよ。\nおたすけさんぽも、かき氷も、おたからさん:
I drew lots and lots in my picture diary.
The helper walk, shaved ice, treasure walk... even Mia.
I made so many memories.
Message.おにいちゃん、こんばんは。\nこの前のかいすいよく、たのしかった。:
Good evening, Big Brother.
Going swimming in the ocean the other day was so fun.
Message.これもおにいちゃんとレイヴェルとルナのおかげ。: This was thanks to Big Brother, Level, and Luna too.
Message.だからね、ずっとみんないっしょがいい。\nこれからも、いっしょだよ、おにいちゃん:
So you see, I want us all to stay together forever.
Let's stay together from now on too, Big Brother.
Message.だからリディアも、おにいちゃんたちにお礼がしたい。\nなにかほしいもの、してほし:
That's why Lidia wants to thank you and the others too.
Is there anything you want, or anything you want me to do? I'll help you out.
Message.だけど、リディアがぽかぽかえがおなのは、\nおにいちゃんたちといっしょだから。:
But the reason Lidia has a warm, happy smile
is because I'm together with you and the others.
Message.でもそれじゃ、お礼にならないよ……？: But that wouldn't count as a thank-you, would it...?
Message.んー？ いっぱいなってる……？\nレイヴェルやルナも、そう思ってる……？:
Hmm? It already counts as plenty...? 
Do Level and Luna think so too...?
Message.んー？ リディアがわらっていてくれたら、それでいい？: Hmm? As long as Lidia is smiling, that's enough?
Message.それじゃあ、一緒に商店街を盛り上げるために頑張りましょうね♪\nバイバーイ♪:
Well then, let's work hard together to liven up the shopping district♪
Bye-byee♪
Message.でも、してもらってばかりじゃ申し訳ないから、\nあたしに頼みたいことがあったら何:
But I feel bad always being on the receiving end,
so if there's anything you want to ask of me, just say the word!
Message.ふふ、あたしにちゃんと付いてきてくれるから、\nついつい楽しくなっちゃって、やり:
Fufu, because you kept up with me so well,
I got carried away having fun and overdid it a bit♪
Message.ふふ、これも後輩クンだけに言うのよ？\nだって、信頼してるから♪:
Fufu, I'm only saying this to you, Junior-kun, okay?
Because I trust you♪
Message.もしもし、後輩クン？ さっきはありがとう♪\n色んな場所に付き合わせちゃってゴメ:
Hello, Junior-kun? Thanks for earlier♪
Sorry for dragging you around to so many places, okay?
Message.後輩クンって、文句を言わずに手伝ってくれるし、\n親身になってくれるから本当に助:
You always help out without complaining, Junior-kun,
and you're so caring, which really helps me out♪
Message.後輩クンのためなら、何だってしてあげるから。\nあ、エッチなお願いでもいいわよ…:
If it's for your sake, Junior-kun, I'll do anything for you.
Ah, naughty requests are fine too... Just kidding♪
Message.……うん、ちゃんと治ったなら良かった……私としたことが、\n慌てて傷を舐めちゃっ:
...Yeah, I'm glad it healed properly... For someone like me
to frantically lick your wound... I really wasn't calm at all.
Message.……それに、相談してくれた子が元気になった姿を見るのって、\n案外悪くないからね:
...Besides, seeing a kid who came to me for advice get all energetic again
isn't half bad, actually.
Message.……ちょっと私らしくなかったかな。まあ、キミも何かあったら、\n私に相談してね？:
...Maybe that wasn't very like me. Well, if anything happens to you,
consult with me too, okay? Calling is fine, or I can listen in person♪
Message.ここで聞ける相談だったり、\n悩みっていうのはビジネスのタネになるからね。:
Consultations and worries I hear here
can become seeds for business, after all.
Message.ちゃんと相談の対価は貰うけどね？\n……なーんてね？ 冗談だよ。それじゃ、またね:
I'll properly charge a fee for the consultation, though!
...Just kidding♪ It's a joke. Well then, see you later♪ Bye-bye.
Message.ふふ、ボランティアとはいっても、私が何かを得るのは自由でしょ？\nキミだって打算:
Fufu, even if it's volunteer work, I'm free to gain something from it, right?
Even you told me it's fine to be calculating♪
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%くん？\n私だよ、レイ:
Hello, %usernameusernameuserna%-kun?
It's me, Layla. How is your injury from the other day?
Message.一応、商店街のことが一段落したあとも、\nしばらくコミュニティナースのお手伝いを:
For now, even after things with the shopping district settle down,
I plan to keep helping out as a community nurse for a while.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%～？\n今時間いい？:
%usernameusernameuserna%~?
Do you have time right now?
Message.……あ、でも、まずこの戦いに勝たなきゃか。\nじゃあ準備して来る！ バイバーイ♪:
...Ah, but first we have to win this battle, huh.
Alright, I'll go get ready! Bye-byee♪
Message.……あなたと一緒だと、力が湧いてくる気がします。\n自分達の未来を、自分達の手で:
...When I'm with you, I feel power welling up inside me.
I feel like we can seize our own future with our own hands.
Message.あはは、また恥ずかしいこと言っちゃったかも。\nじゃあ終わり！ 後でね～。:
Ahaha, I might have said something embarrassing again.
Okay, that's all! See you later~
Message.えへへ……電話っていいね。\n耳元で%usernameusernameusern:
Ehehe... Talking on the phone is nice.
I can hear your voice right next to my ear, %usernameusernameuserna%...
Message.さっき話したことなんだけど、\nあんまり人に言っちゃだめだからね。:
About what we talked about earlier,
don't tell too many people, okay?
Message.その未来を迎えるために、全力を尽くそうと思います。: To reach that future, I intend to give it my all.
Message.それでは、失礼いたしますわ。\n後ほど会いましょう。:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
Let's meet later.
Message.それに……なんかさっきの話、\nよく考えたらちょっと恥ずかしいこと言ってたし。:
Besides... thinking about what I said earlier,
I realized I said something kind of embarrassing.
Message.だから……他の皆には絶対に負けないよ！\n本気で行くから、覚悟しておいてね！:
So... I definitely won't lose to anyone else!
I'm going all out, so be prepared!
Message.だから、この戦いが終わったら……\nその未来について、また、たくさんお話しさせて:
So after this battle is over...
please let me talk to you a lot more about that future, okay?
Message.だからこそ、その未来について考えて……\n希望を持つべきなんだって、そう思うよ。:
That's why I think we should think about that future...
and hold onto hope.
Message.でも、全部本当のことだもんね。\nあたしたちは未来のために戦ってる。:
But it's all true, isn't it.
We're fighting for the sake of the future.
Message.なんだか、不思議な気分。こういう通話みたいに、\n今まで当たり前に思ってたものが:
It feels kind of strange. Just like this phone call,
things I took for granted until now suddenly look so bright and shiny.
Message.まずは、学園に戻ったらデートしよ！ ふたりで色んなところに行きたい！\n絶対絶対:
First off, let's go on a date once we get back to the academy! I want to go all kinds of places together with you!
I definitely, definitely, definitely want to go!
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\nごめんね、その…:
Hello, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Sorry, um... I just wanted to hear your voice.
Message.シリウスシュガー、そして集った皆で、\n誰一人欠けることなく生きて帰る。:
Sirius Sugar, and everyone gathered here,
we will all return alive, without a single person missing.
Message.今は皆、目の前の戦いに集中してるだろうから、\n余計な情報を入れちゃわないように:
Everyone is probably focusing on the battle right in front of them right now,
so I have to make sure not to give unnecessary information.
Message.多分だけど、\nこれもきっと%usernameusernameuserna%のお:
It's just a guess, but
this is definitely thanks to you too, %usernameusernameuserna%.
Message.恥ずかしいところも見せてしまいましたが……\nもう、わたくしの中に不安はありませ:
I showed you an embarrassing side of myself, but...
there is no longer any anxiety left inside me.
Message.%usernameusernameuserna%、まだ起きてる？\nさっきはあり:
%usernameusernameuserna%, are you still awake?
Thanks for earlier.
Message.……でもこの話をした時、ファルファッラがすごく微妙な顔してた。\n顔合わせがどう:
...But when I talked about this, Farfalla made a really subtle face.
Saying something about formal family introductions or whatever.
Message.そうなるって……ラミ達を日常に返して、おまえも一緒に帰るって、\nそういう未来を:
That's how it'll be... Returning Rami and the others to daily life, and you coming back together with us,
because I fight believing in that kind of future.
Message.それで、私の知らない場所だと、\n父さんがどんな人だったのか、何を考えてたのか、:
And I hope that, in places I don't know,
I can learn what kind of person my father was and what he was thinking.
Message.だから、その時は一緒に来てくれないかな。\n無事に帰ってこれたのはこの人のおかげ:
So, will you come with me when that time comes?
Because I want to introduce you as the person who made it possible for me to return safely.
Message.でも約束、ゼッタイ忘れないようにしろよ。\n一緒に帰るってやつ。:
But make sure you NEVER forget our promise.
The one about returning together.
Message.とにかく、覚えておいて。\nじゃあこれで……通話を切るボタンは確か……:
Anyway, keep it in mind.
Well then... the button to end the call was, if I recall...
Message.とにかく！ とっとと寝ろ！ また明日！\n寝不足でボケてたらぶっ飛ばすからな！:
Anyway! Go to sleep already! See you tomorrow!
If you're out of it from lack of sleep, I'll send you flying!
Message.なんか、髪結んでもらった分、\nちょっと勇気もらえたし……やっぱ今のナシナシ！:
Having my hair tied up gave me a bit of courage, so...
Wait, cancel that last part! Ughhh!
Message.ま、ラミ様にかかればそれぐらいラクショーだけどね。\nイザナミなんかぶっ飛ばして:
Well, for Rami-sama, something like that is a piece of cake.
We just have to blast Izanami away and get ourselves a free tomorrow!
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%？\n今、ちょっといい:
Hello, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Do you have a moment right now?
Message.今度、ファルファッラに案内してもらって、\n父さんがよく行ってた場所を巡ることに:
Next time, I decided to have Farfalla guide me around
places my father used to visit often.
Message.付き合ってくれて、まあ……助かったかも。\nそこは感謝してる。:
You coming along with me... well, was pretty helpful, I guess.
I'm grateful for that.
Message.大事な人に大事な人を紹介したいって、変なのかな。\nよく分からない。:
Is it weird that I want to introduce an important person to an important person?
I don't really know.
Message.……それと、先ほどの会話はニーナには伝えぬように。\n我が魂の片割れの負担となる:
...And don't tell Nina about our conversation earlier.
I cannot allow it to become a burden on my soul's other half.
Message.そのために、我はお前と共に戦うとしよう。\n同じ『今日』を生きる者として、な。:
To that end, I shall fight alongside you.
As those who share the same 'today'.
Message.ちょ、ちょっと、あまり怒鳴らないでください！\nいきなりどうしたんですか！？\n:
W-Wait, please don't shout like that!
What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?
Huh...? It's not flattery? That I'm truly attractive...
Message.先ほどは我の決意を見届けてくれたこと、感謝する。\n信頼するお前だからこそ、あの:
I thank you for witnessing my resolve earlier.
It was precisely because you are someone I trust that I could lay myself bare like that.
Message.我にとって一番大事な存在は、やはりニーナなのだ。\nおっと……これもまた、本人に:
To me, the most important presence is still Nina.
Oops... please keep this a secret from her as well.
Message.我らは家畜ではない。与えられるだけの明日に意味はない。\n故に『今日』という日を:
We are not livestock. A tomorrow that is merely handed to us has no meaning.
Therefore, we must fight through this 'today' and win what we desire.
Message.話は以上だ。ではな、%usernameusernameuserna%！\n後ほど:
That is all. Farewell, %usernameusernameuserna%!
Do not get too entranced by my sword dance on the battlefield later!
Message.……そのためにも、この戦いを乗り越える必要があります。\n後ほどまた、決戦に向け:
...For that reason as well, we need to overcome this battle.
Let's coordinate again later for the decisive battle. Farewell.
Message.あと、それと……戦いが終わったら、ゾリャーの外のこと、\nまだまだたくさん教えて:
Also... when the battle is over,
please teach me so much more about the world outside Zorya.
Message.なんだかこうしていると、普通のどこにでもいる\nひとりの女の子になったみたいです:
Somehow, being like this makes me feel like I've become
an ordinary girl you could find anywhere.
Message.もしもし、%usernameusernameuserna%さんですか？\nさっき:
Hello, is this %usernameusernameuserna%?
Thank you for accompanying me to check the unit earlier.
Message.ザルトゥームの未来のために、あなたが辣腕を振るうことを期待します。\n我々クラス:
For the future of Zartum, I expect you to show your great skill.
We in Krasna will also surely follow your orders and deliver results.
Message.不安や懸念を完全に払拭し、\n決戦に臨むことができるようになったでしょうか。:
Have you completely cleared away your anxieties and concerns,
allowing you to face the decisive battle?
Message.私達……思えば、出会ってからまだ間もないですけど。\nでも、%usernameu:
Come to think of it... it hasn't been long since we met.
But if it's you, %usernameusernameuserna%, I can trust you.
Message.……？ みんなじゃなくて、ふたりで……？: ...Huh? Just the two of us... instead of everyone...?
Message.あ、%usernameusernameuserna%さん、こんにちは。\n昨日は:
Oh, hello, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Um... thank you for yesterday.
Message.い、いえ！ 嫌とかじゃなくて……むしろ、望むところと言いますか、\n願ってもない:
N-No! It's not that I don't want to... Quite the opposite! It's exactly what I'd like,
or rather, more than I could have hoped for...!
Message.ううん、なんでもないです！ 嬉しいです……！\nどうであれ、私と『ふたりで』とい:
No, it's nothing! I'm happy...!
Whatever the reason, especially since it's 'just the two of us'... Ehehe.
Message.えっ！？ ふたりでですか！？: Huh!? Just the two of us!?
Message.え？ また星を観に行こう？ 今度は景色のいい場所で……？: Huh? Go stargazing again? Somewhere with a nice view this time...?
Message.では今度時間を作って、夜空の綺麗な場所へ行きましょう。\nアマツで綺麗な星が観ら:
Then let's find some time to go somewhere with a beautiful night sky.
I'll look for a few good stargazing spots
in Amatsu.
Message.はい……！ 喜んで！\nではみんなにもこのお話をして、スケジュールを――:
Yes...! I'd love to!
Then I'll tell everyone and arrange our schedules—
Message.ん？ 昨日のお礼をちゃんとしたい……ですか？: Hmm? You want to properly thank me for yesterday...?
Message.不束者ですが、これからも末永くよろしくお願いしますっ。: I still have a lot to learn, but I hope you'll stay with me for years to come!
Message.…………あーもう、ほんと、ヤなやつ！ そういうとこよ！！\n目の前にいたら蹴飛ば:
............Agh geez, seriously, you're so annoying! It's that trait of yours!!
If you were right in front of me, I'd kick you!
Message.……？ え、行ってくれるの……？ ふたりで？: ...? Eh, you'll go with me...? Just the two of us?
Message.あー！ やっぱなし！ 忘れなさい！ 今のはなし！\nこんなの私らしくない！:
Ah! Forget it after all! Forget what I said! Cancel that!
This isn't like me at all!
Message.いい？ 絶対今度もふたりだからね！\n『せっかくだからみんなも誘ってみた』\nと:
Listen here, next time has to be just the two of us too, okay!
Don't do something idiotically stupid like
'Since we're going, I invited everyone else too'!
Message.え？ 『そういう一面もいい』……？: Eh? 'A side like that is nice too'...?
Message.こ、今度よかったら……また、どこかに行かない？ ふ、ふたりで……: I-If you're free next time... want to go somewhere again? J-Just the two of us...
Message.こう……あんたと何でもない日を、\nもっと過ごしてみたいっていうか……: Like... I want to spend more ordinary, nothing-special days with you...
Message.どうせなら、のんびり夕日の見れる場所とか……そういうところ。\nまあ、無理にとは:
If we're going, somewhere we can relax and watch the sunset... a place like that.
Well, I'm not forcing you or anything, though...
Message.ふふ、言ったわね？ 今更撤回なんてナシなんだから！\nまた予定つけたら声かけるわ:
Fufu, you said it, okay? There's no taking it back now!
I'll call you again once I set up a schedule!
Message.もしもし……起きてる？ 今日はその……ありがとう。楽しかったわ。\n校舎もゆっく:
Hello... Are you awake? Today... thanks. I had fun.
I got to take my time looking around the school building too.
Message.校舎から見る夕日、綺麗だった。\n本当なら晴れていれば毎日見れるはずなのに、\n:
The sunset seen from the school building was beautiful.
Normally, we should be able to see it every day if it's clear,
but I realized that there are surprisingly few times when we actually take the time to watch it properly.
